morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Intervocalic or stem-final dialectal alternation between glottal stop 7 and glides/ejectives.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: be7u ~ beyu ('Let her look'); me77- ~ meqq- ('to break'); sa77- ~ saxx- ('to bite')

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Alveolar nasal /n/ assimilates to bilabial, palatal, or velar place of following obstruent.
Feminine animate plurals insert feminine theme vowel -e- before plural suffix -ntt-.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.fst_reverse_pattern: -enttappe -> root + F.PL.ABL; -entti -> root + F.PL.NOM; -entta -> root + F.PL.ACC
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: miidzdze ('cow') -> miidzdzentti (NOM.PL), miidzdzenttappe ('from the cows'); meddaayentta ('the brides')

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Alveolar sibilants/affricates palatalize when followed by a palatal consonant or suffix.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: ichchashsha ('five') + -antso -> ichchashshanchcho ('fifth'); ʔuj- ('drink') + -ss- -> ʔushsh- ('give to drink')

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Root-final /k', j, t/ coalesce with causative -ss- into geminate -ss- or palatal -shsh-.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.fst_reverse_pattern: ess- <- eqq- + -iss-; bess- <- be7- + -iss-; ushsh- <- uy- + -iss-; tooss- <- tookk- + -iss-
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: eqq- ('stand') -> ess- ('stop/set upright'); be7- ('see') -> bess- ('show'); uy- ('drink') -> ushsh- ('give to drink')

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Geminate root-final consonants degeminate when followed by heavy derivational suffixes containing geminates.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.fst_reverse_pattern: baiz-ett- -> bayzz-; ʔuuk-ett- -> uukk-; pit-erets- -> pitt-; shamm- -> sham-ett-
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: bayzz- ('sell') -> bayz-ett-is ('was sold'); uukk- ('bake') -> uuk-ett-is ('was baked'); pitt- ('sweep') -> pit-erets- ('sweep repeatedly')

morphophonemic_fst_rules.formal_rewrite: /k/ -> [h] / V__V (especially in passive -étt- and fast speech)
morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Degeminated voiceless velar stop /k/ spirantizes to glottal fricative [h] between vowels.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: uukk- ('bake') -> uuk-ett-is ~ uuh-ett-is ('was baked'); bookk- ('dig') -> booho ('ditch/trench')

morphophonemic_fst_rules.process_name: Terminal Vowel Truncation Before Vowel-Initial Suffixes
morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Verbal citation terminal vowels delete unconditionally before vowel-initial TAM and derivational suffixes.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: ooso ('work') -> oott-ays ('I work'), oott-idosona ('they worked'); tamaaro ('learn') -> tamaar-ana ('will learn')

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Feminine nouns replace or augment their terminal vowel with palatal -e- before definite case suffixes.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: aayo ('mother') -> aayiya (NOM.F.DEF), aayiw (ACC.F.DEF); mishire ('lady') -> mishiriya (NOM.F.DEF), mishiriw (ACC.F.DEF)

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Breaks hiatus (*-ea, *-oa) via glide insertion and raises mid vowels /e, o/ to /i, u/, creating surface -iya, -uwa, -iw.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: bitane ('man') -> bitaniya (ACC.M.DEF); migiddo ('ring') -> migidduwa (ACC.M.DEF); hare ('donkey') -> hariw (ACC.F.DEF)

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Male proper names in -a and female names in -o drop TV before case suffixes; male names in -e/-o diphthongize (-ey, -oy).
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: Dosa (M) -> Dosi (NOM), Dosa (ACC); Dosito (F) -> Dosita (NOM), Dosito (ACC); Doli -> Dola (NOM.M)

morphophonemic_fst_rules.process_name: Canonical Syllable Templates (U, GU, GUGU, GUGUGGU)
morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Gofatho words are built from open V/CV and closed CVC/CVCC syllables; initial consonant clusters (*CCV-) are strictly prohibited.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.fst_reverse_pattern: Reject *CCV- word-initially; insert epenthetic vowel if loanword
morphophonemic_fst_rules.source_citation: Goofatho Doona Grade 9 Ch. 1 (pp. 5–7) & Grade 10 Ch. 2

morphophonemic_fst_rules.formal_rewrite: *C1C2C3 -> C1C2V or C1C2 (except digraphs th, dh, dz, sh, ch, ph, ny, zh)
morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: No more than two consonant phonemes may cluster word-medially; doubled digraphs write only the first letter doubled (e.g. dhdh, chch, shsh, thth).
morphophonemic_fst_rules.fst_reverse_pattern: Normalize chch, shsh, dhdh, thth, qq, xx, cc

morphophonemic_fst_rules.formal_rewrite: '7' represents phonemic glottal stop /ʔ/ (single 7 or geminate 77)
morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: In Latin script, '7' never occurs word-initially (initial /ʔ/ is unwritten) but is mandatory word-medially and in geminates (77).
morphophonemic_fst_rules.fst_reverse_pattern: Preserve '7' and '77' in ASR/TTS and Fidel (ዓ/ዑ/ዒ/ዔ/ዕ/ዖ)
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: na7a ('child'), lo77o ('good'), ba7a ('not exist'), ma77o ('clothes'), zo7o ('red'), qan77ishe ('poetic duel')
morphophonemic_fst_rules.source_citation: Goofatho Doona Grade 8–10 & Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 22)

morphophonemic_fst_rules.conditioning_environment: Converb and finite verb theme vowels partition subjects into Group A (1S, 2S, 3FS) and Group I/O/E (3MS, 1PL, 2PL, 3PL); H-L-H sequences undergo H-H-H plateauing.
morphophonemic_fst_rules.fst_reverse_pattern: Enforce -ada for 1S/2S/3FS and -idi for 3MS/1PL/2PL/3PL in clause chains
morphophonemic_fst_rules.exemplars_gofatho: Taani mada baas (1S uses -ada) vs. I midi bis (3MS uses -idi)

Woga Buqurata
Nu mayzappe woykko yeletaappe yeletaakko aadhdhishe yeda dumma dumma 
buqurati woga buqurata geetettees. He woga buqurati moodettonashin ooratha 
yeletaas maaran adhdhana mela ishalssi oykkida beni aawati daroppe anjjetanaas 
koshshees. He dumma dumma kushe hiillan malaaliyabata ubbaa nuus bonch -
chora aathidosona guussi. Medhetan de7iya woga buqurata naagidi wosoy nuuppe 
ubbaappe naagettiyaba gidiya gishas bonchchidi oyqethi koshshees. Hayssara 
gahettida woga buqurati naagettidi uttana mela bessiya gisho Issippetida alame 
gadeta timirtte, saynisenne woga kaalethiya yarati (UNESCO) baggara eratethi 
imettishe gam77is. Hessappe denddidayssan, nu gade Tophphiya pa garssan de7iya 
dumma dumma woga buqurata alame dethan erisasu. Gidoppe attin, Tophphiyan 
daro dalgga woga buqurati de7okkoka ha nibaabe kaara garssan shiiqidayssati 
Sofomere gonggolo, Laalibala woosa keetha woykko Bataskkaana, Jogole goda 
geetettiya woga buqurata.
Sofomere gonggoloy Tophphiya Oroomo killilen beettes. Ha gonggoloy sunthet -
tiday Isilaame sheeke Sof Omer Ahimede sunthana. Ha sheeke sunthan sunthettida 
gaasoy sheekey paara daro asa dumma dumma metoy gakkiya wode kem77on gelidi 
unddenne wode uttidia gishossa. Ha gonggoloy medhdhettiday webi geetettiya 
shaafiya goggiya oge aggada gonggoloy medhdhettiya biitta garssara biitttanne 
gonggolo shuchcha meecci efida gishassa. Sofe Omer gonggoloy adussatethay 16 
kilo metire gidishin 40 geliyanne ke7iya wulati de7oosona. 
Ha gonggoluwa garssan dumma dumma kifileti de7iya gisho baatire poo7on 
go77ettidi gaatha xeellanaas dandda7ees. Gaathan dumma dumma kifileti de7iya 
gisho xeelliya asa beessa malliya maappe qo77ettoosona. Sofe Omore gonggoloy 
alame yuushon medhettida sa7a garssan de7iya gonggolota gaathappe daro malalisi-

Tamaare Maxaafe
yanne Iyara geedarettiya gonggoloy baynna gisho Issippetida alame gadeta timirtte, 
saynisenne woga kaalethiya yarati (UNESCO) erettida Tophphiyan de7iya woga 
buquratappe issuwa. 
Laalibela bataskkanati 645 kilometire Tungga katamaappe pudeha baggara de7ees. 
Laalibela bataskkaanay issi shuchchappe woykko zaallappe woochettidi keexet -
tides. Ha bataskkaanati kawo laalibela woden 12tho xeetu laythan keexettida dumma 
bataskkaana. Hessikka kawos dumma gidida kanddo qonccisiya bataskkaana. Ha 
bataskkaanay oosettida gaasoy kiristtaane ammano kaalliya asati geesha gade gidi 
ammaniya Yerusaaleme katama boonna mela Isilaame ammano kaalliya musulumeti 
olan xoonodi gishas Tophphiya biittan ooratha Yerusaaleme katama medhdhanaassa. 
Hessa dalggan xeelliya wode Akisume kawotethay kunddidayssappe guye baggan 
Laalibela kawotethay adil77e ciishshe mela ciiyyida wode.
 Issi zaalla shuchchappe woocettidi oosettida laalibaba bataskkaanay nam77u 
cugan shaakettoosona. Hessatikka: Yorddaanose geetettiya shaafappe pudeha 
ginaranne degeha ginara de7iya bataskkaana geetettoosona. Yorddaanose shaafappe 
pudeha baggara de7iya bataskkaanati sunthan qonccisishin Geeshsha medan -
aleme, Geeshsha marami bataskkana, geeshsha masqqala bataskkaana, geeshsha 
denagile bataskkaana, geeshsha goligotta gidishin Yorddanose shaafappe dugehara 
de7iya bataskkaanati qassi geeshsha Amanu7eela bataskkaana, geeshsha Marqqosa 
bataskkana, geeshsha Libanose bataskkaana, geeshsha rufa7ele bataskkaananne 
geeshsha Beteleme bataskkaanata gidishin geeshsha Gorggisey bataskkanay hara 
bessan de7ikkoka hara xuura ogen qonccida bataskkaanatara mino issipetethi de7ees. 
Laalibala bataskkaanati beni wode oosettida penggey woykko wuli, kaarinne baale 
bonchchiya dalgga bessi oyqqida malaalisiya ooso qommo. Hessanne hessa mela

Jogole goday Tophphiyan beettiya malaalisiya woga buquratappe issuwa. Ha woga 
buquray beettey Tophphiya doloha baggara Harare kataman beettees. Jogole goday 
Harare katama yuushon direttida goda. Ha goday harare kataman de7iya asata shooro 
gaden de7iya morkketappe naaganaas 13tho xeetu laythappe doommidi 16tho xeetu 
laythi gaso keexettida malaalisiya goda. Harare katamiwu yuuyidi direttida Jogole 
godas ichchashu geliya wulati de7oosona. Ha ichchashu wulati katamiwu ichchashu 
aqon gishiya ichchashu ogetara gahettidaba. Jogole goda gaathan 82 Isilaama woosa 
keethati woykko maskideti de7oosona. Hessappe denddidayssan Hararey Isilaama 
ammano kaalliya dere asas oyddantho geeshsha katama gidi ammanettoosona. 
Harare dere asay ha beni wode woga buqurata naagidinne ishalisi woson loythidi 
sabettoosona. Hessape denddidayssan, Harare biittan de7iya dere asay hessata 
mela dumma dumma kushe hiilla ooson loythidi erettoosona. Mallas: woysha giya 
maqa aaziya mithappe daachchoo ooson, hoothe ooson, moomi qolanaas maaddiya 
woyshappe oosettiya miishata giigison daroppe meezetidi erettoosona. Hessa gisho 
alame woga buqurata shiishiyanne naagiya issipethay (UNESCO) ooso keetha 
erettena mela hanis. 
Woga buqurati beni wode yeletaappe ha77i deiya yeletaakko beni benkko laythappe 
denddidi hachchi gakkanaas yeletappe yeletaakko aadhdhiya woga buqurati 
Tophphe biittes sunthatethappe aadhdhidi biittees demisha pultto gididi maaddiy 
gishos loythi bonchchidi oykkanaas bessees. Hesspappe denddidayssan yeletappe 
yeletakko aadhdhidi adussa wode moorettonnashin naagettidi uttida Tophphiya

Asatetha Kanddo
Asatetha kanddoy asa na7i biittan de7ishe issoy issuwara lo77o gahetethi medhdhidi 
dumma dumma oosota poloanaas maaddiya lo77o hanota guussi. Asaya pantta 
gallasa duussan issoy issuwara gahettishe, simerettishe, gelishenne keyishe bessiya 
lo77o kanddoti de7anaas koshshees. Lo77o asatetha kanddo dishoy deretethaa 
giddon oothanaas bessiyabatanne bessonnabata shaakki eridi polo guussi. Gijjidikka, 
lo77o kanddora de7iya asi asay hara asata ufayssiyabata, ufayssonnabata, lo77obata, 
iitabata woykko moorobata, polotika oosota, deretethaa hanota, wogatanne h.h. 
melata polo akeekidi polo guussi. 
Asatetha kanddotappe issoy dere asay issipetetha duussa sarotethan kaalethiya 
hanota. Deretetha garssan issipetha duussa sarotethan gahettishe kaaleso guussay 
issoy issuwara lo77o gahetetha medho, sarotetha medho, payyatetha oysho, ooso 
maaran oosonne deretetha bonchcho shiishi oykkees. Hessa bolla qassi asatetetha 
kanddo qonccisi xeelliya wode issi asas deretetha garssan de7iya bessay woykko 
bonchchotethay lo77o gidikko he uraas woykko asees lo77o asatetha kanddoy 
deretetha giddon de7ees geetetti ammanettees. Mallas: Dimokiraase maata, ooso 
maata, giira wodera cigo, heera geeshshatetha naago, biitta meechappe naaganaas 
mitha tokethi, issoy issuwa bonchcho, wolira kacettidayssata giigiso, kawo maata 
bonchchonne h.h. melata. 
Hara baggara qassi moorettida asatetha kanddoti qassi deretetha qohiya kanddo. 
Ha kanddoti deretetha garssan de7iya dalggidi de7ikko deretetha lo77o kanddota 
qohees. Mallas: uyi mathotethi, pantta soo asa bonchchonna ago, machcho bilethi, 
kawo giira wodera ciggona ixo, bayrata bonchchonna ago, imettida ooso polonna 
agonne h.h.melata. 
Nabbabo wode
Kaalli de7iya meega qofata nabbabidi kaysa bessan gelanaas bessiya qofa 
nibaabiya qofara gathidi zaaro immite.

textbook_chapters_28_deep.dialogues_summary: Aasetho Oda vs. Sitta Oda (pp. 47–49): Aasetho oday nam77u woykko daro asati wolira qofa laamerettishe haasayiya haasaya (dialogue); Sitta oday qassi issi asi haratas shiishiya moode haasaya (monologue/address). (Interactive Dialogue (Aasetho Oda) vs. Direct Address (Sitta Oda): Aasetho oda is an interactive conversation between two or more speakers, whereas sitta oda is a prepared speech delivered by a single speaker.)
textbook_chapters_28_deep.grammar_focus_qawosa: 1. Waatha Qaala (Compound Words, p. 53): Nam77u pana dandda7ida qaalati wolira gahettidi hara ooratha qaala medhdhiya wode waatha qaala geetettees (Mallas: shambba-haluwa, aaho-ooso, tukke-xaaro, para-haythe). -> 1. Compound Words (Waatha Qaala): Formed when two independent stems join (often hyphenated) to create a new lexical unit with specialized meaning. | 2. Singular (Pexo) vs. Plural (Masara) Nouns: Singular nouns denote a single entity, while plural nouns attach the plural suffix -ta (ACC) / -ti (NOM) (e.g., kafo 'bird' -> kafota 'birds').

Literal / Denotative Meaning (Zodo Birshshethi, p. 84): Giving the direct dictionary definition of a lexical item. | 2. Active to Passive Voice Transformation (Os-meqo -> Ost-meqo with -ett-, pp. 85–87): Mallas: 1. Shaashshota asho masu -> Ashoy metettis. 2. Lafaama soollo uukkasu -> Soolloy uukettis. 3. Shalula Woytetasu (Diraama Xuufe: Koyro Beso & Beso Nam77a) (Shalula Was Awarded (Two-Scene School Drama on Girls' Education and Diligence)): Shemppo 10: Diraama Shemppo 10 : Diraama
135
Tamaare Maxaafe
kunthidi sa7a qamisenna yaana gishe qaala gelidi soopeke7is.
Gurzza: Aaway soo simenna qammappe oyddu sa7ate gidida gisho pa aawa koyana 
gishe aayera zorettidi koshsha doommis. Daro ushsha keethan aawaa koyis.Gido 
shin demmanaas dandda7ibenna. Wursethan, aaway ushshan mathottidi soo bishin 
oge bolla kaamey dom77idi qeri yeggis. Aaway kundidayssa gurzzi xeellidi dagama 
dozhgi gis.
Mle. Balmoona : I na7a gurzzi aawaa koyanaw ke7idi gami7da gisho silke pa 
na7aasshocasu. I na7a Gurzzika pa aaway kaamen dom7ettin haakime keethaefidi 
hanin aawa bolla gakkida qohay daro gidida gisho aaway ha alameppe xeesetti -
dayssa pa aayes odis. Hessa wode keetha asay ubbay shiiqidi waasonne yeeho 
doomidosona.
Meeze 1
Qommon qonccida diraama xuufe baaso udidi kaalli de7iya oyshota zaarite
a. Dn. shuguxey diraama giddon odettida haasaya ne kahan oykkada qaalan ne 
cuga yaratas taarikiya oda.
b. Mle. Balmoona diraama giddon odettida haasaya ne kahan oykkada qaalan ne 
cuga yaratas taarikiya oda. 
c. Gurzzi diraama giddon odettida haasaya ne kahan oykkada qaalan ne cuga 
yaratas taarikiya oda. 
Nabbaboppe Sinthe
Barkketho Oysha
Kaalli de7iya oyshota entew de7iya kase era go7ettidi zaarite.
a. Diraama guussi ay guusse?
b. Diraami qantha medh-darisoppe aybin dummati ?
c. Diraama xuufe yarati oonantee ?
 10.3. Shaaho Heedza: Nabbabo Hiilla
 Shalula Woytetasu (Diraama xuufe)

Shemppo 10: Diraama Shemppo 10 : Diraama
136
8tho kifile Goofatho Doona
 (Koyro beso)
Kustti koyro detha timirtte keethan 2010 M.L giddon shemppos issi tamma gidiya 
tamaareti Shalulonne I laggeta Aynatonne Ashanqqo gujjidi issi mitha kuyaa 
gaathan uttidi nashishin beetoosona. Ha nayta gaathappe guuthi haakkada Shalula 
pa dawtariya kessada nabbabishin I achi I laggeti Ayanttiranne ashanqqira bidi 
matan de7iya shucha bolla uttidi Shalulo haasayisoosona.
Ashanqqo: Shalule ha7i shemppo wode bay ha7ika ne mangena dawtariya 
nabbabaasaka. Udupuntho kifile ne attin dawtarey awun de7iyaakoshiretti xeelena 
nuukka aadhana gashe Shalulo qeexen ayko erennaboozi kessada qeexen xeelashe 
matan eqqasu.
Aynato: Ashanqqa tuma gasu. Nena aybi anjji oykkidi yeemoyaakko ta erikke. 
Ane shemppa ekka! nayti haniya mela hana. Nena walloya ufayssa…Dawtariyaara 
hayqqana gooppa. 
Shalulo:Ta micheto! taani Inte giya mela ufayssi, walotethi , kaassenne miiche 
erenna tamaare gidikkke. Ubaasika wodey de7ees. Ha7i taani ta wodiya go7ettada 
xann7aanaw koyayss. Entte gida mela xeetappe 50 ehidi aadho dandda7etees. Taw 
heyssi oykkanaw bessiyaa era oykkenna aadhethaa aadhethi gidenashin yeda kifile 
paydo. Hayssas wursethay kundethi.Tana qofisey aadhdhethinne kundethi gidennan 
nu kifilen de7iya attuma tamaareti macca tamaareti timirtten booza giya akeekanne 
xeeluwa laamada nu kifilen de7iya 60 tamaaretappe koyro detha ke7ada woyte -
tanayssa. Hayssa gisho, nabbabana woden nabbabenna aggada miiccana woden 
yeekanaw koyikke.
Ashanqqo: Ehe…he …he …ee gada arashad inddiya pana attuma tamaaretaragee -
darawusika. Aadhethi guuxxis gada kifile de7iya attuma tamaaretara geedarettada 
detha demanaas koyaasaka. 
Aynato:Taani ne mela maccasi be7abike waayo gin coo waayasa. Malara ageeni 
azaasa timirttey nees hanenna ixxeeko pana gida dure gelada de7anaasdandda7aasa. 
Aybis dawutare bolla gunddada nena qohay.
Shalulo:Ta michcheto ta mala geyssi cala arasatethi, siidhe eqatethi, binaana adussa-
tethi xeessa lee7otethi gidenna. Taas mala lo77otethi gaatha mala hayssatikkaa 
asatethi, lo77o era goda gido, de7iya eran deretetha minotethanmaade gidiya gisho

137
Tamaare Maxaafe
hintte giya cala mali tana kochenna. Taani ta malan zemppada, ta timirtte qanxxada 
dure gela aqanaas koyikke. Soyzoy timirteppe guye pa woden gakkiya gisho soyzos 
qoppike ta qoppey ta timirtes kanche.
Nabbabiya wode 
Kaalli de7iya oyshota nabbabishe zaarite.
a. ______, _____, _____,______nne________diraama odaawata.
b. Diraamay polettida beswodey_________________________
c. Diraama gaathan polettiya gaasonne muruuta qonccisa
(Beso Nam77a)
Usuppun ageenappe guye timirtte keethan wursetha Cooce ageenan yelaasata baale 
bonchanaas yelaasati, boncho imathatinne timirtte keetha tamaareti shiiqida aqon 
timirtte keetha kaapoy Dn. Giximey laytha gaathan oosettida ooso riportte shiishi -
dappe guye laytha giddon lo77o muruuta demmida tamaareta woytanaas timirtte 
keetha kaapoynne worada timirtte xifate keetha kaapoy Dn.Idirey haasayanne woyto 
immana mela madiraken ke7is. Tamaare Aynatanne tamaare Ashanqqa timirttiyan 
udupuntho kifile aathanaas dandda7isiya muruuta dhayida gisho kaayon kumidi 
haniyaaba xeellanaas madirakeppe haaki uttidi hanota kaaloosona.
Dn. Gixime : Boncho Dn. Iraasha Idire, Dembba Goofa worada bertte ays 
kaappo,Boncho Gasaqo Gabbaara worada timirtte xifate keetha bertte kaapo,baaliya 
bonchanaas yida tamaare yelaasati nne boncho tamaareto maccatethi : minotethi, 
cincatethinne goobatethi gideyssa ooson bessida Shubaasha Shalulo ta entew 
qonccisishin keehippe gita ufayssay taw si7etees. Shalulo de7uwa alamen pholqqiya 
aleeqoti cimmenna, dabboy laggey zoriya lo77o aziya geella zores kushe immonna 
nu timirtte keethan koyro kifileppe hospuntho kifile gaso de7iya 3000 tamaare -
tappe 99 giddole muruuta demmada koyro detha ke7ida daro ufayetas. Tamaare 
Shubaashe Shalulis giigida woytuwa imana mala Dembba Goofa worada ayso bertte 
kaappo Iraasha Idire madrakiyako yaana mela bonchon shoobays.
Dn. Iraasha Idire : Tamaare Shubaashe Shaluli malalisiyaa muruuta baggara 
hashettida kustti koyro detha timirtte keetha kaapo Dn.Kuussa Gino, dembba 
goofa worada timirtte xifate keetha kaapo Dn. Gina Giximenne matan kaallishe 
gam7ida Shubaasha shaluli astamaareta wozanappe galatanaas koyayis. Hayssappe

Shemppo 10: Diraama Shemppo 10 : Diraama
138
8tho kifile Goofatho Doona
guye tamaare Shubaasha Shalulis giigida woyto imidaape guye gujan Shubaasha 
shaluli kare gade bada tamaarana mela qaadi imettidayssa qonccisis.
Tamaare Shalulo:Imettida woytosinne timirtte qaadas galatada sinthapes macca 
nayta akeeka bollane xeeluwa bolla loythada oothanaas qaala gelasu.
Aynatonne Ashanqqe :Macca tamaareta bolla de7iya nu akeekalaafatethanne 
nu xeelo geellatetha nu ayfen xeellida. Macca tamaareti attuma tamaaretara gina 
gideyssa nu kadhida nu michchiya Shalame Shalula ayfen nuna besasu. Sinthapes 
nuuka Shubaasha Shalulo kaallidi loythidi nu timirttiya tamaarana. 
(Pulttoy Leera Sameela Medh Darso 2014M.L)
Diraama aybatetha nne Birshetha
Diraama guussay issi diraama xuufes giigida qofa giddon de7iya taarike odaawati 
de7uwa alamen shemppo zeridi qaaxxiya hanota kochidi polettiya madrake ooso.
Dumma dumma diraama qommoti de7oosona. Hayssatikka: Miiciso, Kaayiso, 
Kaayo-Miiciso nne h.h.h. Miicciso diraama qommoy wursethay ufasisoninne 
miiccison wuriya diraama qommo gidishin kaayiso diraama qommoy qassi 
wursethay kaayison wurees. Kaayo-Miiciso diraama qommoy qassi nam77u 
diraama qommota kanddo shiishi oykkees.
Diraami qantha medhi darsso mela pa gaathan dumma dumma yarata shiishi 
oykkees. Hessatika: Taarike, Gaasonne muruuta, Dom77e, ayfe qofa, odaawa, nne 
beswode gidishin issuwaas issuwaas de7iya birshetha kaalli de7iya mela qonccis.
Odaawa:issi diraama xuufe taarike giddo polettiyaa ooso gishoy de7iyaanne 
de7uwaalamen de7iya ase kochidi ase mela odetethaninne dumma dumma allalleta 
polon go7eyssata. Odaawati poliya allalleti nabbabanchatas gido xeeliya asatas 
kumethan qoncce.
Taarike: Issi diraama giddon haasayan gido odaawata ooson polettiya diraa -
maxuufe taarike. Taarike gaathan dumma dumma diraama yarati qoncces.odaawati 
beswodey,gaasonne muruuti issi diraama taarikegiddon qonccees.
Gaasonne Muruuta : Odaawati gaasonne muruuta kaallidi poliyaa ooso allalle.
Dom77e:Issi diraama giddon odaawati poliyaa ooso allalle giddon wolibolla 
woyko hayssa ooso oothoppo giya buzo qofan panttara dom7etoosona. ubba

Tamaare Maxaafe
diraaman dom7ey dhayenna. Dom77ey dhayaaba gidikko diraama taarike gidanaas 
dandda7enna yeda taarike gidees.
Beswode:Issi diraama xuufe giddon allalley awudde polettidaako polet-

Nabbaboppe guye wode
Kaalli de7iya oyshota nabbabidappe guye zaarite
4. Ha diraama xuufe ayfe qofay aybee ?
a. Ha diraama xuufe nabbabidappe guye ente akeeka bollanne ente xeeluwa bolla 
gathida lo77o naaqoy aybee.
b. Ha diraama ayfe qofa qaalan qonccisite.
Meeze 3
Qommon qonccida diraama xuufe nabbabidappe guye xuufiya kaallada ooson 
madrake bolla bessite. Kaalli de7iya oyshotas diraama xuufen baasettidi 
suure gidikko tuma suure gidonna ixxiko worddo gidi zaarite.
1. Shubaashe Shaluula kustti koyro detha timirtte keethan 2010 M.L. tamaariya 
tamaareta ubbape koyro detha demasu.
2. Shaluli laggeti timirttiyaan daro goobidi tamaarida gisho tamaaretappe lo77o 
detha ke7idi aadhidosona.
3. Ha diraama xuufen gaasoynne muruuti baawa.
4. Diraama ayfe qofay goobidi tamaarida tamaareti woyteteyssa qonccisees.
5. Diraama xuufe giddon dom77e giyaabi beetenna.
Meeze 4
Kaalli de7iya oyshotas qantha zaaro xuufen zaarite.
1. Diraama xuufe giddon taarikesinne gaasonne muruutas de7iya dummatethay 
aybee.
2. Diraama xuufe giddon dom77ey waani qonccanaw dandda7i
3. Diraama xuufe giddon gaasonne muruuta guussi ay guuseko qonccisa.
4. Diraama xuufe giddon taarikey gaasonne muruutappe aybin dummati?

GIIRA CIGO
Giira cigoy alame dethaba gididi koyro Gibxxen domettis. Giiroy dumma 
dumma kawotetha oosota sinthe efanaw koshshiya miisheta shammanaw, kawo 
oosanchchatappe, goshshanchatappe, zal77anchatappenne issi issi eqotatappe 
shiiqiya qaye bira demisha gididi baaso dichcha eqotata keelanaw /keexxanaw/ 
haggazota eesoyanawnne kothetetha dichcha tillayanaw maadiya miishe.
Giiri wogara cigettiyaaba gidikko issi gades baaso dichchata tillayanaw aykko 
hirggikka baawa. Giiranchati giira woderanne bantta abbiya qosonna ciggishin 
ogeta, geeshsha ushsha haathata, timirtte keethata, ifila eqotatanne goshsha ooso 
loohiso keethata keexidi go7ettana mela oothiyanne issi gade dichchaas zokko 
meqethi gididi maaddiyaaba.
Dumma dumma kawonne buzo eqotatan moodettidi deretethaas haggaaza immiya 
oosanchatas cawa gate cigganaas giiri pultto gididi maaddees. Hessa gishin, 
hargganchchati akimetappe, tamaareti asttamaaretappe, worandzanchchatan 
qohettida asati polisetappenne pirdda immiya asatappe,hessadankka hara haggaazata 
demmidayssas sitta gidonna ogera giirappe beettiya demishappe cigettees. 
Guussaykka deretethay wodera kawos giiriya giiray yuuyidi enttaw haggaaza 
immiya eranchchatas cigettees guussi. 
Issi deretetha giddon dumma dumma duussa dethan de7iya asati de7eyssi qoncce. 
Hessatikka: wolqqaama dureti, giddo shalaawatinne manqqoti issi gaden shiiqidi 
de7oosona. Ha heedzu detethata shiiqoti ubbay kawotetha eqotan issi gina haggazota 
haakki boonna matappe haggazota wallon demmanaw, pantta karen toggidi 
giddotiyasa gakkanawnne dhumappe xomppiyan allaxxanaw (wallotanaw) giira 
wodera cigoy gita bessa oykees.
 Kumethan nu xeelliya wode giiri woderanne wogara cigetethay ubbaas kothe go7a 
immeyssa eridi kawotethay oychiya giira wodera cigoy issi gade dichchaas malaata 
gidiya gisho mor7ethi bayinna cigganaw bessees. Gujankka, giira cigoy issi gade 
dichchaas zokko meqethi gideyssa nu eridi harataskka erisanaw koshshees.

16
9tho kifile Goofatho Doona
 3.3. Nabbabo
MINIRAALE BOOHO
Miniraaley biita garssaninne haatha zedhen beettiya madheta shalo. Miniraaleti biita 
giddoppenne haatha giddoppe dumma dumma ogen bookettidi ke7iya, qommon 
shaahettiya, issi gades ikkonoomenne issi petetetha dichchaas go7iyanne ishalsso 
koshshiya al77o medheta shalo.
Miniraale qommoti daro gidishin entta kanddonne medhuwan zemppidi nam77u gita 
cugatan shaakkanaw danada7ettees. Hessatikka minniyanne gukkiya miniraaleta 
gidishhin minniya miniraaleti worqa, bira, xarqqamala, biraata, shuchcha kasale, 
naase, maxinenne h.h.m. Gidishin gukkiya miniraaleti haathe, lambba, kaame, 
zaytenne hayssa mela teknoloojeninne asa wolqqa boohon beettiya miiniraaleta.
Miniraaleta beetoynne boohetethay issi gade ikkonomenne issipetetha dichaas 
gita go7a immees. Issi heeran mineraale boohoynne muuruutisoy doomettishin 
paapirkanne industtiretan gelissidi dumma dumma miishetan laamon gade giddonne 
kare gades bayzidi demisha dichchanaw maadees. Hara baggara qassi miniraale 
boohoy issipetetha dichchaas dhoqqa go7a immees. Hayssa gishin miniraaleti 
beettida heeran paapirkkatinne industtereti eqqishin he heera deretethay he eqotatan 
moodettidi eranne wolqqa oosota oothidi pantta duussa laammoosona.
Biitti pa giddon miniraale haphonna heeri baawa. Ha biitti kammi oykkida 
miniraaleta heeray di7on woocettonna mela mitha tokethan keela keeloninne di7ota 
teqethan wuda wothidi aawatethan naago koshees. Aybis giikko ha medheta shaloti 
kessi ekkiko zaari demo qaaday keehidi xunthi gidiya gishossa.
Kumethan miniraaley biittinne haathi pa giddon haphphi oykkida medheta shalo 
gididi miniyanne gukkiya sabisttansse. He shaloti teknoloojeninne asa wolqqan biitta 
giddoppe beettiyaba gidishin issi gade ikkonoome dichchaas gita sohoy de7iyanne 
dhoqa naagoy koshshiya medheta imota.
IV . Kaalliya Oyshata Nibaabiya Zemppidi Zaarite.
1. Miniraale gishin ay guusee ?
2. Miniraaleti awuppe beetoonaa ?
3. Miniraale qoomoti aappunan shaahetoonaa?
4. Miniraaleta waati ishalsanee ?

shemppota ayssana wolqqay de7ees. Ha dondzatethaan demmida pa na7aa wontta 
ooso bessi baanaw zaari zaari xeellidi yeeri ekkidi pa shinqqe toora xeeran sottidi

Gidoshin, Daroti yelettoodeppe ichchashu laytha gaso ifili dhayidi hargge machcho 
gidis. Gaasoykka, yelettin heedzantho ageenara misha harggey, usuppuntho 
ageenara sheenoy, qassi laythaa wurssethan puuso harggey bollan ke7in daaburidi

layti uttis. Darota geetetti sunthettidaykka harggey darida gishossa.

yuushi xeellishe hayqoppe qosettiyaa soo koyiyaada hanees. Mishiree Keehanna 
“Hay godaw … Ta new ay iissadinnaa?” gashe pa danccuwa haa mintha qachchada

Ginxxo Aybatetha, Ginxxo Yarata & 'Duuqqopa' (Ginxxo: G. Yirdaw nne G. Isiyaas) (Poetics and the 8-Stanza Didactic Poem 'Duuqqopa' ('Do Not Cheat/Plagiarize' by G. Yirdaw & G. Isiyaas)): Shemppo 6:Ginxxo
47
Tamaare Maxaafe
 6. gINxxO
SHEMPPO uSuPPuNA
Qoppobata: Tamaareti ha shemppuwa wurssethan:
 " Ginxxo aybatetha hayzidi qaalan shiishana.
 " Dumma dumma odota ginxxo giddoppe shaakkana.
 " Odota ginxxo xaafishe go7ettana.
 " Ginxxon qaala go7etethara meezetana.
Denthetho Oyshota
1. Ginxxoy aybee ?
2. Ginxxoy hara bila xuufetappe aybin dummatii ?
3. Ginxxo yarata ereetii ?
4. Issi ginxxanchcha gooba ginxxanchcho udiya bata qonccisite.
Ginxxo Aybatetha
Ginxxoy qorettida qaalan dalgga qofi qanthara mal77o hanotan shiiqiya bila xuufe.
Ginxxoy eedoy de7iya, asa kaha denthethosinne kaha wutetha gita wolqqi de7iya 
hiilla ooso. Ginxxoy beni xuufey doomettonna woden saban qanthara shiiqishe 
gam77is. Hessappe denddidayssan ginxxoy ceega bila xuufe; medhoykka qanthinne 
siqimettidaba.
Daro eranchchati odiya mela ginxxoy qanthan shiiqana mela oothida gaasoti zaari 
qofos injjetana melanne qaalan oykkanaw waayisonna melassa. Nu eriya mela 
xuufen gidin haasayan usa adussenne zhordumordda gidida allalley hayzanchatas 
kaha wuttenna, hayzanawkka suukeyenna.
Ginxxoy adarssanchcha kahappe eeson pulttees. Gujankka gaanaw qoppidabaa 
ellesishe gidi poli aggeesippe attin odaa adussishenne goochishe peto pee7enna. 
″Odi darin haren caanettenna″ giya qofa mela ginxxon hayzanchchi iishana gaso 
gooshechiyabay baawa.

Shemppo 6: Ginxxo Shemppo 6:Ginxxo
48
9tho kifile Goofatho Doona
Issi lo77o ginxxoy shiiqiya dethan ginxxuwa mal7uuwappe denddidayssan 
hayzanchati pantta haytha yeggidi ayfiya qiphonnanne uttida bessappe qaaxxonna 
de7iya bessa doganaa gaso wuda wothidi kaallosona.
Ginxxoy daro wode shiiqey dethan gidin dumma didirxxata gaaso udidi yethan, 
zelelssan, ceeqon, sabaninne h.h.m hanotatan dumma dumma qoppobata cuucummidi 
aadhdhees.
Ginxxo Yarata
Ginxxos dumma dumma yarati de7oosona. Hessatikka:
A. Keso
B. Tura
C. Zira
D. Kure
E. Mixenne shoche
F. Eedo
G. Polo
H. Dinxxo 
A. Keso: Ginxxo yafaran uttida qaalatas issi shemppon xeesettiya koosheta 
bessiya qofa. Daro wode kesota usttata baaso udidi shaakkoos.
Malla: Kareetha malaa, kenchecha teemaa,
Ha issi yafara ginxxuwaan kesoy yaani uttees:
/ka – ree – tha/ /ma – laa/ /ken - che – cha/ /tee - maa/
B. Tura: Turi ginxxos issi yafaras (ziras) bagga.
Malla: kareetha malaa kenchecha teema
Kareetha mala = koyro tura
Kenchecha teema = nam77antho tura
C. Zira: Ziri ginxxos issi yafara.
Malla: Kareetha malaa kenchecha teema,
Ha qofay ginxxos issi zira gaanaw danda7ettees.
D. Kure: Kurey zirata shiiqo gididi pa giddon issi ayfe qofa oykkiya ginxxos 
mentho gaanaw danda7oos.
Malla: Timirttiyaan minnidi salora paallanaa,
Piilggi xanna7idi shaakkidi pinnanaa,
Oychidi qiicana dhoqqa soo gakkanaa.

Shemppo 6:Ginxxo
49
Tamaare Maxaafe
Ha qommon shiiqida ginxxo yafarati issi ayfe qofa tookkida issi kure gaanaw 
dandda7ettees.
E. Mixenne Eedo: Mixe gishin issi ginxxo turan woy ziran de7iya kesota 
paydoy gina gideyssa tillayetha oge. Eedoy qassi zirata wurssethan beettiya 
qaalata woy koosheta gaason nabbabishin si7ettiya yethaada haniya mal77o 
kooshe.
Malla: Timirttiyan minnidi salora paallanaa
/Ti-mirt-tiyan min-ni-di/ /sa-lo-ra paal-la-na/
Ha ginxxo yafaraa mixiya xeellishin 6/6 keson mixettees.
F. Polo: Ginxxo ziratas wurssethan beettiya misatiya koosheta woy pidaleta 
guussi.
G. Dinxxon: Issi kuren shiiqiya zirati pantta sima qofa issi mela pidalen woy 
kooshen polishin dinxxo geetettees.
Meeze Isso
 6.1. Hayzo
I. Haysappe Garssan Shiiqida Ginxxuwa Hintte Asttamaarey Nabbabishin 
Akeekishe Wogayi Hayzidi Kaalli Shiiqida Meezeta Oothite.
Duuqqopa
Xana77appe attin asaba duuqqopa,
Asaba wuttada wontto yeellatoppa,
 Shaakkonna sal77ada coobaas xoonettoppa,
 Nenan ammanetta haratan katoppa.
 Xinaatiyaan beettida eray geeddarettees,
 Awanikka gidin poloy sinthe keyees,
 Cawatti demmiday eggetonna kanthees,
 Duuqqidi shishiday issoode yeellatees.
 Duuqon ammanetee tamaarey erettees,
 Kifilen uttidi kare kare xeellees,

Shemppo 6: Ginxxo Shemppo 6:Ginxxo
50
9tho kifile Goofatho Doona
 Tamaaranaw yishe wodiya aathi gakkees,
 Paacey mati kichin duuqos sinthe meeccees.
 Duuqoy haddirikko yeggidi soo simmees,
 Minnidi goyenna bone awas babbes,
 Balggoy yaade qassi ira deshos hirggees,
 Wonttos halchonnashin nayta zata yelees,
 Nayti kathi oychin huuphe qaachi darees.
Duuqqidi gakkida akimey haggazin,
Bollara boshechees ulo giddon sakkin,
Giddon ooliso baas huuphe dhale immin,
Harggisidi zaarees pashkkatetha koyin.
Xinaatiyan gakkida akimey erettees,
 Mata soon haaho soon iya oosoy nashettees,
Sunthay ubba bessan xeegishin teematees,
Narppe caddin aggin zoren pathi yeddees,
 Haggaazaan palahi kawonkka woytettees.
Duuqqi anjjetiday aawatees sunthetees,
Tuma pirdda aggi pakko paakko dafees,
Ammanuwa dabbota hara ayfen xeellees,
Pa ulo kunthidaa woozanappe dosees,
Woganaw uttiti hara meto medheees.
Minni xana7iday araata demmanaa,
Ayso soo gakkikko ubbata allanaa,
Wobbaato billidi wogidi kanthana,
Oothikko odikko wuri amin77anaa
Haggaazaan alidi anjjishe simmanaa.
 (Ginxxo: G.Yirdaw nne G. Isiyaas)

gado hargge gidishin he harggey asappe asan aadhdhiya, hargganchata bolla bessiya 
malaati de7iya, asa bolla gita qohata gathiya, issi issi asatan bala xeeloti imettiyaanne 
teqqanaw dandda7ettiya hargge.
Koroona vayrese harggey asappe asakko eeson aadhdhiya ogeti de7osona. He 
aadhetha ogetappe hargganchchappe qufishin, hadhdhishishin woy shemppishin 
keyiya peenuwa gaason, hargganchchappe keyiya laakkiyaaba bochida kushiya 
boshoninne qoomettidi saroson, hargganchchata miishata kothen go7etethan 
aadhees. Gujjanakka, harganchati dumma dumma bessatan bochchidi woy go7ettidi 
aadhdhida miisheta eeson bochchishininne assay dariya bessatan walakettidi allalleta 
polishin ha harggey hargganchchappe paxa asakko dharccettees.

9tho kifile Goofatho Doona
Koroona vayrese harggey oykkida asa bolla daro malaatati beettoosona. Ha 
malaatatappe bertteta be7ishin, ha harggey oykkida asa bolla gita qoxonne misha, 
shemppanaw un77etho, mela zode qufenne qoodhe giddo saho malaatati beettoosona. 
Qassikka he harggey minni minni bishe goofina bochchidi kilahoy oothonna mela 
udiya hargge.
KOVIDE-19 koroona vayrese harggey alame dethan asa na7a shemppo, 
ikkonoomenne issipetetha duussa bolla gita qoha gathida hargge. Ha harggey asa 
na7a shemppo bolla qoha gathis gishin, harggiya teqqanaw butetiya akimetanne 
dokttooreta shemppo mis, wontto gades maaddana yalaga nayta wodhis, zoridi 
zaariya donzata shemppokka dhayssis. Hessa kanchche gidonnashin asa kochche 
qorenna. Oykkikko ubba harggisees nne wodhanaw dandda7ees. Ikkonoome 
baggara qassi turuuzumeppe,zal7eppe, tiranispportteppenne hara eqotatappe kawos 
gidin buzo asas beettiya demisha guuthees. Aadhdhidikka eqotatatan moodettidi 
oothiya kawonne buzo oosanchchata duussas dhube gidees. Hara baggara qassi ha 
harggey issipetetha asa duusa bolla gita naaqo gathees. Hessa gishin, asay issippe 
hashetiya oosota dhuubbees; asay wolira oothiya gahetetha giddon so7atethinne 
hirgga medhdhees.
Koroona vayrese harggey asa shemppo miya hargge gidikkonne dumma dumma 
asati ha harggiya bolla bala qofanne xeelo bessishe de7oosona. Ha bala xeelotappe 
koyroy ha vayrese harggiyaappe naagetetha kiitay allaley xelliya gishadetappe 
imettishin leqethidi xeelo. Haray qassi ha hargey baawanne wodhenna gidi 
qoppeyssa. Gujjankka ha harggiya teqetha ogeta si7idi naagetetha bolla ashirtto 
nne kiita polonna ixoy dumma dumma asata bolla beettiya bala xeelota gaanaw 
danadda7ettees. Gidoshin hayssa mela xeeloy de7iyaa asay ha bala xeeluwaappe 
simmanaw koshshees.
Ha gado harggey dharccettonna mela naagetetha ogeti de7oosona. Hessatikka asay 
dariya bessata keyishe doona gultte woso, qufishe woy hadhdhishishe pa surkkiyan 
geshechchi, asappe haahotetha naago, kushe saamunan meechche, kushe geeshshiya 
keemikaale (sanitayzere) go7etethaninne haraara qoomettidi woy kushe immidi 
saroso agon asi pana ha harggiyappe naaganaw dandda7ettees. Gujjankka daro 
asati shiiqiya bessa boonna agon; hargganchchatara miisheta koxxonna agon ha iita 
harggiyaappe naagettanawnne dharccetetha teqqanaw dandda7ettees.

Goofatho Doona Xaafo Hiillatanne Pidaleta Qaala Giddon Wogara Xaafo Maara (6 Core Orthographic Rules & Zara 5 CV Table, pp. 63–65): Ustta = U (vowel), Guttuma = G (consonant). Rules: (1) Two different vowels (usttati) never cluster at word onset; (2) Consonants (guttumati) never geminate at word onset (*GGUG is illegal); (3) When two different vowels meet word-medially, glottal stop '7' (gilootaley) is inserted (e.g., sa7a, na7a, ma7o); (4) Doubled consonants medial-internally are pronounced geminated (minni nabbabettoosona); (5) Doubled vowels are pronounced long (aduqqi nabbabettoosona); (6) Digraph consonants (waatha guttumati: ch, dh, dz, ny, ph, sh, th, zh) represent a single phoneme. Zara 5 patterns: U (i, ee), GU (ba, ta, ne), GUGU (mata, kathi, qofa), GUGUGGU (timirtte, atarqqa), UGGUGUGU (asttamaare), GUGUU (nam77a, gam77a). -> 1. Six Fundamental Gofatho Orthographic & Phonotactic Rules (Zara 5, pp. 63–65): Formalizes CV syllable templates (Ustta 'U' = Vowel, Guttuma 'G' = Consonant), bans initial consonant clusters/geminates (*GGUG) and initial vowel hiatus (*UUGU), mandates glottal stop '7' between medial vowels (sa7a, na7a, ma7o), and defines consonant gemination and vowel length. | 2. Dhanthetetha & Sigetho/Gasetho Suffixation (pp. 66–68): Attaching bound case/postpositional suffixes (-ppe, -ra, -n, -s, -tethi, -ncha) directly to stems (Malla: Sawlappe, goshshanchcha, medheta = medho). -> 2. Bound Derivational and Inflectional Suffixation (pp. 66–68): Attaching case and agentive suffixes (-ppe, -ra, -n, -ncha) to nominal and verbal stems.

 8.1. Diraama Aybatetha
Diraama giya qaalay ″Giriike″ qaala gidishin birshshethaykka ″ooson beso″ woykko 
″qaaxo″ guussi. Diraama kaassi issi hanida taarike ooson beso hiilla. Hayssa gishin 
issi taarikiyaas besoden didirxxa bessidi duussaba akeekisiya bila ooso.
Diraami iskkiripitten giigidi diraama oothiya asan haasayoninne qaaxon poletteesippe 
attin nabbabos shiiqiyaaba gidenna.
Diraami haasayaranne qaaxora dethan shiiqidi asa na7a duussaba qonccisees. Issi 
diraama ooso bolla peeshanaw daro eranchchata hashetethan polettees hayssa gisho 
diraami cuga ooso geettetees.

Pola: Ne ginxxuwan ″Timirttey al77obaa″ gishin ay gaanaw koyadii timirttes 
gatey de7ii ? washettii?
Worqqa: Ero. Timirttes woyko eras gatey hessa gaanaw dandda7okko. Ays giikko 
biranne worqqa pilggidi demmey, medhdhey era gidiya gishossa. 
Ciisha: Ne tuma odadii aggadii! Asi haaridi shalo shiishidikka wurssethan ″Ta 
tamaaridaakko″ guussay attenna.
Worqqa: Ee nuuni qassi nu na7atethan timirtte qaada demmida ″Wonttara maxida 
kuttiw argganthi dentahenna. ″ gees. Na7atethan tamaaro koshshees. 
Aybikka nuna dhubbidi guye zaaranaw bessenna.
Pola: Hizappe taanikka guye qoppike. Ta ishaa yaatin woygada zoroo ?
Ciisha: Kaysoy demmonna, danoy bochenna merinaa shaluwa timirtte eraa shiisha. 
Yaagada zora eroo.
Worqqa: Nu odan baletti attin sa7aykka omarssis. Kaassa denthida Poli wurssetha

textbook_chapters_28_deep.dialogues_summary: Full Classroom Drama Dialogue between Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha (pp. 72–75): Pola asks whether education (timirtte) or wealth (shalo) is greater. Worqqa and Ciisha prove that even clean piped water at school to wash hands against COVID-19 and discovering gold/silver come from education, and Worqqa recites the poem 'Timirttey al77obaa / Azallin beettenna...'. Ciisha concludes: 'Kaysoy demmonna, danoy bochenna merinaa shaluwa timirtte eraa shiisha.' (Three-Character Drama Dialogue (Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha, pp. 72–75): Debating whether education or material wealth is superior, incorporating COVID-19 handwashing awareness and an embedded 9-line poem praising education.)

Miidiyanne Gahetetha (Media and Communication: Print, Broadcast, and Digital Media as a Bridge Between Government and Society): Shemppo 9: MIIDIYANNE GAHETETHA
73
Tamaare Maxaafe
Meeze Isso
 9.1. Hayzo
I. Tamaareto Hintte Miidiyanne Gahetethaba Eranaw Koyiya Heedzu Oyshata 
Hintte Dawtaren Xaafite.
II. Hessappe Garssan Shiiqida Kaaratan Hintte Asttamaarey Shoobbida Imatha 
Haasaya Akeekkan Hayzidi Demmida Ayfe Qofata Hintte Kifile Tamaaretas 
Zaari Odite.
1. Paranje miiza haaro gade miiza haarora geeddarite.(awussi muruutan aadhii?)
2. Goofa masqqala baale bonchcho maara.
3. Beni kawotabaanne ha77i kawotabaa gathi geeddaron qonccisethi.
III. Kaallidi Miidiyanne Gahetetha Aybatetha Yuushon Shiiqida Nibaabiya 
Asttamaarey Nabbabishin Wudayi Hayzite.
Miidiyanne Gahetetha
Miidiya guussay daro asa giddoyiyaanne markkanddo issi detha akeekan 
demmanaada maaddiyaba. Gahetethi qassi daro asay issoy haraara qofanine 
markkando laameretetha hanota qonccisees. Hessadanikka miidiyanne gahetetha 
giya wode issi eqota gididi deretethaas matatethan haggaziya, pana dandda7ida 
eqotati de7iyaanne deretethappe deretethaas haggaazo immiya eqota.
Miidiyanne gahetethaba nu denthiya wode nu kahan yaanaw bessiyabay, 
ooraxxiya markkanddoy, lo77i ekkiya nashshoy, ufayssiya kabexa denthethi erisoti 
qofettoosona. Hessadanikka naagetethabati ge7etethabatinne kawotetha derethetha 
issippetethabati ubbakka sintha xeera oykkoosona. Ha hanotati deriya hachi alamey 
waani aqidaakko si7anaw naagiya asaas ho77o markkanaddota wodera hayzanaw 
koyiya haythatakkonne xeellanaw koyiya ayfetakko gathana mela moodettida eqota. 
Hayssa kanchche gidonashin eqota oosanchchati odaas gidin giigisuwas pulttoy 
de7iya bessaa gakkidi tumanne tuma (qoncce) gidida paatethi de7iyaabata shiishiya 
eqota.
Miidiya gishin daro asa giddotethaan markkanddo gathiya eqota gidikkoka pa giddon 
dumma dumma daashshata shiishidi oykees. Hessatikka satalayiten gakkiya, T.V , 
carkko zeebulisan gakkiya Iradoone, Intterneeten oothiya Fees-buukenne xaafon

74
9tho kifile Goofatho Doona
gahettiya, maxaafe, mexeete, gaazexati kooshen gasethiya yethati woga kaassatinne 
poototi panttana dandda7ida miidiya qommota geetetoosona.
Hayssappe qommon paatettida miidiya eqotati asa nayta duussa bessaadaninne entta 
timirtte dethadan akeekisanaw doorotho shiiqidosona. Hessa gishin gaxare asaasinne 
xomppey gakkonna heeratas FM iradooneta, yalagatas qassi fes-buuketa nne katama 
heeratas T.V (Televizhine) go7etethay gahetethas gita injjetiyatho qofettees.
Miidiya pana dandda7ida eqota gidikoka qoppobay deriyaas lo77iyaaba zaaridi deriya 
giddo dharcciyaba. Ha eqotay paape demmiya markkanddoy baawa. De7ikkoka 
worddoppe attin deretethan ekettiyaaba gidenna. Hessa kanchche gidonnashin 
giddo oosanchchatanne zoranchchatakka deretethaa giddoppe demmees. Hayssa 
gisho haggazoy deriyaappe deriyaas gidishin, lo77iyaabata, nashettiyaabata, lo7o 
ooso polota, woga kaassata, woga yethata, deriya gakkida metotanne maadetethaa, 
hessadanikka metotappe pinnida ogetanne kawotethaa kiitata zaaridi kawotethasinne 
deretethaas xoliqqisiya eqotappe attin pa buzo qofa qonccisiya eqota gidenna.
Kuyishin, miidiya giya wode kawotethasinne deretethaas giddon de7iya dhoqqa 
zooze mela xeelettiyaba gaanaw danda7oos. Doqqa zoozey nam77u soo kooshe 
sissiya mela miidiyakka kawotethasinne dere asaas giddon de7iya eqotappe attin 
tawu buzo giya kawotethi gidin deretethi de7anaw bessenna. Ha eqotaas qoppobay 
xaafon gidin beson woy sison be7onnabaa bessanaw, si7onnabata sissanaw 
gakkonnabata haratas shaakanaw lo77o wogata erisanaw, walloyananne ha77i 
wodetethi de7iya kiitata bessanaw oothiya eqota.
Meeze Nam77a
 9.2. Haasayo
IV . Hessappe Garssan Imettida Allalliya Bolla Cugan Gididi Eriso Misilera Loythi 
Giigisidi Shiishite.
1. Issi woga ma7o sikkiyaa keetha eriso.
2. Timirtte keetha dooyetethaanne doometha eriso.
3. Maxaafe bayziya keethanne imettiya haggaazo.
Hessappe qommon imettida kaara bolla cuga yarati shiishe wode akeekan hazidi 
bornasho immite.

Dooni asa na7i ubbay paas de7yaa heera ubban de7iyaa issoy issuwaara qofa, 
metuwaa, qiiruwaa, amuwaanne h.h.melata qonccisanaw go7ettiya gita miishe. 
Hessika go7etethaa, keethaawatethaara xeelliya wode sa7a bolla de7iya medoosa 
ubbatappe asa na7a kanchey go7ettiya dumma miishe guussi. Doona aybatethha 
bolla dumma dumma eranchati immida qofata xeellishin Baye Ymaamey “Dooni 
asi pa qofa wothiya oge gidishin ikka mega qofan qonccisiyaaba” I gujjidika 
“Dooni meega qofata shiiqo” gis. Hara eranchaa Admaasu Yoonnasa geetettetssi 
qassi “Dooni coo medettida qaalata shiiqo gidishin ha shiiqida qaalati he doonan 
haasa7iya dere asay akeekiya ogen kiitaa aathiya oge” gis. (12tho kifile Goofa doona 
tamaare maxaafe 2009M.L) 
Dooni asa na7as immiya go7aa hayssa mala gidi odidi wurssanaas dandda7ettennabaa 
gidikkoka kase wodeppe hachi gaso go7etetha ogey dalggishe yidayssi erettiyaaba. 
Hessika, kase wode daro laythape sinthe bayrati taariketa gidin bila odata doonara 
kaalliya yeletatas panttas go7ettiya doonaara aathishe gam7idosona. Doonay ay 
wodekka asa na7as immiyaa kothe gidida go77atappe uugati asi pa qofaa haratas 
kumethan qoncisanaas, taariketa yeletaas aathanaas, wogaa erisanaas, bila odata 
aathanaas, dumma dumma taariketa xaafi wothanaas, pilgetha oosota oothanaas, 
kare gadetara dumma dumma gade oosotas gahettanaas, timirtte tamarssanaasinne 
h.h.m go7iyaa gita miishe. Heessa mela ha7i hiloohay diccida wodiyaan dooni 
immiya go7ay ubbarakka haa guzhettis giikko borissenna. Gaasoykka Alame dethan 
asa na7i medhida carkkora kiita aathiya miishetan mallas: peesibuke, intterneete, 
telebizhine, yutuubenne h.h.m xeeloninne hayzon go7ettidi aadhiya qofata birshethi 
imon alame yuushon hachi haniyaabaa ubba kaalli be7oninne sissan ellesi qofa 
shaaketteyka doonara gidees.
Gujidikka dooni asa na7as ha doona go7aa kumethan demmonna deretethaa 
giddon asaa haasayaa si7onna issi issi asati woy hayzo metoy de7iyaa nayti

4

deriya giddon de7anaw dandda7iya isho hemetoy de7iyaa asati hara asatara qofaa

ay ogera panttasoo asaara woy laggetara waati qofaa laamerettiyaako akeekon

usha bessan, shankka bessaninne h.h.m bessatan meezetishin diccishe yeletape

Haray qassi doonas deretethaa gahetethaara de7iyaa issipetetha baggara xeellishin 
asay panttas de7iyaa heeran dalgga dere asay lo7o wode gidin iita wodiyaan

Asa na7i shempora de7iyaa medosatappe issuwa. Shemppoy de7iabata kanddotappe 
issoy qassi yeletethi. Asa na7i shempora de7idi susasy duuxxonna melanne kochay 
dhayonna mela beni sisa wodeppe oykkidi ekkishenne gelishe yelishe ha7i gaso 
biitta bolla daridi de7is. Gidishin, eko gelo wogay heerappe heeran dummatiyaaba 
gidishin bini wode Goofa heeraa eko gelo wogaa kaalliya daassatan xeellana.
Beni wode ichashu gidiya eko gelo wogati de7oosona. Hessatikka sinthara gelo, 
guyera gelo, dafa, githenne utetha gelo geetettoosona.
Koyroy sinthara gelo gidishin, eko gelos gakkida pantha na7ay daro dosida na7ees 
aawa aayi baggara heedzu cima soo yeddees. Hessika, na7aasinne na7ees kochan 
ixoy woy dabbotethi baynnabaa gidikko kanche. He cimatika ero gaana gaso zaari 
zaaridi oychoosona, giigisoosona. Ha oysho wogaa sintha kushe ekkidi polos gathey 
aawaanne aayiw.
Nam7anthoy guyera gelo gidishin hessika, aawi aayiya eronna woy si7onna na7aara 
na7eera wolira siiqettidaappe labi zaarana mela laazanthi yeddoosona. He laazanthay, 
yaaganoninne dumma dumma bessatan shoobbees. Hessika na7ee dabbota maadon 
giyan na7iw dabbotara ushoninne nashon na7aas ero udoosona. Hessape guyen eko 
gelo polees.
Heedzanthoy qaassi dafi eko gidishin, na7ay daro siiqida na7iya sinthara gidin guyera 
oychin ixxidabaa gidikko na7ay pa laggetara pana giigisidi dafos oge aadhdhees. 
Hessika haney, giya ogen, yeeho ogen, yaaganon, haatha ogeninne kiita bessape 
yishin gidanaw dandda7ees. Woranzo gidonna mela laappunappe woy hosppunappe 
dariya cima yeddees. Cimatikka zaari zaari woossidi ero udoosona.
Oyddanthoykka qassi gixxidi ekkeyssagidishin, ha eko gelo wogan na7iyaanne 
na7ay na7entta soo asay kasetidi oyshettonnaninne qopponna na7ay kase oychi

giigisida machiw hari ekkiko he metuwaa gaasuwan daro cimati nm77u heedzu 
qamman mayza ma77e wogan gixxidi yela asaa woossi xoonidi ekki boosona. 
Haray qassi bayray de7ishin kaaloy woy gedenoy ekkiko bayraas macho gixxidi 
immoosona. 
Ichashanthoy qassi utetha gelo gidishin, hessika nam7un shaahettees. Koyroy 
attumay ekkana gidi oychidaappe guye si77i gidi gam77iko na7ay pa laggera 
kaa7ishin keesey keyiyaa mela gidikko omarssa gallas he oychidi aggida na7aa 
soo bada uttada naagawsu. He na7ay pa sooasaara woy shoorotara zorettidi guye 
simmanaas bessonnabaa gidida gisho na7iw ekki aggees. Nam7antho ogey qassi 
geela7otethan daro laythi gam77id alida issi issi geela7oti hara asi odan bochiko 
woy he uraara guutha laggetethi de7iyaaba gidikko uraa soo bidi uttoosna. Hara

Mishire (Mre) Amaarachi Aggido Taarike (Biography of Mishire Amaarachi Aggido: Pioneer Female Scholar from Southern Ethiopia): 15
Tamaare Maxaafe
 3.B. Haasaya
Meeze 2
II. Kaallidi Shiiqida Kaarata Bolla Cugan Cugan Tobbite. 
1. Maccatas gade dichaa bolla de7iya gishaaddetethay ay aazii?
2. Maccatasinne attumatas de7iya ginatethaa bolla haasayite.
3. Maccati ubba ooson hasheteyssi gade dichaas lo7o woy iita geyssa bolla 
haasayite.
4. Macca nayti ubbaban gina hashetana mela oosettanaw bessiyabaata bolla 
haasayite.
5. Maccati laames tamaaro koshshiiyee zal77e koshshiyaako odettite.
 3.C. Nabbabo
 
Misile 3 
Mishire (Mre) Amaarachi Aggido geetettiyaara Dugeha Tophphiyan luxida 
maccasatappe issiwu. Iya yelettiday Wolaytha zoone Boloso Soore woradana. Iyakka, 
pantta soo asaas oyddantho na7a gida oyddu maccanne usuppun adde nayti gididi 
yelettida dalgga keethaa giddon diccasu. Keetha asaykka timirttes de7iya qofay 
keehi dalgga. Iis aaway Sudaane gaden Intterire geetettiya Mishinen payyatethaa 
pilggetha hiillaa tamaaris. Hara baggara qassi, wonggele ooso haggaziya asi gidida 
pa nayti attoshin pa heera asaa nayti ubbati timirtte tamaarana mela denthethiya

16
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
ase. Hessape denddidayssan, heeraape tamaaridi dhoqqa dethaanne aawatethaas 
gakkida daroti de7oosona. I aawaa denthethoynne tamaaro miishata haggazoy iipe 
shaahettonnashin tamaaridayssa doona kuntha odawusu.
Iya duuden de7ishin I aaway koyro detha asttamaareta haasayisidi gallasa timirtte 
tamaaranaw dandda7onna heera nayta omarssi omarssi soo gidon xomppera 
woy paanosera tamaarana mela oothishe gam77is. Heera asati guyepe “Dargge 
kawotethaa wode baaso timirtte kaaloy yishin Aggido wolqqan pidale nu sinthe 
eri uttida” gidosona. Guussayka, pidale toho shaaho kanche gidonnashin xaafidi 
nabbabonne pirmma dandda7ana mela iya timirttey oothis. 
Mre Amaarachi Aggidoy issanthope bada heedzantho kifile timirtte tamaariday 
heeran de7iyaa woosa keethaana. Oyddanthope usuppuntho kifile gaso guuthi 
haakki ekkiya Sudaane Itteriyeere Mishinen (SIM) timirtte keethana gidishin he 
timirtte kethankka addetassape attin macca naytas aqiyaa bessi baynna gishos iya 
aqey dabbo asa soona. Dabbo keethan aqoppe attin xanna7anaasinne issi issibaatas 
daro injjey baawa. Gidikkonne, un77etethan saamintta gam77ada Laame galasi 
saaminttan issi wode soo asaakko simeretteyssi iis aykkoka aazenna. He timirtte 
keethaan aadhdhiya timirttey lo77onne kumethi gidiya gishos iya minnana mela udis. 
He timirtte keethaan Inggilizetho doona timirttey paranjjetan imettiya gishonne iya 
timirttiyaan gooba gidiya gishos kifile tamaaretappe issanthope heedzantho detha 
gaso kanche keyawusu. 
Laappunthope hospuntho gaso de7iyaa timirttiya Sooddo ammaniyaa asata timirtte 
keethan ha7i Sooddo( Otona) Hosppitaaley de7iyaa heeran tamaarasu. He timirtte 
keethay aqo timirtte keetha (boarding school) gidiyaa gishos aqiya bessayka iyan 
de7ees. Nam77antho detha timirttiyaa Sooddo nam77antho detha timirtte keethan 
tamaarada Otona simeretta aqawusu. Hessa ubbaa haniya wode sintha mino qofi 
de7iya gisho daaburssi iis si7ettenna. Hessa ubbaa hanashe pa soo asaakko Laame 
qamman soo simmada soo asaas dumma dumma metota maaddashe asaa daro 
ufayssiyaa na7a. 
Tammantho kifile gakkashe azina geloppe attin timirttiyaa qanxxonna tammanne 
nam77antho kifile wurssada I azinay ekkida qammape doomidi iyo kaallishe gam7is. 
Hessa yaani de7ishin koyro digire timirtte tamaaro bolla de7ashe yelida nam77u 
nayta azinaa soo asati dichoosona. Soo asay dichishe entta tamarssanaas keehi

17
Tamaare Maxaafe
baaxetidosona. 1975 M.Laythan, Tungga yunbburssen Deretetha Saynsse timirtten 
anjjettada ooso oykkasu. Hessape guye Mastterete timirtte qaada demmada iya kare 
gade keyishin I azinay haan attidi naytta baaloyi dichchishe salettonna aawatethan 
dichishe gam7is. Hessika daro mino maccata guye taarikiya pilggi xeelliyaade 
azinata maadey de7eyssa bessees. Aybis giikko, I azinay iyo darope kaalleyssanne 
maaddeyssa be7ada iyakka odawusu. 
Wurssethan iya “Ta naytoo, ta micheto, macca tamaaretoo ay wodekka qantha wode 
meton xoonettidi hintte timirttiyaape guye gooppite” gasu. Gujjadakka, “Metoy 
ubbi aadhdhees; kushe immiko qassi hemetuwaan qashetti atethi medhettees; 
ubbarakka ha77i wode cimmiyaabatinne leelisiyaabati de7iyaa gisho macca nayti 
loythidi naagettanaw koshshees. Minnidi yiikko qassi geli yelidaappeka guye 
tamaaroy dandda7etteyssa taappe tamaarite. Hara baggara qassi hinttes wodey 
kaseppe lo77idi timirtte keethay matan de7ees, guuxxin darin tamaare maxaafey 
benttees, iraadooneynne telebijiney de7ees. Hessa gishos, ha qaadaa ubbata wodera 
go7ettanaw koshshees” gasu. 
(Pulttoy luxida maccasata 1990 M.L. Toosoo Tophphe Timirtte Biiro.)
Meeze 3
I. Kaallidi Qommo Nibaabiyaape Shiiqida Oyshota Qaalan Zaarite.
1. Payyatetha pilggetha ooso tamaariday oonee?
2. Asati tamaaridi dhoqqa dethanne aawatethas daroti gakkida gaasoy,nibaabiyaadan, 
aybee?
3. “Aggido wolqqan pidale nu sinthe eri uttida” giday oonee?
4. Dn. Aggidoy gallasa timirtte tamaaranaw dandda7onna pa heera asatas ayba 
giigisidee?
5. Mre Amaarachi Aggidoy aappuntha kifile gaso tamaaradee? 
6. Mre Amaaracha “Ta michetoo, ta aayetoo ta naytoo, macca tamaaretoo” 
yaagada ooddes zore immadee?
7. Mre Amaaracha koyro digire tamaaro bolla de7ashe yelida nam77u nayta 
dichchey oonee?

10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
Meee 2
I. Kaallidi Qommo Haasayaape Keyida Oyshota Qaalan Zaarite.
1. Dummatethan de7iya issipetethay laalettiko waati giigisanee?
2. Hintte heeran dummatetha issipetethaa laalliya hanoti de7ii? Ayba aybee?
3. “Darana dereyan heedzi daggi uyees” issipetetha duuasara gathi 
xeellishin guussay ay guussee?
4. Hintte heeran de7iyaa issipetethay ay melee?
5. Dummatetha issipetetha duussaas baaso gidiyabaati ayba aybee?
 4.C. Nabbabo 
Misile 5 
Pederaale Kawotethi
Issi wode gade kawoy gade deretethaanne kawotethaaba dalggan tobbanaw shiiqo 
medhdhis. Hessika koyro baaso udidi xeellanaw koyiday kawotethaa ooso sinthe 
efos qaaxxishin deriya giddon de7iya dummatethay de7ishin benttiya issipetethaa 
woy nam77ata giddon de7iya issipetethay wolippe duuxxonnayssa oge beson 
kawotetha ooso polo wode metoti yeletata giddon medhettonna mela deretethaa 
woy gadiya gaathan de7iya darota garssan aqiya guuthati qohettonna mela baaso 
gidida meezey de7ana mela koyettida shiiqo.
He shiiquwan denddidabaatappe koyroy, Tophphpiya dere asaa giddon medhettanaw 
dandda7iya dummatetha qommota paatethi. He dummatethaa qommotape bertteti 
kaalleyssada shiiqis: kochchata (ethnic), doona, ammano, guta (regional), woga, 
taarikenne polttika dummatethata gidoosona. Gidikkoka, dumma dumma asati

27
Tamaare Maxaafe
issipe shiiqidi issi kawotethi medhdhidi he kawotethaa gaathan wolli dummatethaa 
issipetethaasinne minotethaas wolqqa udidi go7ettishe daro wodeppe gam77idosona.
Gujjidikka, nu dere Tophphiya dere asaa duussaa hara gadetappe dummayiya lo7o 
kanddoy kase bayra aawata wodeppe doommidi ammano dummatethan de7iyaa 
issipetethaanne woga dummatethaan de7iyaa issipetethaa wolippe naagoninne 
bonchchon yidaba gideyssi dummayees. Mallas, nu gaden Isilaama ammaniya asati 
pantta Masggide keexxiyaaba gidikko hara ammaniya asati qassi wolli maadettidi 
keexxoosona.
 Shiquwan denddida qofatappe nam77anthoy, dumma dumma deretethaa giddon 
de7iyaa dummatethay hachi gaso shiphphatethan gam77idaba gidikkoka issi issi drere 
asaa giddon de7iya bala asati dere asaa issipetethaa laallanawunne hara kare gade 
morkketa qofaa hemethon guutha maade woy miishe demmanaw gidi shagotetha qofa 
medhdhikokka he qofay deretethaa issipetethaa dummatethay de7ishin deretethaa 
giddon de7iyaa issipetethaa uulloyeyssati de7oosona. Entta oosoy shagotethas 
qaaxxiyaa bala qaaxoynne buqethay deretetha giddon loddara gaathi gelon gita 
meto medhon deretethaas de7iya siiquwaa, dabbotethaa, bollotethaanne h.h. melata 
daro ogera gahetethaa duuthishe gam77idosona. Gidoppe attin, issi asi gidin

Daro wodeppe doomidi issi heera dere asay dumma dumma medhettiyaa kachchata 
dhaysonne teqetha oosota oothishe gam77is. Ubba heerankka gade wogan saro 
naagiso wogay heeraape heeran dummatees. He oosoy gaden woy heera wogaadan, 
dabbotetha gahetethaadan, ooso keetha meeziyaadaninne h.h.melatan katidi 
polettees (Macfarlane, 2007). Ha qantha adarssoy dondzata gade wogan saro medho: 
Tophphiyaan, Dugeha Tophphiyaaninne nu heera Goofan oosettida oosota shishi 
oykkees. 
Dondzata gade wogan saro medho oosotape koyroy, gade dethan woy Tophphiyaan 
oosettiyaa oosota. Hessika, beni benkko laythape doommidi Fitaha Negestte 
geetettiyaa kawotethaa wodepe doommidi issi issi buzo asata gidin heeray heeraara 
cugan medhdhiya kachchata gade wogan giigisanaw oda bila eriyaa dondzati 
doorettoosona. Hessa mela doorettidi giigisiyaa dondzati Amaara heeran Shimaagille, 
Oroomo heeran Gadaa, Sidaama heeran Gudumaalee h.h.mela geetitti erettiyeyssati 
Tophphiya gade wogaan saro medhdhiyaa cugatape beettiyaa malla gidees.
Baryata giigiso oosotape nam77anthoy, gade wogan saro medho Dugeha Tophphiya 
kililen oosettiyaa oosota gidees. Ha kililey Tophphiyaan 3 tho dalgga kilile, daro 
wogaawatinne daro doonaawatikka hara kilileyssatape dariyayssara gahettidi

Pinniyaa Peesho (Transitive Verbs) vs. Pinnonna Peesho (Intransitive Verbs) (6.F Qawosa, pp. 60–61): Pinniyaa peesho transfers action from Yohaadde (Subject) to Kaalodde (Object): 'Gawariyaa eceriwu wodhasu' ('The cat killed the mouse'); 'Ta na7aawu kathaa ma' ('My child, eat the food'). Pinnonna peesho has no direct object: 'Nuuni Sawlan de7oos' ('We live in Sawla'); 'Awi dolohara keyees' ('The sun rises in the east'); 'Tami eexxees' ('The fire burns'). Ambivalent verbs (e.g., 'so77is' / 'feared'). -> 2. Transitive (Pinniyaa) vs. Intransitive (Pinnonna) Verbs (6.F Qawosa, pp. 60–61): Defines verbal valency and direct-object licensing in Gofatho.

 7. aDuSSa MeDh-DarSSo (novel)
SheMPPo laaPuna
Shemppo qoppobaata:
Ha shemppuwaa tamaari wurssidaape guyen tamaareti:
 " Adussa medh-darsso (novel), ayfebaata paattana.

Barkketho oyshota
1. Medh-darsso yarati ayba aybee?
2. Adussa medh-darssoy aybee?
 7.1. Medh-darsso
Medh-darssoy (fiction) Adarssanchay pa kahape medhdhi kessidi shiishiya xuufe. 
Medhdhi kessees gishin biitta bolla baynnabaa medhdhees guussi gidenna. Kase 
de7iya tumaa ekkidi malayi shiloyidi shiisheesippe attin. Biitta bolla de7iyabaan 
oorathabay baynnayssi geeshshi. Asi gidin asa yuushuwan de7iyabaa ubbay binipe 
de7ees. Hano shin nuuni akeeki wuda wothidi xeelli erokko. Asdarssanchi pa de7iya 
imotaan he medhape de7iya medhetata mala immidi, tilidi, shiloyidi, asi suuketana 
mela udidi xaafiya wode ooraxxi kichees. Medhdhi kessees guussay hayssa. 
Medh-darssoy gita woy adussa medh-darsso (novel), qantha medh-darsso (short 
story), diraamanne ginxxo shiishi oykkees. Daro bagga medh-darssoti yedan 
(narritve) xaafettoosona. Mallas: adussanne qantha medh-darsso. Ginxoynne 
diraami ginxxon xaafettoosona; shin diraami ubba wode ginxxon xaafettees guussi 
gidenna. Yedan xaafettida diraami kumi attis.

58
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
 7.2.  Adussa Medh-darsso /prose fiction
Sunthay qonccisiya mela yeson dalgga, medhon adussenne aaho. Issi adussa 
medh-darssoy pana dandda7ida issi gita maxaafe gidanaw dandda7ees. Hessa 
gisho unddenna sinthinne issi ishatamu sha77u gaso oykkiya qaalan xaafettanaw 
dandda7ees. Medhon dalgga gidida gisho pa gaathan oykkiya yarati, odaawati, 
besodeti tekniketi dalggoosona. Issi gaasoy issuwara gahettishe, sikettishe, 
qashettishe, tukkettishe biya gisho qanthay daro dalggisees. Qanthay dalggi 
dalggi bishin taarikey dalggees. Taarikiya dalggatethaape denddidayssan issi uten 
(shemppo saaten) nabbabin wurenna. Odaawati tirppa gidiya gisho ayfenne (bertte)

Tamaare Maxaafe
Meeze 1
I. Kaallidi Shiiqida Oyshota Worddo Woy Tuma Gidi Zaarite. 
1. Adarssanchay medh-darsso pa kahape medhdhi kessees gishin biitta bolla

 7.3. 7.3 Adussa Medh-Darsso (Novel), Yarata 
Medh-darsso yarati adarsso xaafanaw maaddiya shalota. Oona gida adarsson 
de7anaw bessiya, adarsanchatikka go7ettanaw bessiya shiisho ogenne medhdhanaw 
maaddiya tuussi. Yaratinne hiillati medh-darsso oosoy ay malanikka shiiqo, ay 
yohokka dentho, ay keenakka dalggo woy xuummo wogara ekettanaw bessees. 
Oosuwa gurzzatethay, adarssanchaa eray, nabbabanchaa aloy yigettey he kochatana.
Yaratanne hiillata go7etetha wogay adarssuwa kochaada, mixiyaadanne hiillaada 
dummatikkoka adarsso ubbaa giddon dhayokkona. Ubbarakka bor-nashaaddeti 
adarsso oosota yigganaw xapho gidida mixeda eketteykka he yaratanne hiillata.
Ha qofaa wozanthanaw/naannisanaw ane issi malla ekkoos. Issi asi lo77o wode 
keethe keexxanaw dosin ixxin koshshiya miisheti: besse, shuchi, shafe, goda (mithi), 
qorqqoro, simintto, mismmaare, bilookete, haathenne h.h.m. adussa medh-darsso 
yarata xeellishin:
Taarike (story)
Taarikey ooso sinth-guye. Ooso ubbay issi toho ellesidi polettenna. Woden, bessan, 
hanotan pantta maara oykkidi polettoosona. Taarikey goggiya shaafa haatha mela 
duge bees. Awuppe denddidi aw gakkii giya oyshuwa zaarees. Hanikkonne “ays?” 
“waanidi?” giya gaasonne demota zaarenna.
Taarike eranaw ayfe odaawaa kaallidi buussi koshshees. “Ebeloy” koyro yaanis; 
kaallidi yaanis; hessape yaanis; wurssethan yaani shemppis guussa kanche. Issi 
nabbabida medh-darsso hara nabbabonna lagges bollara bollara odiyabaa gidikko 
taarike odoos; woy haysoos guussi.

10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
Meqethi (yangge/ plot)
Hayssi ooso sinth- guyey gaasoninne demon tukettidi sinthe buussi bessees. Meqethi 
(yanggey) oosoy polettida gaaso bessishe sinthe kolxxees. “Koyro? Kaallidi? 
Iyaappe? Wurssethanishee?’ guussa kanche gidenna “Ays yaanidee? Waanidi 
hanidee? Oonee udiday?...” gishe gaasota oychees. Oychishekka wurssetha gaso 
bees.
Odaawa (character)
Odaawati adarsso giddon adarssanchay medhdhi kessidi wothida asata. Adarsson 
dumma dumma malanne kanddo, hessadan asho ma77idi imettida pantta ooso gisho 
poliya kare (biitta bolla) de7iya asaa eqqaaddeta. 
Meeze 2
II. Kaallidi shiiqida oyshota xaafidi zaariye.
1. Medh- darsson taarikenne meqetha dummatethaa paattite.
2. Medh-darsso yaratinne tekniketi medh-darsson attonna koshshiya gaasoy 
aybee? Ane hayssas giiga malla immite.
3. Odaawa qommota odite.
Dom77e (confilict)
Dom77ey nam77u zokkottiya asata, qofata giddon medhettiya ixotethi, walasse, 
palama, bute woy ooshshi. Nam77ata giddon qofan, koshshan, medhon, kanddon, 
ammanon…, wolira sigatetha dhayon medhettees. Hessikka asa duussan metoy, 
waayey, ixoy, kachi, ooshshi, palami, xiiney morkkey, am77usey… de7eyssa 
bessees. Asay duussi luulisanaw, tumatethi demmanaw, koyidabaa polaanaw 
woxxishin dhubey dhayi erenna. He dhubeta denthanaw woy dhubetape attanaw 
dafettees, butetees, baaxetees; dom77ettees. Yaanidikka haahe gi erenna. Hara 
lo77obaas gurgguxees; xinggimaallees. Hessankka hara dhubera gahettees. 
Medh- darssoy tuma asaa duussi bessiyabaa gidida gisho, asa na7appe shaaketti 
eronna dhubetanne paaceta odaawata baggara bessees. Medh-darsson dom77e 
guussaykka hessata mela metota buuri holidi keyanaw maaddiya bute guussi.
Dom77es gaasoy daro. Asi paara, asi hara asaranne lakkaytuwaara, asi medhetara 
dom77ettees. He dom77e gaasoti asa bolla (ashon) issi naaqo/meto gathees. Woy

61
Tamaare Maxaafe
kaha bolla naaqo/meto gathidi paacci be7ees. Adarssanchay he naaqota asa bolla 
be7idi medhdhi kessida odaawata bolla wothees. Odawaati he metuwappe keyanaw 
butetiya butey, dafetethay adarssuwaas mala immees. Nabbabanchaa wozanaa 
sottidi sinthe woxisees. Meqethan taarikey gasoranne demora tukettidi medhettiya 
tanggoy gaaso gidishin he gaasoykka dom77e gidees. Nam77u dom77e kochchati:
Asho Dom77e (physical confilict)
Hayssi issi odaaway hara odaawara ashon woy asatethan medhdhiya dom77etethi, 
bute, gorppetethi. Ha butiyaan kunddetha, wadhetetha, oletetha, shooletetha mela 
asho bolla gakkiya metota be7oos. Hayssi kare bolla (asatetha) woy asho dom77e 
geetettees. Hessi asa na7a bolla tumappe gakkiya meto gididayssa doganaw bessenna.
Kaha Dom77e (psychological confilict)
Issi odaaway issibay iya bolla gathiya naaquwaape denddidi pa ulo, wozana, kaha 
gaathan meetettiya hanota (gaatha qofa).
Medh- darsson daro wode asho dom77epe kaha dom77ey doorettees geetettees. 
Asho dom77etethi aleppe aadhdhishin hayqos gathees. Taarikeykka wuronna 
shin eqqi/polettonna attanaas dandda7ees. Hayssi qassi medh-darsson hara meto. 
Adarssanchaa wolqqaaka paaccis guussi. Kaha dom77en odaaway pa gaathara 
(wozanara) meetettishin taarikey sinthe tanggana mela maaddees. Hanikkonne, 
nam77atikka koshshoosona. Pilmmen gidikko asho dom77ey daro dosettees.
Issi medh-darsso nabbabi giddo gakkishin dom77eti usappe waaxetti (minni minni) 
bees. Nuunikka daro suuketoos. Ubbara nu kahay un77ettees. Nu qofay suullees. 
Nu wozanay sotettees. Dhiskko dhayssees. He wode dom77ey suullis; nu wozanay 
sotettis goos. Wurssetha bolla qassi dol77i dol77i bidi suullidayssi irxxees. He 
wode zarbbis goos. Taarikeykka polettees. Nabbabanchaykka shemppees. Taarikey 
ufayssishe wurikko haahe goos. Meto bolla wodhdhishin wurikko hara qofan geloos; 
yilotoos; adarssanchaa baaddoos. 
Dom77ey medh-darssos tuussi woy zokko meqethi guussi. Suullida dom77en 
xaafettonna adarssoy ase suukeyenna. 
Mallaas, 
1. “Dada” giya medh- darssuwan dadaranne moconaara pala dom77en 
gahettidosona. Wurssetha bolla taarikey nu wozanaa sotti aggis. Dada bolla

10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
iita metoy gakkanayssa haahora xeelloos. Woy dadi talbbon gelidi shemppo 
dhayssana mela hanees; woy asata bolla dano gathidi malalssiya hanotan

2. “Darota” giya tammantho kifilen xaafettida medh-darssuwan “…pa achaa

 Besode (Setting)
Ha qaalay “besse” nne “wode” giya nam77u qaalatape ekettidi bu7ethan medhettis. 
Sa7a bolla qaaxxiya qaaxoy, oosettiya ooso ubbay bessapenne wodepe kare keyanaw 
dandda7enna. “Bessi” issibay hanida aqo malaatiya gidishin “awan” giya oyshuwa 
zaarees, (heera, keethe, kare, wora, dembba, zuma, abba…). “Wodey” issibay ay 
wode (awde) hanidaakko, awde oosettidaakko suure bessees. (Laythi,ageena, saate, 
qamma…)
Odaawati medh-darsson taarikenne ooso poliya laythi, wodey, qammi, ageeni 
de7eyssi qoncce. Adarssanchay odaawati medhettidaanne de7iya heeraa (bessaa) 
malayidi kochanaw bessees. Adarssuwan odaawatas qaaxos imettiya medheta 
bessatinne wodeti tumappe asa na7i de7iyaanne qaaxxiya woy de7anawnne 
qaaxxanaw dandda7ees gidi nabbabanchay akeekanaw dandda7iyabaa gidanaw 
bessees. Hankkoode taarikeynne oosoy asas tuma aazenna.
Odaawati qaaxxiya bessati katama, gaxare, guta, giya, gadha, gezze,… gidanaw 
dandda7ees. Hessata sunthay geeyidi erettanaw bessees. Wodeta sunthaa suure 
xeeganaw woy xeegonna agganaw dandda7ees. He wode, he laythi, hiqqa ageena, 
hiqqa saaten gishe bessanaw dandda7ees.

Tamaare Maxaafe
Wodeti qassi: wontta, qamma, issi ageenanne usuppun laythi.
1. Dom77ey asa giddon waanishin medhettii?
2. Dom77e kochata odidi hinttepe hara malla immite. 
3. Asho dom77epenne kaha dom77epe awssi iitee? Awssi keehee? Ays?
Ayfe (theme)
Ayfe guussay adarssoy nabbabanchchatas aathiya kiita, ayfe qofa, wuda, guussi. 
Adarssanchay odaawata go7ettidi, asa asho mayzidi, asa bessan essidi oosisees; 
qaaxisees. Entti woli giddon medhdhiya gahetethaaninne butiyaan ayfe bessees.
Ayfey issi adarsson maxaafiyaas koyro bolla, giddon woy wurssethan issi aqon 
kuuretti uttidi beettenna. Koyrope wurussetha gaso nabbabikko he ubbaape 
gum77ettidi beettiya kuushsha qofa. Nuuni issibaa demmida gidi odeykka he 
adarssuwaas qustteepe denddidi odishina guussi.
Adarsson ayfey nam77u ogera shiiqees geetettees. Geeshsha ogeninne geeman 
(xuuran). Baggatan, kasetidi xeeraape poxi bessees. Kasetidi besoy doorettenna. 
Baggati kumetha taarikiya giddon zerikko asi nabbabishe, odaawata butiya 
akeekishe, dhubetappe keyanaw haniya dafetethaa qopishe…, gaathape woocidi 
demmees.
Issi adarsso ooson bertte ayfey ay wodekka gidin issinno gidanaw bessees. Bila 
xuufe zaway aaho gidikkonne issi xuufey ubbabaa buuri shiishenna. Hanikkonne 
adussa medh-darssotan kale ayfeta shiishanaas dandda7ettees.
 Xeelli-gina (Xeelliyaa gina) (Point of View)
Haasgini adarssanchay taarikiya odiya oge. He taarikiya odiya uray (adarsso giddon) 
awan uttidi odii? “Taani” woy” tana” gishe giddo gelidi odii? Yee Karen uttidi “I 
woy Iya woy entti” gishe odii?
Mallas, koose kaassi odaaddey (haysaaddey) iraadonera odeyssa ekkikko gidana. 
Odaaddey toho koose kaassi iraadonen hayziya asaas aathishe yaagees.
“Ha77i ebeloy koose ekkis. Ekkidi ebelos aathi immis. Ebeloy haassidi ebelos 
immis. Ebeloy qassi qanthara ebelos immidamela ebeloy shemppisonna shin bollara 
qakkidi gelisimakkin goole naageyssi oykki ashshis.”
Ha koose kaassaan haysaddey (odaaddey) paw kaa7enna. Pana sinthe aathidi

64
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
odenna. Kaassanchata qaaxuwa karen utti xeellishe aathees. Issi adarssanchi ha 
haasginaa oyddu haasgina go7ettidi shishees. 
Wurssi-eraadde Haasgina/xeelgina (omniscient point of view)
Ha ginay odaaddey taarikiyaape karen uttidi odiya has-gina. Wurssi-eraadde guussay 
eraawa woy ubbaa wurssi erees guussi. Hayssa geetettiday haysaddey karen uttidi 
odaawati haniyaaba ubbaa xeellishe odiya gishossa. Odaawa issoy issoy haniyaabaa 
ubbaa wurssi xeellanaw injje qaadi de7iya gisho iyaappe buutidi woy balidi attiyabay 
baawa. Hayssa mela ginay adarssanchay odaawata guyen geemmidi pa gaatha 
qofaa nabbabanchatas qonccisi odanaw maaddees. Nabbabanchati adarssuwaape 
haakkoosona.
Koyro Moode Haasgina (first person point of view)
Koyro moode geetetteyssati pexon “tana”, masaran “nuna” giya laame sunthata. 
Hayssa mela haasginan xafettida adarsson haysaaddey pa huuphera taarikiya giddo 
geli uttidi qaaxishe haasayiya oge guussi. “Taani yaanas; taani yaatas; woy masaran 
“nuuni yaanida;nuuni yaatida…, gishe odees. Haysaaddey qaaxon (ooson) gelidi 
kushettishe odiya gisho nabbabanchati taarikiya matan kaalloosona.
Hara baggara qassi taarikiya giddo gelidi “taani yaanas…,” gishe odeyssi pa 
lo77otethaa, ashkketethaa, iitatethaa, qaratethaa, metuwa, un77aa woy hayqo gidin 
odanaw injjetenna. 
Mallas, “Biqqala” giya Ayyala Gabayoy xaafida medh-darssope poxettidi ekettida 
qofa xeelloos.
“…Ha taarikiya hinttes xaafiya taani hayqqada dogettida ase. Asi-derey erin 
moogettas. Hintte ta sunthaa denthidi ta lakkaytuwaape issi ase oychiyaako “1884 
Nepilsen denddida koleera gadoy harqqida asatape issuwa; ta ahaykka ha77i duufon 
wooqetha bolla de7ees” gaana. Hanope attin, taani ha77i paxa; shemppora de7ays. 
Taani suuthi irxxonna buroo hasttamu laytha yalaga. Ta ayfey ixxibeenna; phircci 
gidi xeellees. Ta kushe sarppay arggacibeenna. Panthatetha shophphey xinqqees. 
Ha77ikka buroo dicca simmabiikke. Ee…asi tana hayqqis gidi odikkonne, 
aggikkonne taani hayssishe; paxa… (Biqqala 1981:3)
Xii- Eraadde Haasgina (limited omniscient point of view)

65
Tamaare Maxaafe
Ha ginay haasaya hiillan eraadde haasayaginara misatees. Dummatethay eraadde 
haasgini odaawa ubbata bagga wurssi eriya gidishin xii- haasgini uuga odaawata 
bagga kanchche erees. Bertte (ayfe) odaawape woy sima odaawatape hankkota 
eranaw daro wolqqi baawa. 
Diraama Haasgina (dramatical point of view)
Hayssa kocha haasginay daro injjetey diraamana.
Doona (Language)
Adarssoy qaalan bessiya misile. Adarssanchay odaawata qaaxuwa, gaatha qofaanne 
entti qaaxxiya heeraa qonccisey doonana. Kochida odaawata wolira haasayisishe 
pantta qofaa qonccisanaada, hessadan, taarikiya giddora tanggishe pa huuphe 
qofaakka qonccisey doonana. Hessa gisho, adarssanchay doonan dure (luxida) ase 
gidanaw bessees. Doonanne doonan qonccisetha wolqqi baynna adarssanchi daro 
erikkonne haraas kessi bessanaw dandda7enna. Adarssanchas kaxxida doona eri 
de7eyssa koyro shemppuwaan dalggisidi xeellida. Kuuyishin, adarssanchi ashanqqa, 
misile medhdhiyanne qonccisiya gurza qaalata doori ekkidi xaafanaw bessees.
Meeze 4
III. Kaallidi Shiiqida Oyshota Tuma Woy Worddo Gidi Zaarite.
1. Issi adarsson ayfe qofay daro wode giddo heeran beettees.
2. Adussa medh- darssotan ayfey issi bessan kuurettidi beettanaw dandda7ees.
3. Adussa medh-darsson bertte ayfepe hara tashe ayfey de7anaw dandda7ees.
4. Wurssi-eraadde haasgini issi taariken “Taani” woy “Nuuni” gishe odes (haysees).
5. Koyro moode haasginan haysaaddey pana sinthe kessi odeyssi pana nashshanaw 
woy boranaw injje gidonna gisho daabura miyyeda ekettees.
6. Sima eraadde haasgini odaawata bagga wurssi erees.
 Odaawata (characteristics) 
Odaawati adarsso giddon adarssanchay medhdhi kessidi wothida asata. Adarsson 
dumma dumma malanne kanddo, hessadan asho ma77idi imettida pantta ooso gisho 
poliya kare (biitta bolla) de7iya asaa eqqaaddeta. He asati nu mela sunthi de7iya, 
mali de7iya, kanddon shaakettidi /dummatidi erettiya adarssanchay medhdhidi

66
10tho kifile Goofatho Doona
wothida nuus malla eqqida asata.
Adarssanchay pa be7idabaata, xeellidabaata, akeekidabaata, xomoosidabaata… 
adarsson bessanaw koyishe biitta bolla de7iya asay othiya oosota oosisanaw 
odaawata medhdhees; koyida qofaa entta doonan qonccisees.
Odaawati nuuda moosona; uyoosona; ufayttoosona; kayottoosona; odoosona; 
oothoosona, haraggoosonanne hayqqoosona. Nu gisho eqqida gisho nuuni haniyabaa 
ubbaa hanoosona.
Odaawata Shiisho Oge
1. Dumma dumma oosota othishe beettanaw bessees. Odaawati doona dooyidi 
odettanaw bessees.
2. Entti medhettida asaas /deriyaas eqqanaw bessees.
3. Pantta oosuwan gidin odaan nabbabanchata ayfen tuma gididi beettanaw 
koshshees.
4. Pantta oykkida oosuwan minni eqqidi (gede haa laamerettonna) polanaw 
bessees.
5. Amale laammonna shin pantta kase amaliw ekkidi wurssetha gaso baanaw 
bessees. Dosin ixxin laame koshshiyabaa gidikko ammanthiya mino gaaso 
shiishidi laamo koshshees.
6. Issoy issuwaape dummatiya issi kanddoy de7anaw bessees.
7. Ubbara xillo gidanaw bessenna. Nu, asa na7i, ubbara xillo gidokko. Issi issi 
pacciyabaati de7oosona.
 Odaawa Qommota
A. Bertte Odaawa
Ayfe woy bertte odaaway taariken koyrope wurssetha gaso ooso polishe beettiya 
daro dalgga bessan gelees.
B. Sima Odaawata
Hayssati medh- darson guutha bessan ooso oothi pantta gishuwa onggidi ellesi 
dhayeyssata. Enttikka panta oosees hankkotada koyettoosona. Ubbarakka sima 
odaawati baynnaako bertte odaawati entta bessan eqqidi othanaw dandda7onna 
gisho woy imettida ooso ubbaa pantta kanchche polanaw wolqqa dhayiya gisho

8.1.1 Palantho adarsso
Ha adarssouwaa sunthay qoncisiya mela palantho adarsoy issi allalle haraara gathi

Muussinne Ushshi
“Miday bidaa gakkees” gees Goofatho tossey. Hekko ‘uyiday bidaa gakkees’ gishin 
si7i ereetii? Yaatikko, ushshi gishin xillo xoossa haathi, woy nu dere irko maathi 
gidonna shin uyi ekkin haa uyaa mathoyiya wolqaama ushshi gaanaassa. ‘Gede min 
haa miya bambariyaw, Gede uyin haa uyaa haraqiyaw’ giya bini yetha sabaa qopite. 
Muussi gidin ushshi go77anaas woy qohanaas danda7ees. Shin, ubbaape, alepe aathi 
ushshi ubba wode qoheesepe attin go77enna. 
Qumi asa na7as shempo. Qumape haakkidi waani de7anee? Ane akeekite. Nu seeley 
wonta omarsi quma koyees. Nu diccey, nu paammey, nu cil7ey, nu uusattey quma 
mishina. Nu wolqa abbe demmey, nu iita hargepe naagettey, nu bollaa kooley, nu 
wolqaama gita ooso oothey quma mishina. Nu ifilay kumin oothishin aggopa aggopa 
gees; kaa7ishin bollas lo77ees; hamettishin woxxa woxxa gees. Lagge dabbora 
uttidi issibaa nashshanaw, iita shin hayqqin afuxxidi yeekkanaw, haray attin, uloy 
kallanaw bessees. 
Muussi wolqanne wolqa malanne mala. Bini nuukkon issi uray ‘wolqi ulona’ gees. 
“Ma ekkada cil7aasa; ciiyaasa. Tista ekkada elcaasape attin ciiyakka. Ne bolla 
gogaape attin gaathay tistin ciiyenna’ gees. Hayssi tumape tuma.

73
Tamaare Maxaafe
Ushshi muussara yethi kushe baqara oykkiya mela giigees. Alana, ufayssana, 
hessada baaloyana gaana. Shin , ane ushshinne ushshi yaariya ase akeeki xeellite. 
Koyro, kaassay, nashoy, haysey, miichay, arashay. . . lo77ees; Ubbara ufayssees. 
Haathi miiccishin mees giya tossiya mela gam7ishin, guuthara guja guja gees. 
Guuthara ganxi mittishin gana gana gees. Ayfen yuuyi simmishin he wona kaasa 
lo77oy kachan laamettees. E wona nashoy – haysey oda cachan shirettees. Miicha 
kaassay tumbula wadhon gelana mela udees. Baggaa qassi ceeqetta ceeqetta, gayra 
gayra, gereera gereera udees. Coo bolloo - sa7oo giissees. Kase baynna ushshi 
kessida assura magga mela wolqay wadhetta wadhetta, tukettida inxarsay caya caya 
udisees. 
Hannira pee7iyakko ay iita geetii? Oge bolla kundi ache kolettida asaa, me77idi 
koolin soo gelida asaa, pa siiqo machiwnne nayta sarotaa dhayssida asaa, miishe – 
shalo ushshan xirsi ongidi meton gelida asaa, aawa - aayo, dabbo lagge ziqqi dhoqqu 
udi qaaridi cayida asaa . . . paydi wurssoko. Baggati mathoy aadhdhin wozana zaaridi 
“Yii coo; attida gideerenne” goosona. Ganjey mullugin, tirey kixxin, maraacey 
xaamatin hayqqi duufo gelida asaa qoodaykka unddenna. Hallithay kundisi aggin 
hannira aadhdhida gidaarkina gin ay maaddii? 
Ha ubbay tuma. I muussikka wogara lo77o. Uloy kallin pili cammees giya tossey 
coo mela tossettibeenna. “Yaare muussi bini qaallis ulo daakkkis” gees. 
Asanka qoronna muussi handa cadisidi moollo ehidi bolla malaa iissees; asho 
deexethees. Ushsha daroykka iya mela. Bini luxida eranchati yaagoosna. “Miichi 
darishe afuthees. Injjetethi darishekka hessada qohees. Ubbabaa bessiya mela 
oykkikko lo77oy attoshin iitaykka go77ees” giya bertte odaa ooso bolla peeshshiday 
go7ettesepe attin qohettenna. (Y.Z.Urgaamo - 2009)

textbook_chapters_28_deep.grammar_focus_qawosa: Os-meqonne Ost-meqo (Active Voice and Passive Voice, 9.F Qawosa, pp. 86–87, cited from Beddilu Wozza 2014): In Os-meqo (Active), the agent subject (Yohaadde) performs the action: 'Wozaakkoy keethe keexxis' ('Wozaakko built a house'); 'Bunnaaroy muuze tokkis' ('Bunnaaro planted a banana tree'). In Ost-meqo (Passive), the object (Kaalodde) takes nominative '-y', the agent optionally takes instrumental/locative '-n' or ablative '-ppe', and the verb takes passive '-ett-': (1) 'Muuzey Bunnaaron tokettis' or 'Muuzey Bunnaaroppe tokettis' ('The banana tree was planted by Bunnaaro'); (2) Agentless passive: 'Muuzey tokettis' ('The banana tree was planted'). -> Active Voice (Os-meqo) and Passive Voice (Ost-meqo) Derivations (9.F Qawosa, pp. 86–87): Formalizes agentive passive ('-n' / '-ppe' on demoted agent + '-ett-' on verb) and agentless passive ('Muuzey tokettis').
