textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 1: Work Ethics and Professional Integrity
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Haasaya guussay issi asi pa huuphen gidin haratara qoppidabata, tobbidabatanne qofa laamerettidabata ubbaa doonara woykko odettidi qonccisikko haasaya geetettees. Haasaya hiillay moode haasayanne moode gidonna haasaya geetettidi nam77an shaakettees.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሀአሰየ ጉኡስሰይ ኢስሲ አሲ ፐ ሁኡጴን ጊዲን ሀረተረ ቆፕፒደበተ፣ ቶብቢደበተንኔ ቆፈ ለአሜሬትቲደበተ ኡብበአ ዶኦነረ ዎይክኮ ኦዴትቲዲ ቆንጭጪሲክኮ ሀአሰየ ጌእቴትቴእስ። ሀአሰየ ሂኢልለይ ሞኦዴ ሀአሰየንኔ ሞኦዴ ጊዶንነ ሀአሰየ ጌእቴትቲዲ ነምዕዓን ሻአኬትቴእስ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: ንግግር ማለት አንድ ሰው በግሉም ሆነ ከሌሎች ጋር ያሰበውንና የተወያየውን በአንደበት ሲገልጽ ነው። የንግግር ክህሎት መደበኛ ንግግር (moode haasaya) እና ኢ-መደበኛ ንግግር (moode gidonna haasaya) ተብሎ በሁለት ይከፈላል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Speech (Haasaya) means expressing one's thoughts and discussions orally with others; speaking skill is divided into formal speech (moode haasaya) and informal speech (moode gidonna haasaya).

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 1: Work Ethics and Professional Integrity
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Aaho Ooso: A. Ooso wogaw, B. Heera geeshshatethaa naago, C. Timirtte, D. Biittay di7on meecettonna mela naago, E. Medheta haarota naago.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: አአሆ ኦኦሶ፦ አ። ኦኦሶ ዎገው፣ ብ። ሄእረ ጌእሽሻቴꬃአ ነአጎ፣ ጭ። ቲሚርትቴ፣ ድ። ቢኢትተይ ዲዖን ሜእጬትቶንነ ሜለ ነአጎ፣ እ። ሜꬌተ ሀአሮተ ነአጎ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የቡድን ውይይት ርዕሶች፦ ሀ. የሥራ ሥነ-ምግባር፣ ለ. የአካባቢ ንጽሕና ጥበቃ፣ ሐ. ትምህርት፣ መ. የአፈር መሸርሸር መከላከል፣ ሠ. የተፈጥሮ ሀብት ጥበቃ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Oral Discussion Topics: A. Work ethics, B. Environmental sanitation, C. Education, D. Preventing soil erosion, E. Conserving natural resources.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 2: Cultural and Historical Heritage Artifacts
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Qan77ishe Kaassa Woga: Qan77ishe wothiya uray 'Qan77ishee' giikko zaariya uray 'Qashe' gidi zaarees. Zaaro immonna attikko 'Mokke' gidi gade immees.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ቀንዕዒሼ ከአስሰ ዎገ፦ ቀንዕዒሼ ዎꬂየ ኡረይ 'ቀንዕዒሼእ' ጊኢክኮ ዘአሪየ ኡረይ 'ቀሼ' ጊዲ ዘአሬእስ። ዘአሮ ኢምሞንነ አትቲክኮ 'ሞክኬ' ጊዲ ገዴ ኢምሜእስ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የቃንጪሼ ጨዋታ ደንብ፦ ጠያቂው 'ቃንጪሼ' ሲል መላሹ 'ቃሼ' ብሎ ይመልሳል። መልሱን ካላወቀ 'ሞኬ' ብሎ አገር ከሰጠ በኋላ መልሱ ይነገረዋል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Qan77ishe Dialogue Protocol: When the challenger says 'Qan77ishee?', the respondent replies 'Qashe'. If unable to counter the couplet, the respondent says 'Mokke' and grants a town before hearing the verse.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 3: Human Character, Personal Conduct, and Civic Ethics
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Aasetho Oda vs. Sitta Oda (pp. 47–49): Aasetho oday nam77u woykko daro asati wolira qofa laamerettishe haasayiya haasaya (dialogue); Sitta oday qassi issi asi haratas shiishiya moode haasaya (monologue/address).
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: አአሴꬆ ኦደ ቭስ። ሲትተ ኦደ (ፕፕ። 47–49)፦ አአሴꬆ ኦደይ ነምዕዑ ዎይክኮ ደሮ አሰቲ ዎሊረ ቆፈ ለአሜሬትቲሼ ሀአሰዪየ ሀአሰየ (ዲአሎጉእ)፤ ሲትተ ኦደይ ቀስሲ ኢስሲ አሲ ሀረተስ ሺኢሺየ ሞኦዴ ሀአሰየ (ሞኖሎጉእ/አድድሬስስ)።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የምልልስ ንግግር (Aasetho oda) እና ቀጥተኛ ንግግር (Sitta oda)፦ ምልልስ በሁለት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ሰዎች መካከል የሚደረግ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ ሲሆን ቀጥተኛ ንግግር ደግሞ አንድ ተናጋሪ ለታዳሚዎች የሚያቀርበው ንግግር ነው።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Interactive Dialogue (Aasetho Oda) vs. Direct Address (Sitta Oda): Aasetho oda is an interactive conversation between two or more speakers, whereas sitta oda is a prepared speech delivered by a single speaker.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 4: Short Fiction and Narrative Structure
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Ooso Kaaloda Maara (Procedural Discourse, pp. 57–58): Koyro, hayssa kaallidi, nam77antho, heedzantho, wurssethan — Mallas: Tukke katho maara, Maathi yeessidi pila doyssi kessana maara, Badala zeridi shaalen gelssana maara.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ኦኦሶ ከአሎደ መአረ (ፕሮጬዱረል ዲስጮኡርሴ፣ ፕፕ። 57–58)፦ ኮይሮ፣ ሀይስሰ ከአልሊዲ፣ ነምዕዓንꬆ፣ ሄእꬓንꬆ፣ ዉርስሴꬃን — መልለስ፦ ቱክኬ ከꬆ መአረ፣ መአꬂ ዬእስሲዲ ፒለ ዶይስሲ ኬስሰነ መአረ፣ በደለ ዜሪዲ ሻአሌን ጌልስሰነ መአረ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የሥራ ቅደም ተከተል አገላለጽ (ገጽ 57–58)፦ መጀመሪያ (koyro)፣ ከዚህ ቀጥሎ (hayssa kaallidi)፣ በመጨረሻም (wurssethan) በማለት የቡና አፈላል፣ የወተት መናጥና የበቆሎ እርሻ ቅደም ተከተልን ማስረዳት።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Procedural Discourse Markers (pp. 57–58): Using sequence connectors (koyro 'first', hayssa kaallidi 'next', wurssethan 'finally') to explain traditional coffee preparation, churning milk into butter, and maize cultivation.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 5: Population Growth, Census Distribution, and Demography
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Haasayo Tobba (p. 75): 1. Tophphiya dere asa qoodanne hayqo geeddaridi shiishite. 2. Tophphiyan matan matan (shiiqidi) de7iya killille dere asata tobbidi shiishite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሀአሰዮ ቶብበ (ፕ። 75)፦ 1። ቶጵጪየ ዴሬ አሰ ቆኦደንኔ ሀይቆ ጌእድደሪዲ ሺኢሺቴ። 2። ቶጵጪየን መተን መተን (ሺኢቂዲ) ዴዒየ ኪልሊልሌ ዴሬ አሰተ ቶብቢዲ ሺኢሺቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የውይይት ጥያቄዎች (ገጽ 75)፦ 1. የኢትዮጵያን የሕዝብ ብዛትና የሞት መጠን አወዳድራችሁ አቅርቡ። 2. በኢትዮጵያ ተጠጋግተው የሚኖሩ የክልል ሕዝቦችን ስርጭት ተወያይታችሁ አቅርቡ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Oral Discussion & Presentation (p. 75): 1. Compare and present Ethiopia's population growth and mortality rates. 2. Discuss densely populated versus sparsely populated regions in Ethiopia.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 6: Desertification, Deforestation, and Environmental Protection
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Moode Haasaya vs. Moode Gidonna Haasaya (p. 90): Hintte cugan cugan gididi 'Bazzotethi' giya kaara bolla qantha nootte oykkidi moode haasaya giigisidi kifile tamaaretas shiishite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሞኦዴ ሀአሰየ ቭስ። ሞኦዴ ጊዶንነ ሀአሰየ (ፕ። 90)፦ ሂንትቴ ጩገን ጩገን ጊዲዲ 'በዝዞቴꬂ' ጊየ ከአረ ቦልለ ቀንꬃ ኖኦትቴ ኦይክኪዲ ሞኦዴ ሀአሰየ ጊኢጊሲዲ ኪፊሌ ተመአሬተስ ሺኢሺቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መደበኛና ኢ-መደበኛ ንግግር (ገጽ 90)፦ በቡድን ሆናችሁ 'በረሃማነት' በሚል ርዕስ አጭር ማስታወሻ በመያዝ መደበኛ ንግግር አዘጋጅታችሁ ለክፍል ተማሪዎች አቅርቡ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Formal vs. Informal Speech (p. 90): In groups, prepare and deliver a formal speech using outline notes on the topic of 'Desertification (Bazzotethi)'.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_gofatho: Shemppo 7: Yooga Nayta Wolqqa Ooson Qoho
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 7: The Harm of Child Labor Exploitation and Protecting Youth Education
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Cuga Tobba (pp. 102–103): Cuga daannanne xaafanchcha dooridi 'Yooga nayta wolqqa tooshe' giya kaara bolla tobbidi kifile tamaaretas shiishite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ጩገ ቶብበ (ፕፕ። 102–103)፦ ጩገ ደአንነንኔ ጠአፈንችቻ ዶኦሪዲ 'ዮኦገ ነይተ ዎልቅቀ ቶኦሼ' ጊየ ከአረ ቦልለ ቶብቢዲ ኪፊሌ ተመአሬተስ ሺኢሺቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የቡድን ውይይት (ገጽ 102–103)፦ የቡድን ሰብሳቢና ጸሐፊ መርጣችሁ 'የሕፃናት ጉልበት ብዝበዛ' በሚል ርዕስ ተወያይታችሁ ለክፍል አቅርቡ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Structured Group Discussion (pp. 102–103): Elect a group chairperson (cuga daanna) and secretary (xaafanchcha) and conduct a panel discussion on preventing child labor exploitation.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 8: Peace, Conflict Prevention, and Social Harmony
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Haasayancha Yeda Haasaya -> Hayzanchas Geliya Qoncciso (Paraphrasing Idiomatic Speech, pp. 114–115): Mallas: 'Ushsha mathoppe maatha mathoy daro iita' -> 'Kaloynne de7oy daridi mathoyida asi ushshan mathotida asappe aadhees.'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሀአሰየንቻ ዬደ ሀአሰየ -> ሀይዘንቻስ ጌሊየ ቆንጭጪሶ (ፐረጵረሲንግ ኢዲኦመቲጭ ስፔእች፣ ፕፕ። 114–115)፦ መልለስ፦ 'ኡሽሻ መꬆፕፔ መአꬃ መꬆይ ደሮ ኢኢተ' -> 'ከሎይንኔ ዴዖይ ደሪዲ መꬆዪደ አሲ ኡሽሻን መꬆቲደ አሰፕፔ አአꬌእስ።'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: ፈሊጣዊ ንግግሮችን ለአድማጭ በሚገባ ግልጽ ቋንቋ መተርጎም (ገጽ 114–115)፦ ምሳሌ፦ 'ከመጠጥ ስካር የወተት (የጥጋብ) ስካር ይከፋል' -> 'በሀብትና በጥጋብ የታበየ ሰው በመጠጥ ከሰከረ ሰው የባሰ ይጎዳል።'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Paraphrasing Figurative Speech for Listeners (pp. 114–115): E.g., 'Intoxication from milk (wealth/arrogance) is worse than intoxication from alcohol' -> 'Arrogance from excess wealth is more dangerous than drunkenness.'

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 9: Climate Zones, Weather Patterns, and Climate Change
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Palama Woga (Formal Debate Rules, pp. 129–130): Palama kaalethiya daannanne afakaato (timekeeper/moderator) dooridi, imettida wodiya wogan go7ettidi, markka shiishidi palamanawuren pirdda amin77idi eko.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ፐለመ ዎገ (ፎርመል ዴበቴ ሩሌስ፣ ፕፕ። 129–130)፦ ፐለመ ከአሌꬂየ ደአንነንኔ አፈከአቶ (ቲሜኬእፔር/ሞዴረቶር) ዶኦሪዲ፣ ኢሜትቲደ ዎዲየ ዎገን ጎዔትቲዲ፣ መርክከ ሺኢሺዲ ፐለመነዉሬን ፒርድደ አሚንዕዒዲ እኮ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የክርክር ሥነ-ሥርዓት (ገጽ 129–130)፦ የክርክር ዳኛና ሰዓት ተቆጣጣሪ በመምረጥ፣ የተሰጠውን ሰዓት በአግባቡ በመጠቀም፣ በማስረጃ በመከራከርና በመጨረሻም ውሳኔውን በጸጋ መቀበል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Formal Debate Protocol (pp. 129–130): Selecting debate judges, staying on topic and within time limits, supporting arguments with evidence, and accepting the final verdict.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 10: Theatrical Drama, Idioms (Aaqe Oda), and Discourse Connectors
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Diraama 1 (10.2 Haasaya Hiilla, pp. 140–141): Dn. Shuguxe, Mle. Balmoona & Gurzza — Mle. Balmoona: 'Cimatethay daro lo77o asa sigethiyaabayka keeha ooso gido shin cimatethappe guye ushshi uyashe daro karen qamisoppa.' Gurzza: 'Abbo itoy gida mela hayana karen daro qamisoppa!' Dn. Shuguxe: 'Entena aybe hirggisey taani ta keena eriya asi.' (Wurssethan Dn. Shuguxey ushshan mathottidi soo bishin oge bolla kaamey dom77idi hayqqees).
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ዲረአመ 1 (10።2 ሀአሰየ ሂኢልለ፣ ፕፕ። 140–141)፦ ድን። ሹጉጤ፣ ምሌ። በልሞኦነ & ጉርዝዘ — ምሌ። በልሞኦነ፦ 'ጪመቴꬃይ ደሮ ሎዕዖ አሰ ሲጌꬂየአበይከ ኬእሀ ኦኦሶ ጊዶ ሺን ጪመቴꬃፕፔ ጉዬ ኡሽሺ ኡየሼ ደሮ ከሬን ቀሚሶፕፐ።' ጉርዝዘ፦ 'አብቦ ኢቶይ ጊደ ሜለ ሀየነ ከሬን ደሮ ቀሚሶፕፐ!' ድን። ሹጉጤ፦ 'እንቴነ አይቤ ሂርግጊሴይ ተአኒ ተ ኬእነ እሪየ አሲ።' (ዉርስሴꬃን ድን። ሹጉጤይ ኡሽሻን መꬆትቲዲ ሶኦ ቢሺን ኦጌ ቦልለ ከአሜይ ዶምዕዒዲ ሀይቅቄእስ)።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: ድራማ 1 (ገጽ 140–141)፦ የአቶ ሹጉጤ፣ የወ/ሮ ባልሞና እና የልጃቸው ጉርዛ ምልልስ፦ ወ/ሮ ባልሞናና ጉርዛ አባታቸው ከሽምግልና በኋላ መጠጥ ጠጥቶ በምሽት እንዳይቆይ ቢመክሩትም አቶ ሹጉጤ 'ልኬን አውቃለሁ' ብሎ አምሽቶ በስካር ሲመለስ በመኪና ተገጭቶ ይሞታል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Drama Dialogue 1 (pp. 140–141): Dn. Shuguxe, his wife Balmoona, and son Gurzza — Balmoona and Gurzza plead with him not to drink late after elder mediation, but he insists he knows his limit, gets drunk at night, and is fatally struck by a car.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 10: Theatrical Drama, Idioms (Aaqe Oda), and Discourse Connectors
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Diraama 2 (10.6 Xaafo Hiilla, p. 146): 'Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna' — Aawa Zalanthi, Aayi Danttenna & Na7a Gurzza dialogue on peace and reconciliation.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ዲረአመ 2 (10።6 ጠአፎ ሂኢልለ፣ ፕ። 146)፦ 'አይፌ ጨድደነ ሚꬂ አይፌስ ቤእቴንነ' — አአወ ዘለንꬂ፣ አአዪ ደንትቴንነ & ነዓ ጉርዝዘ ዲአሎጉእ ኦን ፔአጬ አንድ ሬጮንጪሊአቲኦን።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: ድራማ 2 (ገጽ 146)፦ 'ዓይንን የሚወጋ እንጨት ለዓይን አይታይም' (Ayfe caddana mithi ayfes beetenna) — የአጭር ድራማ ምልልስ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Drama Dialogue 2 (p. 146): 'The twig that pokes the eye is not seen by the eye' — dramatic script writing exercise.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 1: Language (Nature, Growth, Endangerment, and Sentence Types)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze Nam77a (1.2 Haasaya, p. 7): 1. Dooni asa na7aba gishin ay guussee? 2. Dooni hayqqiya gaasoti aybee? 3. Dooni saynsse guussi ay guusseekko paattite. 4. Dooni awppe tamaaretti meezetii? 5. Doona kanddoti oonantteekko paatti odite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (1።2 ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 7)፦ 1። ዶኦኒ አሰ ነዓበ ጊሺን አይ ጉኡስሴእ? 2። ዶኦኒ ሀይቅቂየ ገአሶቲ አይቤእ? 3። ዶኦኒ ሰይንስሴ ጉኡስሲ አይ ጉኡስሴእክኮ ፐአትቲቴ። 4። ዶኦኒ አውፕፔ ተመአሬትቲ ሜእዜቲኢ? 5። ዶኦነ ከንድዶቲ ኦኦነንትቴእክኮ ፐአትቲ ኦዲቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (1.2 ንግግር፣ ገጽ 7)፦ 1. ቋንቋ የሰው ልጅ ብቻ ሀብት ነው ሲባል ምን ማለት ነው? 2. ቋንቋ የሚሞትባቸው ምክንያቶች ምንድን ናቸው? 3. ቋንቋ ሳይንስ ነው ማለት ምን ማለት ነው? 4. ቋንቋ ከየት ይማራል? 5. የቋንቋ ባህሪያትን ዘርዝሩ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (1.2 Oral Discussion, p. 7): Discuss why language is uniquely human, why languages die, why language is systematic/scientific, how language is acquired from society, and the core properties of language.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 2: Taxation, Public Infrastructure, and Verb Tense Paradigms
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze Nam77a (2.2 Haasaya, p. 14): 1. Giira cigos qoppobay aybee? 2. Giira demishay beettiya pulttoti oonanttee? 6. Giira wogara cigo gishin qanthan ay guussee?
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (2።2 ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 14)፦ 1። ጊኢረ ጪጎስ ቆፕፖበይ አይቤእ? 2። ጊኢረ ዴሚሻይ ቤእትቲየ ፑልትቶቲ ኦኦነንትቴእ? 6። ጊኢረ ዎገረ ጪጎ ጊሺን ቀንꬃን አይ ጉኡስሴእ?
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (2.2 ንግግር፣ ገጽ 14)፦ 1. የግብር አከፋፈል ዓላማ ምንድን ነው? 2. የግብር ገቢ ምንጮች እነማን ናቸው? 6. ግብርን በአግባቡ መክፈል ማለት ምን ማለት ነው?
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (2.2 Oral Discussion, p. 14): Discuss the purpose of taxation, sources of tax revenue, and the meaning of paying taxes honestly, on time, and voluntarily.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 3: Mineral Mining, Paragraph Composition (Daassa Xaafo), and Punctuation
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze Nam77a (3.2 Haasaya, p. 19): 1. Hintte heeran de7iya miniraaleta ane hintte laggetas paattite. 2. Miniraaleti aybis go77iyaakko qonccisite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (3።2 ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 19)፦ 1። ሂንትቴ ሄእረን ዴዒየ ሚኒረአሌተ አኔ ሂንትቴ ለግጌተስ ፐአትቲቴ። 2። ሚኒረአሌቲ አይቢስ ጎዕዒየአክኮ ቆንጭጪሲቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (3.2 ንግግር፣ ገጽ 19)፦ 1. በአካባቢያችሁ የሚገኙ ማዕድናትን ለጓደኞቻችሁ ዘርዝሩ። 2. ማዕድናት ለምን እንደሚጠቅሙ አብራሩ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (3.2 Oral Discussion, p. 19): Describe local mineral resources in your area and explain their industrial and household uses.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 4: Creative Fiction ('Darota') and Independent vs. Dependent Clauses
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Dialogue inside 'Darota' (pp. 30–31): Mishiree Keehanna: 'Hay godaw… Ta new ay iissadinnaa? Hayana ne maarota yeddarkki. Ne pathiko… Xoosso ne keethas oothidi de7ana mela new magana na7a giddo.' Daanna Bonqqo: 'Nuus wolqqay daaburishin, ayfey ixxishin, nuna heemana nu ushachaa ne Xoossa keethas immana geyssi taw gelibenna. Ha na7aay diccikko nuus mixi tikkidi nu ayfeppe buuxo denthanay iya era.'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ዲአሎጉእ ኢንሲዴ 'ደሮተ' (ፕፕ። 30–31)፦ ሚሺሬእ ኬእሀንነ፦ 'ሀይ ጎደው… ተ ኔው አይ ኢኢስሰዲንነአ? ሀየነ ኔ መአሮተ ዬድደርክኪ። ኔ ፐꬂኮ… ጦኦስሶ ኔ ኬእꬃስ ኦኦꬂዲ ዴዓነ ሜለ ኔው መገነ ነዓ ጊድዶ።' ደአንነ ቦንቅቆ፦ 'ኑኡስ ዎልቅቀይ ደአቡሪሺን፣ አይፌይ ኢጥጢሺን፣ ኑነ ሄእመነ ኑ ኡሻቻአ ኔ ጦኦስሰ ኬእꬃስ ኢምመነ ጌይስሲ ተው ጌሊቤንነ። ሀ ነዓአይ ዲጭጪክኮ ኑኡስ ሚጢ ቲክኪዲ ኑ አይፌፕፔ ቡኡጦ ዴንꬃነይ ኢየ እረ።'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: በ'ዳሮታ' ልቦለድ ውስጥ ያለው የወ/ሮ ኬሃና እና የአቶ ቦንቆ ምልልስ (ገጽ 30–31)፦ ወ/ሮ ኬሃና ልጇ ከዳነ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልጋይ እንዲሆን ስትሳል፣ አቶ ቦንቆ ደግሞ በእርጅናችን እንጨት ለቅሞና ውኃ ቀድቶ የሚጦረንን አንድ ልጃችንን እንዴት ትሰጪያለሽ ብሎ ይከራከራታል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Dialogue in 'Darota' (pp. 30–31): Weeping over her feverish child, Keehanna vows to dedicate him to serve God's house if healed, while Bonqqo protests that in their old age they need their only son to gather wood and draw water for them.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 5: Gofatho Oral Literature (Folktales, Riddles, Proverbs, Heroic Praise Chants, Qan77ishe, and Children's Songs)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkke Shiisho Hanota & Asa Paydo Sedhemenkke (pp. 40–42): Keetha aaway = Adde kokonjje; Keetha aayiya = Indda ikikiilo; Attuma na7a = Na7a zalle; Macca na7a = Na7a piijjo. Zaaranchay gam77ishin: 'Ta na7a dulley shuuqqees!'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬ ሺኢሾ ሀኖተ & አሰ ፐይዶ ሴꬌሜንክኬ (ፕፕ። 40–42)፦ ኬእꬃ አአወይ = አድዴ ኮኮንጅጄ፤ ኬእꬃ አአዪየ = ኢንድደ ኢኪኪኢሎ፤ አትቱመ ነዓ = ነዓ ዘልሌ፤ መጭጨ ነዓ = ነዓ ፒኢጅጆ። ዘአረንቻይ ገምዕዒሺን፦ 'ተ ነዓ ዱልሌይ ሹኡቅቄእስ!'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የቤተሰብ ቁጥር እንቆቅልሽ (ገጽ 40–42)፦ የቤት አባት = Adde kokonjje፤ የቤት እናት = Indda ikikiilo፤ ወንድ ልጅ = Na7a zalle፤ ሴት ልጅ = Na7a piijjo። መላሹ ሲዘገይ፦ 'Ta na7a dulley shuuqqees!' ይባላል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Household-Counting Riddle Protocol (pp. 40–42): Uses symbolic code names for father (Adde kokonjje), mother (Indda ikikiilo), son (Na7a zalle), and daughter (Na7a piijjo) so the respondent identifies which neighbor's family matches that exact count.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 6: Poetry (Poetic Meter, Stanza Structure, and the Poem 'Duuqqopa')
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze Nam77a (6.2 Haasaya, p. 55): 'Duuqqopa' giya ginxxuwa eedo naagidi kifile tamaaretas nabbabite; duuqoy (exam cheating) tamaare bolla, aakime bolla, nne daanna bolla gathiya qohota tobbite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (6።2 ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 55)፦ 'ዱኡቅቆፐ' ጊየ ጊንጥጡወ እእዶ ነአጊዲ ኪፊሌ ተመአሬተስ ነብበቢቴ፤ ዱኡቆይ (እጠም ቼአቲንግ) ተመአሬ ቦልለ፣ አአኪሜ ቦልለ፣ ንኔ ደአንነ ቦልለ ገꬂየ ቆሆተ ቶብቢቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (6.2 ንግግር፣ ገጽ 55)፦ 'Duuqqopa' (አትኮርጅ) የሚለውን ግጥም ዜማውን ጠብቃችሁ አንብቡ፤ ኩረጃ በተማሪ፣ በሐኪምና በዳኛ ላይ የሚያስከትለውን ጉዳት ተወያዩ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (6.2 Oral Recitation & Discussion, p. 55): Recite the poem 'Duuqqopa' with proper poetic rhythm and discuss the harm of academic cheating across professions (students, doctors, judges).

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 7: COVID-19 Coronavirus Pandemic, Gofatho Phonotactic Orthography (Ustta/Guttuma), and Bound Suffixes
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze Nam77a (7.2 Haasaya Palama, p. 61): Debate between two motions with evidence: (1) 'Koorona vayresse harggey asa na7a aadho qohees' vs. (2) 'Eedise (ECHI-AY-VI) harggey qohan aadhdhees.'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (7።2 ሀአሰየ ፐለመ፣ ፕ። 61)፦ ዴበቴ ቤትዌእን ትዎ ሞቲኦንስ ዊꬅ እቪዴንጬ፦ (1) 'ኮኦሮነ ቨይሬስሴ ሀርግጌይ አሰ ነዓ አአꬎ ቆሄእስ' ቭስ። (2) 'እእዲሴ (እቺ-አይ-ቪ) ሀርግጌይ ቆሀን አአꬍꬌእስ።'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (7.2 የክርክር ርዕሶች፣ ገጽ 61)፦ (1) 'የኮሮና ቫይረስ በሽታ የሰውን ልጅ የበለጠ ይጎዳል' እና (2) 'ኤች.አይ.ቪ/ኤድስ በጉዳት ይበልጣል' በሚሉት ሐሳቦች ላይ በማስረጃ ተከራከሩ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (7.2 Structured Classroom Debate, p. 61): Debate with evidence whether COVID-19 or HIV/AIDS has caused greater harm to humanity.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 8: Drama (Elements, Comedy vs. Tragedy, and the Play of Worqqa, Ciisha, and Pola)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Full Classroom Drama Dialogue between Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha (pp. 72–75): Pola asks whether education (timirtte) or wealth (shalo) is greater. Worqqa and Ciisha prove that even clean piped water at school to wash hands against COVID-19 and discovering gold/silver come from education, and Worqqa recites the poem 'Timirttey al77obaa / Azallin beettenna...'. Ciisha concludes: 'Kaysoy demmonna, danoy bochenna merinaa shaluwa timirtte eraa shiisha.'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ፉልል ጭለስስሮኦም ድረመ ዲአሎጉእ ቤትዌእን ፖለ፣ ዎርቅቀ፣ አንድ ጪኢሻ (ፕፕ። 72–75)፦ ፖለ አስክስ ውሄꬄር እዱጨቲኦን (ቲሚርትቴ) ኦር ዌአልꬅ (ሻሎ) ኢስ ግሬአቴር። ዎርቅቀ አንድ ጪኢሻ ፕሮቬ ꬃት እቬን ጭሌአን ፒፔድ ወቴር አት ስቾኦል ቶ ወሽ ሀንድስ አገኢንስት ጮቪድ-19 አንድ ዲስጮቬሪንግ ጎልድ/ሲልቬር ጮሜ ፍሮም እዱጨቲኦን፣ አንድ ዎርቅቀ ሬጪቴስ ꬄ ፖእም 'ቲሚርትቴይ አልዕዖበአ / አዘልሊን ቤእትቴንነ።።።'። ጪኢሻ ጮንጭሉዴስ፦ 'ከይሶይ ዴምሞንነ፣ ደኖይ ቦቼንነ ሜሪነአ ሻሉወ ቲሚርትቴ እረአ ሺኢሻ።'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የፖላ፣ የወርቃ እና የጪሻ የተውኔት ምልልስ (ገጽ 72–75)፦ ፖላ ትምህርት ይበልጣል ወይስ ሀብት ብሎ ሲጠይቅ፣ ወርቃና ጪሻ ትምህርት ከሁሉ እንደሚበልጥ በማስረጃና በግጥም ('Timirttey al77obaa...') ያስረዱታል። ጪሻም 'ሌባ የማያገኘውን፣ አደጋ የማይነካውን የዘላለም ሀብት የትምህርት ዕውቀትን ሰብስብ' ብሎ ይመክረዋል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Three-Character Drama Dialogue (Pola, Worqqa, and Ciisha, pp. 72–75): Debating whether education or material wealth is superior, incorporating COVID-19 handwashing awareness and an embedded 9-line poem praising education.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 9: Media and Communication, Report Writing, and Comparative/Contrastive Discourse
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze Nam77a (9.2 Haasayo, p. 78): Prepare and deliver oral radio/TV announcements on: 1. Issi woga ma7o sikkiyaa keetha eriso (Traditional clothing tailoring shop ad); 2. Timirtte keetha dooyetethaanne doometha eriso (School opening announcement); 3. Maxaafe bayziya keethanne imettiya haggaazo (Bookstore service announcement).
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ ነምዕዓ (9።2 ሀአሰዮ፣ ፕ። 78)፦ ፕሬፐሬ አንድ ዴሊቬር ኦረል ረዲኦ/ትቭ አንኖኡንጬሜንትስ ኦን፦ 1። ኢስሲ ዎገ መዖ ሲክኪየአ ኬእꬃ እሪሶ (ትረዲቲኦነል ጭሎꬂንግ ተኢሎሪንግ ሾፕ አድ)፤ 2። ቲሚርትቴ ኬእꬃ ዶኦዬቴꬃአንኔ ዶኦሜꬃ እሪሶ (ስቾኦል ኦፔኒንግ አንኖኡንጬሜንት)፤ 3። መጠአፌ በይዚየ ኬእꬃንኔ ኢሜትቲየ ሀግገአዞ (ቦኦክስቶሬ ሴርቪጬ አንኖኡንጬሜንት)።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (9.2 ንግግር፣ ገጽ 78)፦ የሚዲያ ማስታወቂያ አዘጋጅቶ በቃል ማቅረብ፦ 1. የባህል ልብስ ስፌት ቤት ማስታወቂያ፤ 2. የትምህርት ቤት መከፈቻ ማስታወቂያ፤ 3. የመጻሕፍት መደብር አገልግሎት ማስታወቂያ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (9.2 Oral Media Broadcasts, p. 78): Compose and present oral media advertisements/announcements for a traditional tailoring shop, school opening, or bookstore.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 1: Language and Society, Sign Language Inclusion, and Discourse Connectors
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze 2 (1.B Haasaya, p. 7): Group discussion on 9 questions: 1. Dooni ubbay gineeye gina gidennee? 4. Goofatho doonan tamaaroy iiteeye lo7oo? 6. Goofatho doonaa dichaas oosettida oosota qonccisa. 8. Ha7i wode Goofatho Dooni dicci gakkida dethaa paattite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 2 (1።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 7)፦ ግሮኡፕ ዲስጩስሲኦን ኦን 9 ቁእስቲኦንስ፦ 1። ዶኦኒ ኡብበይ ጊኔእዬ ጊነ ጊዴንኔእ? 4። ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ተመአሮይ ኢኢቴእዬ ሎዖኦ? 6። ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነአ ዲቻአስ ኦኦሴትቲደ ኦኦሶተ ቆንጭጪሰ። 8። ሀዒ ዎዴ ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦኒ ዲጭጪ ገክኪደ ዴꬃአ ፐአትቲቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (1.B ንግግር፣ ገጽ 7)፦ በቡድን ውይይት፦ 1. ሁሉም ቋንቋ እኩል ነው ወይስ አይደለም? 4. በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ መማር ጥሩ ነው ወይስ መጥፎ? 6. ለጎፋኛ ቋንቋ ዕድገት የተሠሩ ሥራዎችን አብራሩ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (1.B Oral Discussion, p. 7): Discuss language equality, the benefits of mother-tongue education in Gofatho, milestones in Gofatho language development, and current status.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 2: Traditional Gofatho Marriage Customs and Sentence Transformations
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Full 22-Turn Dialogue between Students Orzaamo and Murqqenna (2.B Haasaya, pp. 13–14): Orzaamo: 'Beni wode eko gelo wogaabaa neeni eray?' Murqqenna: 'Ee, guuthara erays... Aawaara aayeera zorettidi onttako na7iya lo7o; kochayka lo7o gidi cima yeddoosona... Hessa cimi wurssees gees. "Cimi shi7a muzees" giya tossiyaa si7a erikkii?... Na7iyaa puutto oykkada dakko, gaabe, laxana daddawus. Na7ay keethe keexxidi cumees... Soo ekki gakkishin na7aa aawaay xamaata ekkidi... "Yelettite ayfite, na7a na7as biyi na7as gakkite" gidi anjjees.'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ፉልል 22-ቱርን ዲአሎጉእ ቤትዌእን ስቱዴንትስ ኦርዘአሞ አንድ ሙርቅቄንነ (2።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕፕ። 13–14)፦ ኦርዘአሞ፦ 'ቤኒ ዎዴ እኮ ጌሎ ዎገአበአ ኔእኒ እረይ?' ሙርቅቄንነ፦ 'እእ፣ ጉኡꬃረ እረይስ።።። አአወአረ አአዬእረ ዞሬትቲዲ ኦንትተኮ ነዒየ ሎዖ፤ ኮቻይከ ሎዖ ጊዲ ጪመ ዬድዶኦሶነ።።። ሄስሰ ጪሚ ዉርስሴእስ ጌእስ። "ጪሚ ሺዓ ሙዜእስ" ጊየ ቶስሲየአ ሲዓ እሪክኪኢ?።።። ነዒየአ ፑኡትቶ ኦይክከደ ደክኮ፣ ገአቤ፣ ለጠነ ደድደዉስ። ነዓይ ኬእꬄ ኬእጥጢዲ ጩሜእስ።።። ሶኦ እክኪ ገክኪሺን ነዓአ አአወአይ ጠመአተ እክኪዲ።።። "ዬሌትቲቴ አይፊቴ፣ ነዓ ነዓስ ቢዪ ነዓስ ገክኪቴ" ጊዲ አንጅጄእስ።'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: በተማሪ ኦርዛሞ እና በተማሪ ሙርቄና መካከል የተደረገ ባለ 22 ተራ ምልልስ (ገጽ 13–14)፦ ስለ ጎፋ ባህላዊ ጋብቻ ሽምግልና፣ ስለ ሙሽሪት ጥጥ መፍተልና የሙሽራው ቤት መሥራትና ተክል መትከል (cumees)፣ ስለ ሠርግ (yaagano) እና የሙሽራው አባት በእርጎ (xamaata) እግራቸውን እያነካካ 'ውለዱ ክበዱ፣ ለልጅ ልጅ ድረሱ' ብሎ ስለሚመርቅበት ሥርዓት።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Complete 22-Turn Dialogue between Orzaamo and Murqqenna (pp. 13–14): Detailed conversation covering family lineage vetting, sending elders (laazanthi cima), bride's cotton spinning (qolle/gaabe), groom's house-building and planting (cumo), equestrian wedding procession, and the father's curd-blessing ritual ('Yelettite ayfite').

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 3: Women and Development, Biography of Mishire Amaarachi Aggido, and Full Sentence Syntax
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze 2 (3.B Haasaya, p. 20): Group discussion on 5 topics: 1. Maccatas gade dichaa bolla de7iya gishaaddetethay ay aazii? 2. Maccatasinne attumatas de7iya ginatethaa bolla haasayite. 5. Maccati laames tamaaro koshshiiyee zal77e koshshiyaako odettite.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 2 (3።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 20)፦ ግሮኡፕ ዲስጩስሲኦን ኦን 5 ቶፒጭስ፦ 1። መጭጨተስ ገዴ ዲቻአ ቦልለ ዴዒየ ጊሻአድዴቴꬃይ አይ አአዚኢ? 2። መጭጨተሲንኔ አትቱመተስ ዴዒየ ጊነቴꬃአ ቦልለ ሀአሰዪቴ። 5። መጭጨቲ ለአሜስ ተመአሮ ኮሽሺኢዬእ ዘልዕዔ ኮሽሺየአኮ ኦዴትቲቴ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (3.B ንግግር፣ ገጽ 20)፦ 1. ሴቶች በአገር ልማት ላይ ያላቸው ድርሻ ምን ይመስላል? 2. በሴቶችና በወንዶች እኩልነት ላይ ተወያዩ። 5. ለሴቶች ለውጥ ትምህርት ይሻላል ወይስ ንግድ?
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (3.B Oral Discussion, p. 20): Discuss women's contribution to national development, gender equality, and the role of education and commerce in empowering women.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 4: Unity in Diversity, Federalism, and the Five Parts of Speech (Qaala Kifileta)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Full Dialogue between Morggaama and Gardda (4.B Haasaya, pp. 30–31, by Mokkonna M.): Morggaama: 'Hintte heera asaa issipetethay ay melee?' Gardda: 'La ta new ay odada ay aggoo! Deretethaa giddon daro dummatethay de7ishin wol dandda7on dumma dumma gahettiya bessatan: wudiyaan, giyaan, woosa keethaan, yaaganoninne h.h.mela bessatan dumma dumma metoti medhetteyssata dandda7idi qaari bessonna woli kammidi de7oosona... "Darana deriyan heedzay daggi uyees" giyaa tossiya mela wolli siiqoninne dandda7an duussay keehipe lo77ope attin iita gidenna.'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ፉልል ዲአሎጉእ ቤትዌእን ሞርግገአመ አንድ ገርድደ (4።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕፕ። 30–31፣ ብይ ሞክኮንነ ም።)፦ ሞርግገአመ፦ 'ሂንትቴ ሄእረ አሰአ ኢስሲፔቴꬃይ አይ ሜሌእ?' ገርድደ፦ 'ለ ተ ኔው አይ ኦደደ አይ አግጎኦ! ዴሬቴꬃአ ጊድዶን ደሮ ዱምመቴꬃይ ዴዒሺን ዎል ደንድደዖን ዱምመ ዱምመ ገሄትቲየ ቤስሰተን፦ ዉዲየአን፣ ጊየአን፣ ዎኦሰ ኬእꬃአን፣ የአገኖኒንኔ ህ።ህ።ሜለ ቤስሰተን ዱምመ ዱምመ ሜቶቲ ሜꬌትቴይስሰተ ደንድደዒዲ ቀአሪ ቤስሶንነ ዎሊ ከምሚዲ ዴዖኦሶነ።።። "ደረነ ዴሪየን ሄእꬓይ ደግጊ ኡዬእስ" ጊየአ ቶስሲየ ሜለ ዎልሊ ሲኢቆኒንኔ ደንድደዓን ዱኡስሰይ ኬእሂፔ ሎዕዖፔ አትቲን ኢኢተ ጊዴንነ።'
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: በሞርጋማ እና በጋርዳ መካከል የተደረገ ምልልስ (ገጽ 30–31)፦ ሞርጋማ ስለ አካባቢው ሕዝብ አንድነት ሲጠይቅ፣ ጋርዳ በግጦሽ ቦታ (wudiyaan)፣ በገበያ (giyaan)፣ በጸሎት ቤትና በሠርግ ላይ በመቻቻልና በመከባበር አብረው እንደሚኖሩ 'በሚያድግ አገር ሦስት ሰው ተጋግዞ ይጠጣል' በሚለው ምሳሌያዊ ንግግር ያስረዳዋል።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Dialogue between Morggaama and Gardda (pp. 30–31): Discussing how diverse communities maintain unity in grazing lands, markets, places of worship, and weddings through tolerance (woli dandda7o), mutual respect (wolli bonchetetha), and equality (gina xeelo).

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 5: Gofatho Oral Literature (Dual-Edged Proverbs, Folktales, Riddles, and Poetic Duels)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Sedhemenkke & Qan77ishe Interactive Performance Dialogues (pp. 44–47): Includes the 5-guess rule in Sedhemenkke, the boast formula ('Ta na7ay para bolla pastti ne na7ay xinqilo bolla cistti; ta na7ay xamaata mixilttees ne na7ay giishshi mixilttees'), and Qan77ishe dialogues between Doli & Baloy and Cumppe & Cula.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሴꬌሜንክኬ & ቀንዕዒሼ ኢንቴረጭቲቬ ፔርፎርመንጬ ዲአሎጉእስ (ፕፕ። 44–47)፦ ኢንጭሉዴስ ꬄ 5-ጉእስስ ሩሌ ኢን ሴꬌሜንክኬ፣ ꬄ ቦአስት ፎርሙለ ('ተ ነዓይ ፐረ ቦልለ ፐስትቲ ኔ ነዓይ ጢንቂሎ ቦልለ ጪስትቲ፤ ተ ነዓይ ጠመአተ ሚጢልትቴእስ ኔ ነዓይ ጊኢሽሺ ሚጢልትቴእስ')፣ አንድ ቀንዕዒሼ ዲአሎጉእስ ቤትዌእን ዶሊ & በሎይ አንድ ጩምፕፔ & ጩለ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: የእንቆቅልሽና የቃንጪሼ የተግባር ምልልሶች (ገጽ 44–47)፦ በእንቆቅልሽ መላሹ 5 ጊዜ ከሞከረ በኋላ አገር ሲሰጥ ጠያቂው የሚፎክርበት ሥርዓትና የዶሊና ባሎይ እንዲሁም የጩምፔና ጩላ የቃንጪሼ ምልልስ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Riddle and Poetic Duel Performance Dialogues (pp. 44–47): Full ceremonial dialogue formulas for Sedhemenkke (including the 5-attempt rule and victory boast) and Qan77ishe couplet exchanges.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 6: Role of Elders in Indigenous Conflict Resolution, Letter Writing (Dabddaabbe), and Verb Transitivity
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze 2 (6.B Haasaya Palama, p. 49): Formal debates on 4 topics: 1. Mutual respect vs. harming others; 2. Communal dining and sharing; 3. Honoring elders (Bayrata bonchcho); 4. Indigenous conflict resolution (Gade wogan giigiso) vs. modern court litigation.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 2 (6።ብ ሀአሰየ ፐለመ፣ ፕ። 49)፦ ፎርመል ዴበቴስ ኦን 4 ቶፒጭስ፦ 1። ሙቱአል ሬስፔጭት ቭስ። ሀርሚንግ ኦꬄርስ፤ 2። ጮምሙነል ዲኒንግ አንድ ሻሪንግ፤ 3። ሆኖሪንግ እልዴርስ (በይረተ ቦንችቾ)፤ 4። ኢንዲጌኖኡስ ጮንፍሊጭት ሬሶሉቲኦን (ገዴ ዎገን ጊኢጊሶ) ቭስ። ሞዴርን ጮኡርት ሊቲገቲኦን።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (6.B የክርክር ርዕሶች፣ ገጽ 49)፦ 1. እርስ በርስ መከባበር፤ 2. አብሮ መብላትና መጠጣት፤ 3. ታላላቆችን ማክበር፤ 4. ባህላዊ የዕርቅ ሥርዓት ከዘመናዊ ፍርድ ቤት ጋር ሲነጻጸር።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (6.B Classroom Debates, p. 49): Debate the merits of indigenous elder mediation (Dubbusha/Gozdda) compared to formal court litigation.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 7: The Novel (Extended Fiction, Plot, Physical vs. Psychological Conflict, and Narrative Point of View)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: First-Person & Dramatic Narrative Excerpts from Ayyala Gabayo's Novel 'Biqqala' (pp. 69–70): Showcasing Koyro Moode Haasgina ('Taani yaanas; nuuni yaanida') and Diraama Haasgina (dialogue-driven dramatic narration).
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ፊርስት-ፔርሶን & ድረመቲጭ ነርረቲቬ እጥጬርፕትስ ፍሮም አይየለ ገበዮ'ስ ኖቬል 'ቢቅቀለ' (ፕፕ። 69–70)፦ ሾውጨሲንግ ኮይሮ ሞኦዴ ሀአስጊነ ('ተአኒ የአነስ፤ ኑኡኒ የአኒደ') አንድ ዲረአመ ሀአስጊነ (ዲአሎጉእ-ድሪቬን ድረመቲጭ ነርረቲኦን)።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: ከአያሌው ገበየሁ 'ቢቃላ' ልቦለድ የተወሰዱ የአንደኛ መደብና የተውኔታዊ አንጻር ምልልሶች (ገጽ 69–70)።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Literary Excerpts from Ayyala Gabayo's Novel 'Biqqala' (pp. 69–70): Illustrating First-Person Point of View (Koyro Moode Haasgina) and Dramatic Point of View (Diraama Haasgina).

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 8: Social Media, Argumentative Essay ('Muussinne Ushshi'), and Verb Tenses (Aadhode, Ha7ode, Sinthode)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze 2 (8.B Haasaya Palama, p. 74): Four classroom debates: 1. Telebizhine vs. Iraadoone; 2. Moobayle vs. Soo silkke (Mobile phone vs. landline); 3. Postta vs. Imeele (Postal mail vs. Email); 4. Beni wode miidiya vs. Ha77i wode miidiya.
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 2 (8።ብ ሀአሰየ ፐለመ፣ ፕ። 74)፦ ፎኡር ጭለስስሮኦም ዴበቴስ፦ 1። ቴሌቢዢኔ ቭስ። ኢረአዶኦኔ፤ 2። ሞኦበይሌ ቭስ። ሶኦ ሲልክኬ (ሞቢሌ ፆኔ ቭስ። ለንድሊኔ)፤ 3። ፖስትተ ቭስ። ኢሜእሌ (ፖስተል መኢል ቭስ። እመኢል)፤ 4። ቤኒ ዎዴ ሚኢዲየ ቭስ። ሀዕዒ ዎዴ ሚኢዲየ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (8.B የክርክር ርዕሶች፣ ገጽ 74)፦ 1. ቴሌቪዥንና ሬዲዮ፤ 2. ሞባይል ስልክና የቤት ስልክ፤ 3. ፖስታና ኢሜይል፤ 4. የድሮና የዘመኑ ሚዲያ።
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (8.B Structured Debates, p. 74): Debate Television vs. Radio, Mobile Phone vs. Landline, Postal Mail vs. Email, and Traditional vs. Modern Media.

textbook_dialogues_haasaya.topic_english: Chapter 9: Entrepreneurship, Overcoming Poverty, and Active vs. Passive Voice (Os-meqo & Ost-meqo)
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_latin: Meeze 2 (9.B Haasaya, p. 82): Pair and group discussion on 6 questions: 1. Issi asi waani duretanaw dandda7iyaakko tobbite. 2. Wode suuren go7etetharanne ooso medhora waani gahettiyaako haasayite. 6. Tamaari wurssidi kawo ooso oothiko lo7ooye ooso medhdhi oothiko lo7oo?
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.gofatho_fidel: ሜእዜ 2 (9።ብ ሀአሰየ፣ ፕ። 82)፦ ፐኢር አንድ ግሮኡፕ ዲስጩስሲኦን ኦን 6 ቁእስቲኦንስ፦ 1። ኢስሲ አሲ ወአኒ ዱሬተነው ደንድደዒየአክኮ ቶብቢቴ። 2። ዎዴ ሱኡሬን ጎዔቴꬃረንኔ ኦኦሶ ሜꬎረ ወአኒ ገሄትቲየአኮ ሀአሰዪቴ። 6። ተመአሪ ዉርስሲዲ ከዎ ኦኦሶ ኦኦꬂኮ ሎዖኦዬ ኦኦሶ ሜꬍꬊ ኦኦꬂኮ ሎዖኦ?
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.amharic: መልመጃ 2 (9.B ንግግር፣ ገጽ 82)፦ 1. አንድ ሰው እንዴት ሊበለጽግ እንደሚችል ተወያዩ። 2. የጊዜ አጠቃቀምና ሥራ ፈጠራ እንዴት እንደሚገናኙ ተነጋገሩ። 6. ተምሮ ከጨረሱ በኋላ የመንግሥት ሥራ መጠበቅ ይሻላል ወይስ የራስ ሥራ መፍጠር?
textbook_dialogues_haasaya.english: Exercise 2 (9.B Oral Discussion, p. 82): Discuss pathways to prosperity, time management in entrepreneurship, and self-employment vs. waiting for government employment after graduation.

chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_gofatho_latin: Saro! Ufayssan mokkays. Goofatho doona tamaaranaw koyro galla galla sarothota ('Saro pe7adii?', 'Saro aqadii?') nne SOV qaalaara gahetetha ('Taani Goofatho tamaarays') meezeta.
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_gofatho_fidel: ሰሮ! ኡፈይስሰን ሞክከይስ። ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነ ተመአረነው ኮይሮ ገልለ ገልለ ሰሮꬆተ ('ሰሮ ፔዓዲኢ?'፣ 'ሰሮ አቀዲኢ?') ንኔ ሶV ቀአለአረ ገሄቴꬃ ('ተአኒ ጎኦፈꬆ ተመአረይስ') ሜእዜተ።
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_amharic: ሰላም! በደስታ እቀበልሃለሁ። የጎፋኛ ቋንቋን ለመማር በመጀመሪያ የዕለት ተዕለት ሰላምታዎችን («ሳሮ ፔዓዲ?»፣ «ሳሮ አቃዲ?») እና የባለቤት-ተሳቢ-ግስ (SOV) ዓረፍተ ነገር አወቃቀርን («ታኒ ጎፋꬶ ተማራይስ») ተለማመድ።
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_english: Hello! I welcome you with joy. To learn the Gofatho language, first practice everyday greetings ('Saro pe7adii?', 'Saro aqadii?') and SOV sentence structure ('Taani Goofatho tamaarays' = I learn Gofatho).
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.grammar_and_tone_notes: SOV order: Subject (Taani) + Object (Goofatho doona) + Purposive Infinitive (tamaar-anaw) + Finite Verb (koy-ays, PRES.1S).

chat_voice_assistant_sessions.user_input_text: Minniyaanne leppiya qaalati aybee? Leemiso taassi oda.
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.rag_retrieved_sources_json: ["Gemination Lab: tama vs tamma, gita vs gitta, lo7o vs lo77o", "Grade 9 Ch. 1: Goofatho Doona Xaafo Hiillata"]
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_gofatho_latin: Goofatho doonan minniyaa (geminated) nne leppiya (singleton) gathati birshshetha laammoosona: leemisos, 'tama' (fire / እሳት) leppiya, shin 'tamma' (ten / አሥር) minniyaa; 'gita' (big / ትልቅ) leppiya, shin 'gitta' (equal / እኩል) minniyaa.
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_gofatho_fidel: ጎኦፈꬆ ዶኦነን ሚንኒየአ (ጌሚነቴድ) ንኔ ሌፕፒየ (ሲንግሌቶን) ገꬃቲ ቢርሽሼꬃ ለአምሞኦሶነ፦ ሌእሚሶስ፣ 'ተመ' (ፊሬ) ሌፕፒየ፣ ሺን 'ተምመ' (ቴን) ሚንኒየአ፤ 'ጊተ' (ቢግ) ሌፕፒየ፣ ሺን 'ጊትተ' (እቁአል) ሚንኒየአ።
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_amharic: በጎፋኛ ቋንቋ የሚጠብቁ (Minniyaa) እና የሚላሉ (Leppiya) ተነባቢ ፊደላት ትርጉም ይቀይራሉ፦ ለምሳሌ «tama» (እሳት) የላላ ሲሆን «tamma» (አሥር) የጠበቀ ነው፤ «gita» (ትልቅ) የላላ ሲሆን «gitta» (እኩል) የጠበቀ ነው።
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_english: In Gofatho, geminated (minniyaa) vs. singleton (leppiya) consonants change word meaning: for example, 'tama' (fire) is singleton, while 'tamma' (ten) is geminated; 'gita' (big) is singleton, while 'gitta' (equal) is geminated.
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.grammar_and_tone_notes: Geminate consonants hold 1.85x closure duration in Sherpa-ONNX VITS synthesis; digraphs double only the first letter (chch, shsh, dhdh, thth).

chat_voice_assistant_sessions.user_input_text: Analyze 'meddaawaynne meddaayiya soofe bidosona' word by word.
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.rag_retrieved_sources_json: ["Sellassie Cheru (2015) IGT-04 (Ch. 5, ex. 107a, p. 116)", "Rule MP-09/10: Feminine Glide Epenthesis"]
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_gofatho_latin: Ha qofay Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 116) IGT-04: 'meddaawa-y-nne' (groom-NOM.M.DEF-and) + 'meddaayi-ya' (< meddaayo + -e-j-a, bride-NOM.F.DEF via MP-09/10) + 'soofe' (wedding feast) + 'b-idosona' (go-PAST.3PL.A.DCL).
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_gofatho_fidel: ሀ ቆፈይ ሴልለስሲእ ቼሩ (2015፣ ፕ። 116) ኢግት-04፦ ሜድደአወይንኔ ሜድደአዪየ ሶኦፌ ቢዶሶነ።
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_amharic: ይህ ዓረፍተ ነገር ከSellassie Cheru (2015, ገጽ 116) የተወሰደ ነው፦ «meddaawa-y-nne» (ሙሽራውና) + «meddaayi-ya» (ሙሽሪት፣ የሴት ባለቤት ቅጥያ -iya) + «soofe» (ወደ ሠርግ ግብዣ) + «b-idosona» (ሄዱ - የብዙ ቁጥር ኃላፊ ጊዜ)።
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.assistant_english: This sentence is IGT-04 from Sellassie Cheru (2015, p. 116): 'meddaawa-y-nne' (the groom and) + 'meddaayi-ya' (the bride, feminine definite nominative via MP-09/10) + 'soofe' (to the wedding party) + 'b-idosona' (they went).
chat_voice_assistant_sessions.grammar_and_tone_notes: Demonstrates masculine definite nominative (-y) coordinated via -nne with feminine definite nominative (-iya < -e-j-a) triggering 3PL verb agreement (-idosona).

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Koyro doomman Xoossi saluwaanne sa7aa medhdhis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኮይሮ ዶኦምመን ጦኦስሲ ሰሉወአንኔ ሰዓአ ሜꬍꬊስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በመጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔር ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጠረ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Sa7aykka bessennaanne mela de7ees; dhoqqu giida haathaa bollan dhuma de7ees; Xoossaa Ayyaanaykka haathaa bollan yuuyees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሰዓይክከ ቤስሴንነአንኔ ሜለ ዴዔእስ፤ ꬎቅቁ ጊኢደ ሀአꬃአ ቦልለን ꬉመ ዴዔእስ፤ ጦኦስሰአ አይየአነይክከ ሀአꬃአ ቦልለን ዩኡዬእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ምድሪቱም ባዶ ነበረች፥ አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ጨለማም በጥልቁ ላይ ነበረ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በውኃ ላይ ይሰፍፍ ነበር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Now the earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep. God's Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi, "Poo7oy hano" giis; poo7oykka hanis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ፣ "ፖኦዖይ ሀኖ" ጊኢስ፤ ፖኦዖይክከ ሀኒስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም፦ ብርሃን ይሁን አለ፤ ብርሃንም ሆነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi poo7oy lo77o gideyssa be7is; Xoossi poo7uwaanne dhumaa shaakkis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዖይ ሎዕዖ ጊዴይስሰ ቤዒስ፤ ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዑወአንኔ ꬉመአ ሻአክኪስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑንና ጨለማውን ለየ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi poo7uwaa "Gallassa" giidi xeegis; dhumaakka "Qamma" giidi xeegis. Omarssay hanis, guuraykka hanis; koyro gallassa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዑወአ "ገልለስሰ" ጊኢዲ ጤእጊስ፤ ꬉመአክከ "ቀምመ" ጊኢዲ ጤእጊስ። ኦመርስሰይ ሀኒስ፣ ጉኡረይክከ ሀኒስ፤ ኮይሮ ገልለስሰ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑን ቀን ብሎ ጠራው፥ ጨለማውንም ሌሊት አለው። ማታም ሆነ ጧትም ሆነ፥ አንደኛ ቀን።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God called the light "day", and the darkness he called "night". There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi, "Nuuni asaa nu leemisuwan, نuna milatethaan medhdhoos" giis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ፣ "ኑኡኒ አሰአ ኑ ሌእሚሱወን፣ نኡነ ሚለቴꬃአን ሜꬍꬎኦስ" ጊኢስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም አለ፦ ሰውን በመልካችን እንደ ምሳሌአችን እንፍጠር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said, "Let's make man in our image, after our likeness."

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi asaa ba leemisuwan medhdhis; Xoossaa leemisuwan iya medhdhis; attuma asanne macca asa oothidi entta medhdhis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ አሰአ በ ሌእሚሱወን ሜꬍꬊስ፤ ጦኦስሰአ ሌእሚሱወን ኢየ ሜꬍꬊስ፤ አትቱመ አሰንኔ መጭጨ አሰ ኦኦꬂዲ እንትተ ሜꬍꬊስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውን በመልኩ ፈጠረ፤ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ፈጠረው፤ ወንድና ሴት አድርጎ ፈጠራቸው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi ba medhdhidobaa ubbaa be7is; be7ishin, keehippe lo77o.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ በ ሜꬍꬊዶበአ ኡብበአ ቤዒስ፤ ቤዒሺን፣ ኬእሂፕፔ ሎዕዖ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ያደረገውን ሁሉ አየ፥ እነሆም፥ እጅግ መልካም ነበረ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday Abraama, "Ne biittaappe, ne dabbotaappenne ne aawaa keettaappe kiyada taani nena bessana biittaa ba" giis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ አብረአመ፣ "ኔ ቢኢትተአፕፔ፣ ኔ ደብቦተአፕፔንኔ ኔ አአወአ ኬእትተአፕፔ ኪየደ ተአኒ ኔነ ቤስሰነ ቢኢትተአ በ" ጊኢስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም አብራምን አለው፦ ከአገርህ ከዘመዶችህም ከአባትህም ቤት ተለይተህ እኔ ወደማሳይህ ምድር ውጣ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Now the LORD said to Abram, "Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father's house, and go to the land that I will show you."

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani nena gita dere oothana; nena anjjana; ne sunthaakkaXoqqissana; neeni anjjo gidana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ኔነ ጊተ ዴሬ ኦኦꬃነ፤ ኔነ አንጅጀነ፤ ኔ ሱንꬃአክከጦቅቂስሰነ፤ ኔእኒ አንጅጆ ጊደነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ታላቅ ሕዝብም አደርግሃለሁ፥ እባርክሃለሁም፥ ስምህንም አከብራለሁ፤ ለበረከትም ሁን።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi Muuse, "TAANI DE7IYAAGAA" giis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ሙኡሴ፣ "ተአኒ ዴዒየአገአ" ጊኢስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን፦ እኔ ያለሁና የምኖር ነኝ አለው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM."

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi ha qaalata ubbaa haasayidi hagaadaa giis:
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ሀ ቀአለተ ኡብበአ ሀአሰዪዲ ሀገአደአ ጊኢስ፦
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም እነዚህን ቃሎች ሁሉ ተናገረ እንዲህም አለ፦
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God spoke all these words, saying:

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani nena Gibxxe biittaappe, aylletethaa keettaappe kessida Godaa ne Xoossaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ኔነ ጊብጥጤ ቢኢትተአፕፔ፣ አይልሌቴꬃአ ኬእትተአፕፔ ኬስሲደ ጎደአ ኔ ጦኦስሰአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday ne Xoossay nees immiya biittan ne laythay adussana mela, ne aawaanne ne aayee bonchcha.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ኔ ጦኦስሰይ ኔእስ ኢምሚየ ቢኢትተን ኔ ለይꬃይ አዱስሰነ ሜለ፣ ኔ አአወአንኔ ኔ አአዬእ ቦንችቻ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በሚሰጥህ ምድር ዕድሜህ እንዲረዝም አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Isra7eelee, siya! Goday nu Xoossay issi Godaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢስረዔእሌእ፣ ሲየ! ጎደይ ኑ ጦኦስሰይ ኢስሲ ጎደአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር አንድ እግዚአብሔር ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Hear, Israel: the LORD is our God; the LORD is one.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Godaanne ne Xoossaa ne kumetha wozanaappe, ne kumetha shemppuwaappenne ne kumetha wolqqaappe siiqa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደአንኔ ኔ ጦኦስሰአ ኔ ኩሜꬃ ዎዘነአፕፔ፣ ኔ ኩሜꬃ ሼምፕፑወአፕፔንኔ ኔ ኩሜꬃ ዎልቅቀአፕፔ ሲኢቀ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: አንተም አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ በፍጹምም ኃይልህ ውደድ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani nena azazabiikkinaa? Minna, xala; yayyoppa, dagammoppa; ayssi giikko, neeni biyaaso ubban Goday ne Xoossay neera de7ees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ኔነ አዘዘቢኢክኪነአ? ሚንነ፣ ጠለ፤ የይዮፕፐ፣ ደገምሞፕፐ፤ አይስሲ ጊኢክኮ፣ ኔእኒ ቢየአሶ ኡብበን ጎደይ ኔ ጦኦስሰይ ኔእረ ዴዔእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እነሆ፥ አዘዝሁህ፤ ጽና፥ አይዞህ፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በምትሄድበት ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነውና።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Haven't I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don't be afraid. Don't be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Asay bolla bagga xeellees, shin Goday wozanaa xeellees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: አሰይ ቦልለ በግገ ጤእልሌእስ፣ ሺን ጎደይ ዎዘነአ ጤእልሌእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሰው ፊትን ያያል፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን ልብን ያያል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani ta Wozanchchay de7eyssa erais; wurssethanikka i sa7aa bollan eqqana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ተ ዎዘንችቻይ ዴዔይስሰ እረኢስ፤ ዉርስሴꬃኒክከ ኢ ሰዓአ ቦልለን እቅቀነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እኔ ግን ወዳጄ ሕያው እንደ ሆነ፥ በመጨረሻም ዘመን በምድር ላይ እንደሚቆም አውቃለሁ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Iita asata zoriyaa kaallonna, nagaraanchchata ogiyan eqqonna, qilliicciyaageeta uttethaan uttonna uray anjjettidaagaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢኢተ አሰተ ዞሪየአ ከአልሎንነ፣ ነገረአንችቻተ ኦጊየን እቅቆንነ፣ ቂልሊኢጭጪየአጌእተ ኡትቴꬃአን ኡትቶንነ ኡረይ አንጅጄትቲደአገአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ምክርን በክፉዎች ያልሄደ፥ በኃጢአተኞችም መንገድ ያልቆመ፥ በዋዘኞችም ወንበር ያልተቀመጠ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand in the way of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Shin iya ufayssay Godaa wogaa bollan de7ees; gallassanne qamma iya wogaa qoppees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሺን ኢየ ኡፈይስሰይ ጎደአ ዎገአ ቦልለን ዴዔእስ፤ ገልለስሰንኔ ቀምመ ኢየ ዎገአ ቆፕፔእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ደስ ይለዋል፥ ሕጉንም በቀንና በሌሊት ያሰላስላል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But his delight is in the LORD's law. On his law he meditates day and night.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday tana heemmiyaagaa; taw aynne paccenna.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ተነ ሄእምሚየአገአ፤ ተው አይንኔ ፐጭጬንነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔር እረኛዬ ነው፥ የሚያሳጣኝም የለም።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: The LORD is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Irxxa maataa bollan tana zin77issees; shemppissiya haathaakko tana kaallees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢርጥጠ መአተአ ቦልለን ተነ ዚንዕዒስሴእስ፤ ሼምፕፒስሲየ ሀአꬃአክኮ ተነ ከአልሌእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በለመለመ መስክ ያሳድረኛል፤ በዕረፍት ውኃ ዘንድ ይመራኛል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta shemppuwaa zaareedis; ba sunthaa gishsho xillotethaa ogiyan tana kaallees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ ሼምፕፑወአ ዘአሬእዲስ፤ በ ሱንꬃአ ጊሽሾ ጢልሎቴꬃአ ኦጊየን ተነ ከአልሌእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ነፍሴን ይመልሳታል፥ ስለ ስሙም በጽድቅ መንገድ ይመራኛል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Hayqoribay dhumaa wombban taani hamuttikkokka, neeni taara de7iya gishsho, taani iitabaa yayykke; ne xam77ayinne ne gaththay tana minthethoosona.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሀይቆሪበይ ꬉመአ ዎምብበን ተአኒ ሀሙትቲክኮክከ፣ ኔእኒ ተአረ ዴዒየ ጊሽሾ፣ ተአኒ ኢኢተበአ የይይክኬ፤ ኔ ጠምዕዓዪንኔ ኔ ገꬅꬃይ ተነ ሚንꬄꬆኦሶነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በሞት ጥላ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ነህና ክፉን አልፈራም፤ በትርህና ምርኩዝህ እነርሱ ያጽናኑኛል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta morkketa sinthan taassi maaddaa giigissadasa; ta huuphiyaa zaytiyan tiyadasa; ta xuu7ay kumidi palahees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ ሞርክኬተ ሲንꬃን ተአስሲ መአድደአ ጊኢጊስሰደሰ፤ ተ ሁኡጪየአ ዘይቲየን ቲየደሰ፤ ተ ጡኡዓይ ኩሚዲ ፐለሄእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በፊቴ ገበታን አዘጋጀህልኝ በጠላቶቼ ፊት ለፊት፤ ራሴን በዘይት ቀባህ፥ ጽዋዬም የተረፈ ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Tumuppe ta de7o laytha ubban lo77otethaynne maarotethay tana kaallana; taanikka Godaa keettan merinaw de7ana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ቱሙፕፔ ተ ዴዖ ለይꬃ ኡብበን ሎዕዖቴꬃይንኔ መአሮቴꬃይ ተነ ከአልለነ፤ ተአኒክከ ጎደአ ኬእትተን ሜሪነው ዴዓነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ቸርነትህና ምሕረትህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ ይከተሉኛል፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD's house forever.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi nuussi baqataa keettanne wolqqa; metuwaa wodiyan eesotidi demettiya maaddiyaagaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ኑኡስሲ በቀተአ ኬእትተንኔ ዎልቅቀ፤ ሜቱወአ ዎዲየን እእሶቲዲ ዴሜትቲየ መአድዲየአገአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: አምላካችን መጠጊያና ኃይል፥ ባገኘንም በታላቅ መከራ ረዳት ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ne qaalay ta tohuwas xomppenne ta ogiyas poo7o.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኔ ቀአለይ ተ ቶሁወስ ጦምፕፔንኔ ተ ኦጊየስ ፖኦዖ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሕግህ ለእግሬ መብራት፥ ለመንገዴም ብርሃን ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani ta ayfiyaa deriyaakko pude denthais; ta maaddoy awuppe yaanee?
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ተ አይፊየአ ዴሪየአክኮ ፑዴ ዴንꬃኢስ፤ ተ መአድዶይ አዉፕፔ የአኔእ?
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ዓይኖቼን ወደ ተራሮች አነሣሁ፤ ረዳቴ ከወዴት ይመጣል?
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta maaddoy saluwaanne sa7aa medhdhida Godaappe yees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ መአድዶይ ሰሉወአንኔ ሰዓአ ሜꬍꬊደ ጎደአፕፔ ዬእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ረዳቴ ሰማይንና ምድርን ከሠራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Godaa yayyoy eratethaa doomma; eeyyati aadhdhida eratethaanne seeraa kadhdhoosona.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደአ የይዮይ እረቴꬃአ ዶኦምመ፤ እእይየቲ አአꬍꬊደ እረቴꬃአንኔ ሴእረአ ከꬍꬎኦሶነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፤ ሰነፎች ግን ጥበብንና ተግሣጽን ይንቃሉ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ne kumetha wozanaappe Godan ammanetta; ne akeekan zemppoppa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኔ ኩሜꬃ ዎዘነአፕፔ ጎደን አምመኔትተ፤ ኔ አኬእከን ዜምፕፖፕፐ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በፍጹም ልብህ በእግዚአብሔር ታመን፥ በራስህም ማስተዋል አትደገፍ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ne ogiyaa ubban iya era; ikka ne ogiyaa suuthana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኔ ኦጊየአ ኡብበን ኢየ እረ፤ ኢክከ ኔ ኦጊየአ ሱኡꬃነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በመንገድህ ሁሉ እርሱን እወቅ፥ እርሱም ጎዳናህን ያቀናልሃል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ashkke zaaroy hanqquwaa zarxxissees; shin qohiya qaalay hanqquwaa denthees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: አሽክኬ ዘአሮይ ሀንቅቁወአ ዘርጥጢስሴእስ፤ ሺን ቆሂየ ቀአለይ ሀንቅቁወአ ዴንꬄእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: የለዘበች መልስ ቍጣን ትመልሳለች፤ ግዙፍ ቃል ግን ቍጣን ያስነሣል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Saluwaappe garssan de7iyaabaa ubbas wodey de7ees; ooso ubbaskka saatey de7ees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሰሉወአፕፔ ገርስሰን ዴዒየአበአ ኡብበስ ዎዴይ ዴዔእስ፤ ኦኦሶ ኡብበስክከ ሰአቴይ ዴዔእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ለሁሉ ዘመን አለው፥ ከሰማይም በታች ለሆነ ነገር ሁሉ ጊዜ አለው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Nuussi na7ay yelettis; attuma na7aykka nuussi imettis; kawotethay iya hashiyaa bollan gidana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኑኡስሲ ነዓይ ዬሌትቲስ፤ አትቱመ ነዓይክከ ኑኡስሲ ኢሜትቲስ፤ ከዎቴꬃይ ኢየ ሀሺየአ ቦልለን ጊደነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሕፃን ተወልዶልናልና፥ ወንድ ልጅም ተሰጥቶናልና፤ አለቅነትም በጫንቃው ላይ ይሆናል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Shin Godaa naagiyaageeti bantta wolqqaa oorathissoosona; argganthaa mala qefiyan pude paalloosona; woxxidi daafurokkona; hamuttidikka laafokkona.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሺን ጎደአ ነአጊየአጌእቲ በንትተ ዎልቅቀአ ኦኦረꬂስሶኦሶነ፤ አርግገንꬃአ መለ ቄፊየን ፑዴ ፐአልሎኦሶነ፤ ዎጥጢዲ ደአፉሮክኮነ፤ ሀሙትቲዲክከ ለአፎክኮነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርን በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ ግን ኃይላቸውን ያድሳሉ፤ እንደ ንስር በክንፍ ይወጣሉ፤ ይሮጣሉ፥ አይታክቱም፤ ይሄዳሉ፥ አይደክሙም።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Shin i nuooruwaa gishsho madhettis; nu nagaraa gishsho qoxettis; nuussi sarotethaa ehiya qaxxay iya bollan hanis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሺን ኢ ኑኦኦሩወአ ጊሽሾ መꬌትቲስ፤ ኑ ነገረአ ጊሽሾ ቆጤትቲስ፤ ኑኡስሲ ሰሮቴꬃአ እሂየ ቀጥጠይ ኢየ ቦልለን ሀኒስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እርሱ ግን ስለ መተላለፋችን ቆሰለ፥ ስለ በደላችንም ደቀቀ፤ የደኅንነታችንም ተግሣጽ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday hagaadaa gees: "Taani intteyyo qoppiya qofaa erais; intteyyo sinththappe hidootaa immanaassa sarotethaa qofaappe attin, iita qofa gidenna."
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ሀገአደአ ጌእስ፦ "ተአኒ ኢንትቴይዮ ቆፕፒየ ቆፈአ እረኢስ፤ ኢንትቴይዮ ሲንꬅꬃፕፔ ሂዶኦተአ ኢምመነአስሰ ሰሮቴꬃአ ቆፈአፕፔ አትቲን፣ ኢኢተ ቆፈ ጊዴንነ።"
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ለእናንተ የማስባትን አሳብ እኔ አውቃለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ፍጻሜና ተስፋ እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ የሰላም አሳብ ነው እንጂ የክፉ ነገር አይደለም።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossaa sunthay merinaappe merinaa gakkanaw anjjetto; ayssi giikko, eratethaynne wolqqay iyaabaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሰአ ሱንꬃይ ሜሪነአፕፔ ሜሪነአ ገክከነው አንጅጄትቶ፤ አይስሲ ጊኢክኮ፣ እረቴꬃይንኔ ዎልቅቀይ ኢየአበአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ጥበብና ኃይል ለእርሱ ነውና የእግዚአብሔር ስም ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ይባረክ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Asao, lo77obay aybakko i nena bessis; pirddaa suuthanaappe, maarotethaa siiqanaappenne ne Xoossaara ashkketethaan hamuttanaappe attin, Goday neeppe koyiyabay aybee?
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: አሰኦ፣ ሎዕዖበይ አይበክኮ ኢ ኔነ ቤስሲስ፤ ፒርድደአ ሱኡꬃነአፕፔ፣ መአሮቴꬃአ ሲኢቀነአፕፔንኔ ኔ ጦኦስሰአረ አሽክኬቴꬃአን ሀሙትተነአፕፔ አትቲን፣ ጎደይ ኔእፕፔ ኮዪየበይ አይቤእ?
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሰው ሆይ፥ መልካሙ ምንድር እንደ ሆነ አሳይቶሃል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ የሚሻው ምንድር ነው? ፍርድን ታደርግ ዘንድ፥ ምሕረትንም ትወድድ ዘንድ፥ ከአምላክህም ጋር በትሕትና ትሄድ ዘንድ አይደለምን?
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta keettan qumay de7ana mela, asirataa ubbaa miishshaa keettaa ehiite.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ ኬእትተን ቁመይ ዴዓነ ሜለ፣ አሲረተአ ኡብበአ ሚኢሽሻአ ኬእትተአ እሂኢቴ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በቤቴ ውስጥ መብል እንዲሆን አሥራቱን ሁሉ ወደ ጎተራ አግቡ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday ta poo7onne ta atotethaa; taani oona yayyanee?
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ተ ፖኦዖንኔ ተ አቶቴꬃአ፤ ተአኒ ኦኦነ የይየኔእ?
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔር ብርሃኔና መድኃኒቴ ነው፤ የሚያስፈራኝ ማን ነው?
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear?

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday lo77o gideyssa xeellite, be7ite; iya bolla zemppiya uray anjjettidaagaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ሎዕዖ ጊዴይስሰ ጤእልሊቴ፣ ቤዒቴ፤ ኢየ ቦልለ ዜምፕፒየ ኡረይ አንጅጄትቲደአገአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔር ቸር እንደ ሆነ ቅመሱ እዩም፤ በእርሱ የሚታመን ሰው ምስጉን ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Sa7aa asaa ubbao, Godaas ufayssan ilillite!
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሰዓአ አሰአ ኡብበኦ፣ ጎደአስ ኡፈይስሰን ኢሊልሊቴ!
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ!
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the lands!

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Godaas ufayssan oothite; mazamuriyan iya sinthaa yiite!
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደአስ ኡፈይስሰን ኦኦꬂቴ፤ መዘሙሪየን ኢየ ሲንꬃአ ዪኢቴ!
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በደስታ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዙ፥ በሐሴትም ወደ ፊቱ ግቡ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta shemppuwao, Godaa galata; ta giddon de7iya ubbabaykka iya geeshsha sunthaa galato!
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ ሼምፕፑወኦ፣ ጎደአ ገለተ፤ ተ ጊድዶን ዴዒየ ኡብበበይክከ ኢየ ጌእሽሻ ሱንꬃአ ገለቶ!
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፥ አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ፥ የተቀደሰ ስሙን።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday medhdhido gallassay hagaa; ha gallassan nuuni ufayttoosinne hashshu goos.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ሜꬍꬊዶ ገልለስሰይ ሀገአ፤ ሀ ገልለስሰን ኑኡኒ ኡፈይትቶኦሲንኔ ሀሽሹ ጎኦስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔር የሠራት ቀን ይህች ናት፤ ሐሴትን እናድርግ፥ በእርስዋም ደስ ይበለን።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ishati issippetethaan de7iyoogee ayba lo77onne ayba ufayssiyaabee!
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢሻቲ ኢስሲፕፔቴꬃአን ዴዒዮኦጌእ አይበ ሎዕዖንኔ አይበ ኡፈይስሲየአቤእ!
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ወንድሞች በኅብረት ቢቀመጡ፥ እነሆ፥ መልካም ነው፥ እነሆም፥ ያማረ ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Shemppoy de7iyo ubbabay Godaa galato! Halleluuya!
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሼምፕፖይ ዴዒዮ ኡብበበይ ጎደአ ገለቶ! ሀልሌሉኡየ!
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እስትንፋስ ያለው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግን። ሃሌ ሉያ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Eratethay ubbabaappe aadhdhees; eratethaa demma; ne demmido ubbabaankka akeekaa demma.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: እረቴꬃይ ኡብበበአፕፔ አአꬍꬌእስ፤ እረቴꬃአ ዴምመ፤ ኔ ዴምሚዶ ኡብበበአንክከ አኬእከአ ዴምመ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ጥበብ ዓይነተኛ ነገር ናትና ጥበብን አግኝ፤ ከማግኘትህም ሁሉ ማስተዋልን አግኝ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ixoy ooshshaa denthees, shin siiqoy nagaraa ubbaa kammees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢጦይ ኦኦሽሻአ ዴንꬄእስ፣ ሺን ሲኢቆይ ነገረአ ኡብበአ ከምሜእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ጥል ክርክርን ያስነሣል፤ ፍቅር ግን ኃጢአትን ሁሉ ትከድናለች።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ne oosuwaa Godaas aathada imma; ne qofaykka polettana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኔ ኦኦሱወአ ጎደአስ አአꬃደ ኢምመ፤ ኔ ቆፈይክከ ፖሌትተነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሥራህን ለእግዚአብሔር አደራ ስጥ፥ አሳብህም ትጸናለች።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Na7aa i baana bessiya ogiyan tamaarissa; cimidiikka hegaappe shaakettenna.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ነዓአ ኢ በአነ ቤስሲየ ኦጊየን ተመአሪስሰ፤ ጪሚዲኢክከ ሄገአፕፔ ሻአኬትቴንነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሕፃኑን በሚሄድበት መንገድ ምራው፥ በሸመገለም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ፈቀቅ አይልም።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Sa7aykka bessennaanne mela de7ees; dhoqqu giida haathaa bollan dhuma de7ees; Xoossaa Ayyaanaykka haathaa bollan yuuyees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሰዓይክከ ቤስሴንነአንኔ ሜለ ዴዔእስ፤ ꬎቅቁ ጊኢደ ሀአꬃአ ቦልለን ꬉመ ዴዔእስ፤ ጦኦስሰአ አይየአነይክከ ሀአꬃአ ቦልለን ዩኡዬእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ምድሪቱም ባዶ ነበረች፥ አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ጨለማም በጥልቁ ላይ ነበረ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በውኃ ላይ ይሰፍፍ ነበር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Now the earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep. God's Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi, "Poo7oy hano" giis; poo7oykka hanis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ፣ "ፖኦዖይ ሀኖ" ጊኢስ፤ ፖኦዖይክከ ሀኒስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም፦ ብርሃን ይሁን አለ፤ ብርሃንም ሆነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi poo7oy lo77o gideyssa be7is; Xoossi poo7uwaanne dhumaa shaakkis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዖይ ሎዕዖ ጊዴይስሰ ቤዒስ፤ ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዑወአንኔ ꬉመአ ሻአክኪስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑንና ጨለማውን ለየ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi poo7uwaa "Gallassa" giidi xeegis; dhumaakka "Qamma" giidi xeegis. Omarssay hanis, guuraykka hanis; koyro gallassa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዑወአ "ገልለስሰ" ጊኢዲ ጤእጊስ፤ ꬉመአክከ "ቀምመ" ጊኢዲ ጤእጊስ። ኦመርስሰይ ሀኒስ፣ ጉኡረይክከ ሀኒስ፤ ኮይሮ ገልለስሰ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑን ቀን ብሎ ጠራው፥ ጨለማውንም ሌሊት አለው። ማታም ሆነ ጧትም ሆነ፥ አንደኛ ቀን።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God called the light "day", and the darkness he called "night". There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi, "Nuuni asaa nu leemisuwan, نuna milatethaan medhdhoos" giis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ፣ "ኑኡኒ አሰአ ኑ ሌእሚሱወን፣ نኡነ ሚለቴꬃአን ሜꬍꬎኦስ" ጊኢስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም አለ፦ ሰውን በመልካችን እንደ ምሳሌአችን እንፍጠር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said, "Let's make man in our image, after our likeness."

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi asaa ba leemisuwan medhdhis; Xoossaa leemisuwan iya medhdhis; attuma asanne macca asa oothidi entta medhdhis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ አሰአ በ ሌእሚሱወን ሜꬍꬊስ፤ ጦኦስሰአ ሌእሚሱወን ኢየ ሜꬍꬊስ፤ አትቱመ አሰንኔ መጭጨ አሰ ኦኦꬂዲ እንትተ ሜꬍꬊስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውን በመልኩ ፈጠረ፤ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ፈጠረው፤ ወንድና ሴት አድርጎ ፈጠራቸው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi ba medhdhidobaa ubbaa be7is; be7ishin, keehippe lo77o.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ በ ሜꬍꬊዶበአ ኡብበአ ቤዒስ፤ ቤዒሺን፣ ኬእሂፕፔ ሎዕዖ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ያደረገውን ሁሉ አየ፥ እነሆም፥ እጅግ መልካም ነበረ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday Abraama, "Ne biittaappe, ne dabbotaappenne ne aawaa keettaappe kiyada taani nena bessana biittaa ba" giis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ አብረአመ፣ "ኔ ቢኢትተአፕፔ፣ ኔ ደብቦተአፕፔንኔ ኔ አአወአ ኬእትተአፕፔ ኪየደ ተአኒ ኔነ ቤስሰነ ቢኢትተአ በ" ጊኢስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም አብራምን አለው፦ ከአገርህ ከዘመዶችህም ከአባትህም ቤት ተለይተህ እኔ ወደማሳይህ ምድር ውጣ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Now the LORD said to Abram, "Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father's house, and go to the land that I will show you."

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani nena gita dere oothana; nena anjjana; ne sunthaakkaXoqqissana; neeni anjjo gidana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ኔነ ጊተ ዴሬ ኦኦꬃነ፤ ኔነ አንጅጀነ፤ ኔ ሱንꬃአክከጦቅቂስሰነ፤ ኔእኒ አንጅጆ ጊደነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ታላቅ ሕዝብም አደርግሃለሁ፥ እባርክሃለሁም፥ ስምህንም አከብራለሁ፤ ለበረከትም ሁን።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi Muuse, "TAANI DE7IYAAGAA" giis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ሙኡሴ፣ "ተአኒ ዴዒየአገአ" ጊኢስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን፦ እኔ ያለሁና የምኖር ነኝ አለው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM."

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi ha qaalata ubbaa haasayidi hagaadaa giis:
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ሀ ቀአለተ ኡብበአ ሀአሰዪዲ ሀገአደአ ጊኢስ፦
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም እነዚህን ቃሎች ሁሉ ተናገረ እንዲህም አለ፦
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God spoke all these words, saying:

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani nena Gibxxe biittaappe, aylletethaa keettaappe kessida Godaa ne Xoossaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ኔነ ጊብጥጤ ቢኢትተአፕፔ፣ አይልሌቴꬃአ ኬእትተአፕፔ ኬስሲደ ጎደአ ኔ ጦኦስሰአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday ne Xoossay nees immiya biittan ne laythay adussana mela, ne aawaanne ne aayee bonchcha.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ኔ ጦኦስሰይ ኔእስ ኢምሚየ ቢኢትተን ኔ ለይꬃይ አዱስሰነ ሜለ፣ ኔ አአወአንኔ ኔ አአዬእ ቦንችቻ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በሚሰጥህ ምድር ዕድሜህ እንዲረዝም አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Isra7eelee, siya! Goday nu Xoossay issi Godaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢስረዔእሌእ፣ ሲየ! ጎደይ ኑ ጦኦስሰይ ኢስሲ ጎደአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር አንድ እግዚአብሔር ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Hear, Israel: the LORD is our God; the LORD is one.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Godaanne ne Xoossaa ne kumetha wozanaappe, ne kumetha shemppuwaappenne ne kumetha wolqqaappe siiqa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደአንኔ ኔ ጦኦስሰአ ኔ ኩሜꬃ ዎዘነአፕፔ፣ ኔ ኩሜꬃ ሼምፕፑወአፕፔንኔ ኔ ኩሜꬃ ዎልቅቀአፕፔ ሲኢቀ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: አንተም አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ በፍጹምም ኃይልህ ውደድ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani nena azazabiikkinaa? Minna, xala; yayyoppa, dagammoppa; ayssi giikko, neeni biyaaso ubban Goday ne Xoossay neera de7ees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ኔነ አዘዘቢኢክኪነአ? ሚንነ፣ ጠለ፤ የይዮፕፐ፣ ደገምሞፕፐ፤ አይስሲ ጊኢክኮ፣ ኔእኒ ቢየአሶ ኡብበን ጎደይ ኔ ጦኦስሰይ ኔእረ ዴዔእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እነሆ፥ አዘዝሁህ፤ ጽና፥ አይዞህ፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በምትሄድበት ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነውና።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Haven't I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don't be afraid. Don't be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Asay bolla bagga xeellees, shin Goday wozanaa xeellees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: አሰይ ቦልለ በግገ ጤእልሌእስ፣ ሺን ጎደይ ዎዘነአ ጤእልሌእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሰው ፊትን ያያል፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን ልብን ያያል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani ta Wozanchchay de7eyssa erais; wurssethanikka i sa7aa bollan eqqana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ተ ዎዘንችቻይ ዴዔይስሰ እረኢስ፤ ዉርስሴꬃኒክከ ኢ ሰዓአ ቦልለን እቅቀነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እኔ ግን ወዳጄ ሕያው እንደ ሆነ፥ በመጨረሻም ዘመን በምድር ላይ እንደሚቆም አውቃለሁ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Iita asata zoriyaa kaallonna, nagaraanchchata ogiyan eqqonna, qilliicciyaageeta uttethaan uttonna uray anjjettidaagaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢኢተ አሰተ ዞሪየአ ከአልሎንነ፣ ነገረአንችቻተ ኦጊየን እቅቆንነ፣ ቂልሊኢጭጪየአጌእተ ኡትቴꬃአን ኡትቶንነ ኡረይ አንጅጄትቲደአገአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ምክርን በክፉዎች ያልሄደ፥ በኃጢአተኞችም መንገድ ያልቆመ፥ በዋዘኞችም ወንበር ያልተቀመጠ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand in the way of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Shin iya ufayssay Godaa wogaa bollan de7ees; gallassanne qamma iya wogaa qoppees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሺን ኢየ ኡፈይስሰይ ጎደአ ዎገአ ቦልለን ዴዔእስ፤ ገልለስሰንኔ ቀምመ ኢየ ዎገአ ቆፕፔእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ደስ ይለዋል፥ ሕጉንም በቀንና በሌሊት ያሰላስላል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But his delight is in the LORD's law. On his law he meditates day and night.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday tana heemmiyaagaa; taw aynne paccenna.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ተነ ሄእምሚየአገአ፤ ተው አይንኔ ፐጭጬንነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔር እረኛዬ ነው፥ የሚያሳጣኝም የለም።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: The LORD is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Irxxa maataa bollan tana zin77issees; shemppissiya haathaakko tana kaallees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኢርጥጠ መአተአ ቦልለን ተነ ዚንዕዒስሴእስ፤ ሼምፕፒስሲየ ሀአꬃአክኮ ተነ ከአልሌእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በለመለመ መስክ ያሳድረኛል፤ በዕረፍት ውኃ ዘንድ ይመራኛል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta shemppuwaa zaareedis; ba sunthaa gishsho xillotethaa ogiyan tana kaallees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ ሼምፕፑወአ ዘአሬእዲስ፤ በ ሱንꬃአ ጊሽሾ ጢልሎቴꬃአ ኦጊየን ተነ ከአልሌእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ነፍሴን ይመልሳታል፥ ስለ ስሙም በጽድቅ መንገድ ይመራኛል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Hayqoribay dhumaa wombban taani hamuttikkokka, neeni taara de7iya gishsho, taani iitabaa yayykke; ne xam77ayinne ne gaththay tana minthethoosona.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሀይቆሪበይ ꬉመአ ዎምብበን ተአኒ ሀሙትቲክኮክከ፣ ኔእኒ ተአረ ዴዒየ ጊሽሾ፣ ተአኒ ኢኢተበአ የይይክኬ፤ ኔ ጠምዕዓዪንኔ ኔ ገꬅꬃይ ተነ ሚንꬄꬆኦሶነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በሞት ጥላ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ነህና ክፉን አልፈራም፤ በትርህና ምርኩዝህ እነርሱ ያጽናኑኛል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta morkketa sinthan taassi maaddaa giigissadasa; ta huuphiyaa zaytiyan tiyadasa; ta xuu7ay kumidi palahees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ ሞርክኬተ ሲንꬃን ተአስሲ መአድደአ ጊኢጊስሰደሰ፤ ተ ሁኡጪየአ ዘይቲየን ቲየደሰ፤ ተ ጡኡዓይ ኩሚዲ ፐለሄእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በፊቴ ገበታን አዘጋጀህልኝ በጠላቶቼ ፊት ለፊት፤ ራሴን በዘይት ቀባህ፥ ጽዋዬም የተረፈ ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Tumuppe ta de7o laytha ubban lo77otethaynne maarotethay tana kaallana; taanikka Godaa keettan merinaw de7ana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ቱሙፕፔ ተ ዴዖ ለይꬃ ኡብበን ሎዕዖቴꬃይንኔ መአሮቴꬃይ ተነ ከአልለነ፤ ተአኒክከ ጎደአ ኬእትተን ሜሪነው ዴዓነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ቸርነትህና ምሕረትህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ ይከተሉኛል፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD's house forever.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi nuussi baqataa keettanne wolqqa; metuwaa wodiyan eesotidi demettiya maaddiyaagaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ኑኡስሲ በቀተአ ኬእትተንኔ ዎልቅቀ፤ ሜቱወአ ዎዲየን እእሶቲዲ ዴሜትቲየ መአድዲየአገአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: አምላካችን መጠጊያና ኃይል፥ ባገኘንም በታላቅ መከራ ረዳት ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ne qaalay ta tohuwas xomppenne ta ogiyas poo7o.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኔ ቀአለይ ተ ቶሁወስ ጦምፕፔንኔ ተ ኦጊየስ ፖኦዖ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሕግህ ለእግሬ መብራት፥ ለመንገዴም ብርሃን ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Taani ta ayfiyaa deriyaakko pude denthais; ta maaddoy awuppe yaanee?
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተአኒ ተ አይፊየአ ዴሪየአክኮ ፑዴ ዴንꬃኢስ፤ ተ መአድዶይ አዉፕፔ የአኔእ?
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ዓይኖቼን ወደ ተራሮች አነሣሁ፤ ረዳቴ ከወዴት ይመጣል?
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta maaddoy saluwaanne sa7aa medhdhida Godaappe yees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ መአድዶይ ሰሉወአንኔ ሰዓአ ሜꬍꬊደ ጎደአፕፔ ዬእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ረዳቴ ሰማይንና ምድርን ከሠራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Godaa yayyoy eratethaa doomma; eeyyati aadhdhida eratethaanne seeraa kadhdhoosona.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደአ የይዮይ እረቴꬃአ ዶኦምመ፤ እእይየቲ አአꬍꬊደ እረቴꬃአንኔ ሴእረአ ከꬍꬎኦሶነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፤ ሰነፎች ግን ጥበብንና ተግሣጽን ይንቃሉ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ne kumetha wozanaappe Godan ammanetta; ne akeekan zemppoppa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኔ ኩሜꬃ ዎዘነአፕፔ ጎደን አምመኔትተ፤ ኔ አኬእከን ዜምፕፖፕፐ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በፍጹም ልብህ በእግዚአብሔር ታመን፥ በራስህም ማስተዋል አትደገፍ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ne ogiyaa ubban iya era; ikka ne ogiyaa suuthana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኔ ኦጊየአ ኡብበን ኢየ እረ፤ ኢክከ ኔ ኦጊየአ ሱኡꬃነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በመንገድህ ሁሉ እርሱን እወቅ፥ እርሱም ጎዳናህን ያቀናልሃል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ashkke zaaroy hanqquwaa zarxxissees; shin qohiya qaalay hanqquwaa denthees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: አሽክኬ ዘአሮይ ሀንቅቁወአ ዘርጥጢስሴእስ፤ ሺን ቆሂየ ቀአለይ ሀንቅቁወአ ዴንꬄእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: የለዘበች መልስ ቍጣን ትመልሳለች፤ ግዙፍ ቃል ግን ቍጣን ያስነሣል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Saluwaappe garssan de7iyaabaa ubbas wodey de7ees; ooso ubbaskka saatey de7ees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሰሉወአፕፔ ገርስሰን ዴዒየአበአ ኡብበስ ዎዴይ ዴዔእስ፤ ኦኦሶ ኡብበስክከ ሰአቴይ ዴዔእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ለሁሉ ዘመን አለው፥ ከሰማይም በታች ለሆነ ነገር ሁሉ ጊዜ አለው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Nuussi na7ay yelettis; attuma na7aykka nuussi imettis; kawotethay iya hashiyaa bollan gidana.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኑኡስሲ ነዓይ ዬሌትቲስ፤ አትቱመ ነዓይክከ ኑኡስሲ ኢሜትቲስ፤ ከዎቴꬃይ ኢየ ሀሺየአ ቦልለን ጊደነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሕፃን ተወልዶልናልና፥ ወንድ ልጅም ተሰጥቶናልና፤ አለቅነትም በጫንቃው ላይ ይሆናል።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Shin Godaa naagiyaageeti bantta wolqqaa oorathissoosona; argganthaa mala qefiyan pude paalloosona; woxxidi daafurokkona; hamuttidikka laafokkona.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሺን ጎደአ ነአጊየአጌእቲ በንትተ ዎልቅቀአ ኦኦረꬂስሶኦሶነ፤ አርግገንꬃአ መለ ቄፊየን ፑዴ ፐአልሎኦሶነ፤ ዎጥጢዲ ደአፉሮክኮነ፤ ሀሙትቲዲክከ ለአፎክኮነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርን በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ ግን ኃይላቸውን ያድሳሉ፤ እንደ ንስር በክንፍ ይወጣሉ፤ ይሮጣሉ፥ አይታክቱም፤ ይሄዳሉ፥ አይደክሙም።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Shin i nuooruwaa gishsho madhettis; nu nagaraa gishsho qoxettis; nuussi sarotethaa ehiya qaxxay iya bollan hanis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሺን ኢ ኑኦኦሩወአ ጊሽሾ መꬌትቲስ፤ ኑ ነገረአ ጊሽሾ ቆጤትቲስ፤ ኑኡስሲ ሰሮቴꬃአ እሂየ ቀጥጠይ ኢየ ቦልለን ሀኒስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እርሱ ግን ስለ መተላለፋችን ቆሰለ፥ ስለ በደላችንም ደቀቀ፤ የደኅንነታችንም ተግሣጽ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Goday hagaadaa gees: "Taani intteyyo qoppiya qofaa erais; intteyyo sinththappe hidootaa immanaassa sarotethaa qofaappe attin, iita qofa gidenna."
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጎደይ ሀገአደአ ጌእስ፦ "ተአኒ ኢንትቴይዮ ቆፕፒየ ቆፈአ እረኢስ፤ ኢንትቴይዮ ሲንꬅꬃፕፔ ሂዶኦተአ ኢምመነአስሰ ሰሮቴꬃአ ቆፈአፕፔ አትቲን፣ ኢኢተ ቆፈ ጊዴንነ።"
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ለእናንተ የማስባትን አሳብ እኔ አውቃለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ፍጻሜና ተስፋ እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ የሰላም አሳብ ነው እንጂ የክፉ ነገር አይደለም።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossaa sunthay merinaappe merinaa gakkanaw anjjetto; ayssi giikko, eratethaynne wolqqay iyaabaa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሰአ ሱንꬃይ ሜሪነአፕፔ ሜሪነአ ገክከነው አንጅጄትቶ፤ አይስሲ ጊኢክኮ፣ እረቴꬃይንኔ ዎልቅቀይ ኢየአበአ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ጥበብና ኃይል ለእርሱ ነውና የእግዚአብሔር ስም ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ይባረክ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Asao, lo77obay aybakko i nena bessis; pirddaa suuthanaappe, maarotethaa siiqanaappenne ne Xoossaara ashkketethaan hamuttanaappe attin, Goday neeppe koyiyabay aybee?
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: አሰኦ፣ ሎዕዖበይ አይበክኮ ኢ ኔነ ቤስሲስ፤ ፒርድደአ ሱኡꬃነአፕፔ፣ መአሮቴꬃአ ሲኢቀነአፕፔንኔ ኔ ጦኦስሰአረ አሽክኬቴꬃአን ሀሙትተነአፕፔ አትቲን፣ ጎደይ ኔእፕፔ ኮዪየበይ አይቤእ?
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ሰው ሆይ፥ መልካሙ ምንድር እንደ ሆነ አሳይቶሃል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ የሚሻው ምንድር ነው? ፍርድን ታደርግ ዘንድ፥ ምሕረትንም ትወድድ ዘንድ፥ ከአምላክህም ጋር በትሕትና ትሄድ ዘንድ አይደለምን?
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Ta keettan qumay de7ana mela, asirataa ubbaa miishshaa keettaa ehiite.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ተ ኬእትተን ቁመይ ዴዓነ ሜለ፣ አሲረተአ ኡብበአ ሚኢሽሻአ ኬእትተአ እሂኢቴ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በቤቴ ውስጥ መብል እንዲሆን አሥራቱን ሁሉ ወደ ጎተራ አግቡ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Koyro doomman Xoossi saluwaanne sa7aa medhdhis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ኮይሮ ዶኦምመን ጦኦስሲ ሰሉወአንኔ ሰዓአ ሜꬍꬊስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: በመጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔር ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጠረ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Sa7aykka bessennaanne mela de7ees; dhoqqu giida haathaa bollan dhuma de7ees; Xoossaa Ayyaanaykka haathaa bollan yuuyees.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ሰዓይክከ ቤስሴንነአንኔ ሜለ ዴዔእስ፤ ꬎቅቁ ጊኢደ ሀአꬃአ ቦልለን ꬉመ ዴዔእስ፤ ጦኦስሰአ አይየአነይክከ ሀአꬃአ ቦልለን ዩኡዬእስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: ምድሪቱም ባዶ ነበረች፥ አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ጨለማም በጥልቁ ላይ ነበረ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በውኃ ላይ ይሰፍፍ ነበር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: Now the earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep. God's Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi, "Poo7oy hano" giis; poo7oykka hanis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ፣ "ፖኦዖይ ሀኖ" ጊኢስ፤ ፖኦዖይክከ ሀኒስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም፦ ብርሃን ይሁን አለ፤ ብርሃንም ሆነ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi poo7oy lo77o gideyssa be7is; Xoossi poo7uwaanne dhumaa shaakkis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዖይ ሎዕዖ ጊዴይስሰ ቤዒስ፤ ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዑወአንኔ ꬉመአ ሻአክኪስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑንና ጨለማውን ለየ።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi poo7uwaa "Gallassa" giidi xeegis; dhumaakka "Qamma" giidi xeegis. Omarssay hanis, guuraykka hanis; koyro gallassa.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ ፖኦዑወአ "ገልለስሰ" ጊኢዲ ጤእጊስ፤ ꬉመአክከ "ቀምመ" ጊኢዲ ጤእጊስ። ኦመርስሰይ ሀኒስ፣ ጉኡረይክከ ሀኒስ፤ ኮይሮ ገልለስሰ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑን ቀን ብሎ ጠራው፥ ጨለማውንም ሌሊት አለው። ማታም ሆነ ጧትም ሆነ፥ አንደኛ ቀን።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God called the light "day", and the darkness he called "night". There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi, "Nuuni asaa nu leemisuwan, نuna milatethaan medhdhoos" giis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ፣ "ኑኡኒ አሰአ ኑ ሌእሚሱወን፣ نኡነ ሚለቴꬃአን ሜꬍꬎኦስ" ጊኢስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም አለ፦ ሰውን በመልካችን እንደ ምሳሌአችን እንፍጠር።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God said, "Let's make man in our image, after our likeness."

old_testament_seed_verses.gof_latin: Xoossi asaa ba leemisuwan medhdhis; Xoossaa leemisuwan iya medhdhis; attuma asanne macca asa oothidi entta medhdhis.
old_testament_seed_verses.gof_fidel: ጦኦስሲ አሰአ በ ሌእሚሱወን ሜꬍꬊስ፤ ጦኦስሰአ ሌእሚሱወን ኢየ ሜꬍꬊስ፤ አትቱመ አሰንኔ መጭጨ አሰ ኦኦꬂዲ እንትተ ሜꬍꬊስ።
old_testament_seed_verses.amh_fidel: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውን በመልኩ ፈጠረ፤ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ፈጠረው፤ ወንድና ሴት አድርጎ ፈጠራቸው።
old_testament_seed_verses.eng_web: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them.
